Name: Blood Boil
Description: Boils the blood of all enemies within 10 yards, dealing 42 to 51 Shadow damage.  Deals additional damage to targets infected with Blood Plague or Frost Fever.

Name: Blood Presence
Description: Strengthens you with the presence of blood, increasing damage by 2% and heals you for 2% of your damage dealt.    Only one Presence may be active at a time.    Heals up to a maximum of 5% of your health per hit.

Name: Blood Strike
Description: Instantly strike the enemy, causing 40% weapon damage plus 12, total damage increased by 12.5% for each of your diseases on the target.

Name: Blood Tap
Description: Immediately activates a Blood Rune and converts it into a Death Rune for the next 20 sec.  Death Runes count as a Blood, Frost or Unholy Rune.

Name: Dancing Rune Weapon
Description: Summons a second rune weapon that fights on its own for 8 sec, doing the same attacks as you but for 75% reduced damage.

Name: Death Pact
Description: Sacrifices an undead minion, healing you for 20% of its maximum health.

Name: Heart Strike
Description: Instantly strike the target and his nearest ally, causing 50% weapon damage plus 69 on the primary target, and 25% weapon damage plus 35 on the secondary target.  Each target takes 10% additional damage for each of your diseases active on that target.

Name: Hysteria
Description: Induces a friendly unit into a killing frenzy for 30 sec. The target is Enraged, which increases their physical damage by 15%, but causes them to lose health equal to 1% of their maximum health every second.

Name: Mark of Blood
Description: Place a Mark of Blood on an enemy.  Whenever the marked enemy deals damage to a target, that target is healed for 4% of its maximum health.  Lasts for 20 sec or up to 20 hits.

Name: Pestilence
Description: Spreads existing Blood Plague and Frost Fever infections from your target to all other enemies within 10 yards.

Name: Rune of Cinderglacier
Description: Affixes your rune weapon with a rune that has a chance to cause your target to take 20% increased Frost and Shadow damage from you.  Requires a Rune Forge.

Name: Rune of Lichbane
Description: Affixes your rune weapon with a rune that adds 2% extra weapon damage as Fire damage or 4% versus Undead targets.     Requires a Rune Forge.

Name: Rune of Razorice
Description: Affixes your weapon with a rune that causes 2% extra weapon damage as Frost damage and increases enemies' vulnerability to your Frost attacks.    Requires a Rune Forge.

Name: Rune of Spellbreaking
Description: Affixes your one-handed rune weapon with a rune that deflects 2% of all spell damage and reduces the duration of Silence effects by 50% (not cumulative with additional Silence duration reduction).    Requires a Rune Forge.

Name: Rune of Spellshattering
Description: Affixes your two-handed rune weapon with a rune that deflects 4% of all spell damage and reduces the duration of Silence effects by 50%.     Requires a Rune Forge.

Name: Rune of Swordbreaking
Description: Affixes your one-handed rune weapon with a rune that increases Parry chance by 2% and reduces the duration of Disarm effects by 50%.  Modifying your rune weapon requires a Rune Forge in Ebon Hold.

Name: Rune of Swordshattering
Description: Affixes your two-handed rune weapon with a rune that increases Parry chance by 4% and reduces the duration of Disarm effects by 50%.      Requires a Rune Forge.

Name: Rune of the Fallen Crusader
Description: Affixes your rune weapon with a rune that has a chance to heal you for 3% of your maximum health and increase total Strength by 15% for 15 sec.    Requires a Rune Forge.

Name: Rune of the Nerubian Carapace
Description: Affixes your rune weapon with a rune that increases Defense by 13 and total Stamina by 1%.    Requires a Rune Forge.

Name: Rune of the Stoneskin Gargoyle
Description: Affixes your two-handed rune weapon with a rune that increases Defense by 25 and total Stamina by 2%.    Requires a Rune Forge.

Name: Rune Tap
Description: Converts 1 Blood Rune into 10% of your maximum health.

Name: Runeforging Mastery
Description: You gain Runeforging Mastery when learning any Runeforge Spell.     This Mastery automatically unlocks Runeforge Spells when you reach their Class Point requirements at no additional ability essence cost.      Rune of Swordshattering Affixes your two-handed weapon with a rune that increases parry chance and reduces the duration of disarms.    Rune of Lichbane Affixes your weapon with a rune that causes you to deal Fire damage with your attacks, increased versus undead.    Rune of Cinderglacier Affixes your weapon with a rune that has a chance to increase the damage of your next 2 attacks that deal Frost or Shadow damage.    Rune of Spellshattering Affixes your two-handed weapon with a rune that deflects spell damage and reduces the duration of silence efffects.    Rune of Razorice Affixes your weapon with a rune that causes extra Frost damage when you attack and causes them to be more vulnerable to your Frost attacks.    Rune of the Fallen Crusader Affixes your weapon with a rune that has a chance to heal you and increase your Strength.    Rune of the Stoneskin Gargoyle Affixes your two-handed weapon with a rune that increases your defense and Stamina.    Rune of the Nerubian Carapace Affixes your weapon with a rune that increases your defense and Stamina.

Name: Strangulate
Description: Strangulates an enemy, silencing them for 5 sec.  Non-player victim spellcasting is also interrupted for 3 sec.

Name: Vampiric Blood
Description: Temporarily grants you 15% of your maximum health and increases the amount of health generated through your Death Knight spells and effects by 35% for 10 sec. After the effect expires, the health is lost.

Name: Abomination's Might
Description: Increases the attack power by 10% of party and raid members within 100 yards.      Increases your Strength by 2%.

Name: Blade Barrier
Description: Whenever your Blood Runes are on cooldown, you gain the Blade Barrier effect, which decreases damage taken by 5% for the next 10 sec.

Name: Bladed Armor
Description: Increases your melee attack power by 5 for every 250 armor value you have.

Name: Blood Gorged
Description: When you are above 75% health, you deal 10% more damage.  In addition, your attacks ignore up to 20% of your opponent's armor at all times.    The all-damage increase does not stack with Enhanced Weapon Mastery, Unending Fury, Answered Prayers, Blessed Weapons or Blood Presence. Only the highest increase applies.

Name: Bloodworms
Description: Reduces the chance you'll be critically hit by a melee and spells by 6%.    Your weapon hits have a 9% chance to cause the target to spawn 2-4 Bloodworms.  Bloodworms attack your enemies, healing you as they do damage for 20 sec or until killed.

Name: Bloody Strikes
Description: Increases the damage of Blood Strike by 15% and Heart Strike by 45%.    Increases the damage of Blood Boil by 30%.

Name: Bloody Vengeance
Description: Gives you a 3% bonus to physical damage you deal for 30 sec after dealing a critical strike from a weapon swing, spell, or ability.  This effect stacks up to 3 times.

Name: Butchery
Description: Whenever you kill an enemy that grants experience or honor, you generate up to 20 rage.      You generate 2 rage per 5 sec while in combat.

Name: Dance Lessons
Description: Increases Dancing rune weapons's damage modifier by 25% and its duration by 4 sec.

Name: Dark Conviction
Description: Increases your chance to critically hit with weapons, spells and abilities by 5%.

Name: Death Rune Mastery
Description: Whenever you hit with Death Strike or Obliterate there is a 100% chance that the Frost and Unholy Runes will become Death Runes when they activate.    Death Runes count as a Blood, Frost or Unholy Rune.

Name: Improved Blood Presence
Description: Healing done to you is increased by 10% in Blood Presence.    Threat caused decreased by 20% while in Blood Presence.     Capstone Bonus: Increases the healing from your Blood Presence by an additional 3%.    Increases the damage done while in Blood Presence by an additional 8%.    While in Frost Presence or Unholy Presence, you retain 2% healing from Blood Presence.        The all-damage increase does not stack with Enhanced Weapon Mastery, Unending Fury, Answered Prayers, Blessed Weapons, Blood Gorged or Demonic Pact. Only the highest increase applies.

Name: Improved Death Strike
Description: Increases the damage of your Death Strike by 30%, increases its critical strike chance by 6%, and increases the healing granted by 50%.

Name: Improved Rune Tap
Description: Increases the health provided by Rune Tap by 100% and lowers its cooldown by 30 sec.

Name: Might of Mograine
Description: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Blood Boil, Blood Strike, Death Strike, and Heart Strike abilities by 45%.

Name: Scent of Blood
Description: You have a 15% chance after dodging, parrying or taking direct damage to gain the Scent of Blood effect, causing your next 3 melee hits to generate 10 rage.

Name: Spell Deflection
Description: You have a chance equal to your Parry chance of taking 45% less damage from a direct damage spell.

Name: Subversion
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of Blood Strike, Scourge Strike, Heart Strike and Obliterate by 9%.    Reduces all threat generated while in Blood or Unholy Presence by 25%.

Name: Sudden Doom
Description: Requires  Grave Coil (Rank 1)  Direct damage abilities and spells have a 9% chance to cast a free Grave Coil at your target.

Name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization
Description: Increases the physical damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 4%.

Name: Vendetta
Description: Heals you for up to 6% of your maximum health whenever you kill a target that yields experience or honor.

Name: Veteran of the Third War
Description: Increases your total Strength by 6%, your Stamina by 3%, and your expertise by 6.

Name: Will of the Necropolis
Description: Damage that would take you below 35% health or taken while you are at 35% health is reduced by 15%.

Name: Chains of Ice
Description: Shackles the target with frozen chains, reducing their movement by 45%, and infects them with Frost Fever. The target regains 4% of their movement each second for 10 sec.

Name: Deathchill
Description: When activated, makes your next Icy Touch, Howling Blast, Frost Strike or Obliterate a critical hit if used within 30 sec.

Name: Empower Rune Weapon
Description: Empower your rune weapon, immediately activating all your runes and generating 25 rage.

Name: Frost Presence
Description: Increases Stamina by 4% and significantly increases threat generated.   Increases the Armor contribution Cloth, Leather, Mail and Plate items by 30%   Reduces damage taken by 2%.    Only one Presence may be active at a time.

Name: Frost Strike
Description: Instantly strike the enemy, causing 55% weapon damage plus 31 as Frost damage.

Name: Horn of Winter
Description: Increases the Strength and Agility of all party or raid members within 30 yards by 2 and generates 10 rage. Lasts 30 min.

Name: Howling Blast
Description: Blast the target with a frigid wind dealing 119 to 129 Frost damage to all enemies within 10 yards.

Name: Hungering Cold
Description: Purges the earth around the you of all heat. Enemies within 10 yards are trapped in ice, preventing them from performing any action for 10 sec and infecting them with Frost Fever. Enemies are considered Frozen, but any damage other than diseases will break the ice.

Name: Icebound Fortitude
Description: Freeze your blood to become immune to Stun effects and reduce all damage taken by 30% plus additional damage reduction based on Defense for 12 sec.

Name: Icy Touch
Description: Chills the target for 11 to 12 Frost damage and infects them with Frost Fever, a disease that deals periodic damage and reduces melee and ranged attack speed by 14% for 15 sec. Generates very high threat while in a Tank Stance.

Name: Improved Icy Talons
Description: Increases the melee haste of all party and raid members within 100 yds by 20%.    Increases your melee and ranged haste by an additional 5%.

Name: Lichborne
Description: Draw upon unholy energy to become undead for 10 sec.  While undead, you are immune to Charm, Fear and Sleep effects.

Name: Mind Freeze
Description: Smash the target's mind with cold, interrupting spellcasting and preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 4 sec.    This ability shares a cooldown with other interrupts.

Name: Obliterate
Description: A brutal instant attack that deals 80% weapon damage plus 28, total damage increased 12.5% per each of your diseases on the target, but consumes the diseases.

Name: Path of Frost
Description: Surrounds the caster with a freezing aura beneath her feet, allowing her and her party or raid to walk on water for 10 min. Works while mounted. Any damage will cancel the effect.

Name: Rune Strike
Description: Strike the target for 150% weapon damage plus 2. Only usable after you dodge or parry an attack. Can't be dodged, blocked, or parried. This attack causes a high amount of threat.

Name: Threat of Thassarian
Description: When dual-wielding your, Plague Strike, Death Strike, Blood Strike, Frost Strike, Obliterate and Rune Strike hits also strike with your off-hand weapon.

Name: Unbreakable Armor
Description: Reinforces your armor with a thick coat of ice, increasing your armor by 25% and increasing your Strength by 20% for 20 sec.

Name: Acclimation
Description: When you are hit by a spell, you have a 30% chance to boost your resistance to that type of magic for 18 sec.  Stacks up to 3 times.

Name: Annihilation
Description: Increases your critical strike chance by 3%.      Your Obliterate will do its damage without consuming diseases.

Name: Black Ice
Description: Increases your Frost damage by 10%.    Increases your Shadow damage by 5%.

Name: Blood of the North
Description: Increases Blood Strike and Frost Strike damage by 10%.      Whenever you hit with Blood Strike or Pestilence there is a 100% chance that the Blood Rune will become a Death Rune when it activates.      Death Runes count as a Blood, Frost or Unholy Rune.

Name: Chilblains
Description: Victims of your Frost Fever disease are Chilled, reducing movement speed by 50% for 10 sec.

Name: Chill of the Grave
Description: Your Chains of Ice, Howling Blast, Icy Touch and Obliterate generate 5.0 additional rage.

Name: Endless Winter
Description: Your strength is increased by 4%.    The cost of your Mind Freeze is reduced by 20 rage.

Name: Fortified Frost Presence
Description: While Frost Presence is active, its Stamina bonus is increased by 4%, Armor contribution from Cloth, Leather, Mail and Plate is increased by 30%, and damage taken is reduced by an additional 4%.

Name: Frigid Dreadplate
Description: Reduces the chance melee attacks will hit you by 3%.

Name: Glacier Rot
Description: Diseased enemies take 20% more damage from your Icy Touch, Howling Blast and Frost Strike.

Name: Guile of Gorefiend
Description: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Blood Strike, Frost Strike, Howling Blast and Obliterate abilities by 45%.    Increases the duration of your Icebound Fortitude by 6 secs.

Name: Icy Reach
Description: Increases the range of your damaging spells by 6 yards, and the range of your Icy Touch, Chains of Ice, and Howling Blast by an additional 4 yards.    This does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Icy Talons
Description: You leech heat from victims of your Frost Fever, so that when their melee attack speed is reduced, yours increases by 20% for the next 20 sec.

Name: Improved Frost Presence
Description: While in Blood Presence or Unholy Presence, you retain 8% stamina from Frost Presence.    Damage done to you is decreased by an additional 2% in Frost Presence.

Name: Improved Icy Touch
Description: Your Icy Touch does an additional 15% damage and your Frost Fever reduces melee and ranged attack speed by an additional 6%.

Name: Killing Machine
Description: Your melee abilities have a chance to make your next Frost spell or ability guaranteed to critically strike.  Effect occurs more often than Killing Machine (Rank 4).

Name: Merciless Combat
Description: Increases damage done by all frost spells and abilities by 12% to targets under 35% health.

Name: Nerves of Cold Steel
Description: Increases your chance to hit by 5%.    Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 33%.  Does not stack with Dual Wield Mastery

Name: Rime
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Icy Touch and Obliterate by 15%.    Casting Obliterate has a 15% chance to reset the cooldown on Howling Blast and cause your next Howling Blast to consume no runes.

Name: Runic Focus
Description: Your spell critical strikes now deal 200% damage.     This does not stack with other similar effects.   Capstone Bonus: Diseased enemies take 4% more damage from you.

Name: Runic Power Mastery
Description: Increases your maximum rage by 20.

Name: Toughness
Description: Increases your armor value from items by 10%.    Reduces the duration of all movement slowing effects by 30%.

Name: Tundra Stalker
Description: Your spells and abilities deal 15% more damage to targets infected with your Frost Fever.    Increases your expertise by 5.

Name: Anti-Magic Shell
Description: Surrounds you in an Anti-Magic Shell, absorbing 75% of the damage dealt by harmful spells (up to a maximum of 50% of your health) and preventing application of harmful magical effects.      20% of the absorbed damage by Anti-Magic Shell is granted as additional rage. Lasts 5 sec.

Name: Anti-Magic Zone
Description: Places a large, stationary Anti-Magic Zone that reduces spell damage done to party or raid members inside it by 75%. The Anti-Magic Zone lasts for 10 sec or until it absorbs 10024 spell damage.

Name: Army of the Dead
Description: Summons an entire legion of Ghouls to fight for you over 4 sec. The Ghouls will swarm the area, taunting and fighting anything they can.  While channeling Army of the Dead, you take less damage equal to your Dodge plus Parry chance.

Name: Bone Shield
Description: Your are surrounded by 3 whirling bones.  While at least 1 bone remains, you take 20% less damage from all sources and deals 2% more damage with all attacks, spells and abilities.  Each damaging attack that lands consumes 1 bone.  Lasts 5 min.

Name: Corpse Explosion
Description: Cause a corpse to explode for 166 Shadow damage to all enemies within 10 yards.  Will use a nearby corpse if the target is not a corpse.  Does not affect mechanical or elemental corpses.

Name: Death and Decay
Description: Corrupts the ground at the targeted area, causing 14 Shadow damage every sec that targets remain in the area for 10 sec. This ability produces a high amount of threat.

Name: Death Grip
Description: Harness the unholy energy that surrounds and binds all matter, drawing the target towards you and forces them to attack you for 3 sec.

Name: Death Strike
Description: A deadly attack that deals 75% weapon damage plus 23 and heals you for 5% of your maximum health for each of your diseases on the target.

Name: Dominate Undead
Description: Teaches you the necessary abilities to Dominate an Undead companion.  Teaches you Dominate Undead, Raise Undead, Dismiss Undead, Revive Undead and Undead Lore.      Dominate Undead Begins dominating an undead to be your companion.     Your armor is reduced by 100% while you focus on dominating the undead for 20 sec.     If you lose the undead's attention for any reason, the domination process will fail. Each type of undead has unique abilities that you will be able to make use of.

Name: Ghoul Frenzy
Description: Grants your Ghoul pet 25% haste for 30 sec and heals it for 60% of its health over the duration.

Name: Grave Coil
Description: Fire a blast of unholy energy, causing 26 Shadow damage to an enemy target or healing 39 damage from a friendly Undead target.    Ancient Death Knights remember this dark spell as Death Coil

Name: Master of Ghouls
Description: Reduces the cooldown on Raise Dead by 60 sec, and the Ghoul summoned by your Raise Dead spell is considered a pet under your control.  Unlike normal Death Knight Ghouls, your pet does not have a limited duration.    While your Ghoul is active and within 100 yards, it increases your Strength by 5% and reduces damage taken by 5%.

Name: Plague Strike
Description: A vicious strike that deals 50% weapon damage plus 8 and infects the target with Blood Plague, a disease dealing 3 Shadow damage over time.

Name: Raise Ally
Description: Raises the corpse of a raid or party member to fight by your side. The player will have control over the Ghoul for 5 min.

Name: Raise Dead
Description: Raises a Ghoul to fight by your side. You can have a maximum of one Ghoul at a time.  Lasts 1 min.

Name: Scourge Strike
Description: An unholy strike that deals 70% of weapon damage as Physical damage plus 102.  In addition, for each of your diseases on your target, you deal an additional 12% of the Physical damage done as Shadow damage.

Name: Summon Gargoyle
Description: A Gargoyle flies into the area and bombards the target with Nature damage, increased by 33% of the higher of your attack power or spell power. The Gargoyle inherits your spell penetration, hit chance, and 30% of your stamina. Persists for 30 sec.

Name: Unholy Frenzy
Description: Increases the attack rate of your Demon or Undead pet by 50% but drains 2% of its health every 1 seconds. Lasts 30 sec.

Name: Unholy Presence
Description: Infuses you with unholy fury, increasing attack speed by 5%, movement speed by 15%, and reducing the global cooldown of all Death Knight abilities by 0.5 sec.     Only one Presence can be active at a time.

Name: Anticipation
Description: Increases your Dodge chance by 5%.

Name: Blood-Caked Blade
Description: Your auto attacks have a 30% chance to cause a Blood-Caked Strike, which hits for 25% weapon damage plus 12.5% for each of your diseases on the target.

Name: Crypt Fever
Description: Your Death Knight diseases also cause Crypt Fever, which increases disease damage taken by the target by 30%.

Name: Desecration
Description: Your Plague Strikes and Scourge Strikes cause the Desecrated Ground effect.  Targets in the area are slowed by 50% by the grasping arms of the dead while standing on the unholy ground.  Lasts 20 sec.

Name: Desolation
Description: Your Blood Strikes cause you to deal 5% additional damage with all attacks for the next 20 sec.

Name: Dirge
Description: Your Death Strike, Plague Strike and Scourge Strike generate 5.0 additional rage.

Name: Ebon Plaguebringer
Description: Increases your critical strike chance by 3%.    Your Crypt Fever morphs into Ebon Plague, which increases magic damage taken by 13% in addition to increasing disease damage taken.

Name: Epidemic
Description: Increases the duration of Blood Plague and Frost Fever by 6 sec.

Name: Frenzied Unholy Presence
Description: Increases your attack speed benefit of Unholy Presence by 10%.

Name: Improved Unholy Presence
Description: While in Blood Presence or Frost Presence, you retain 15% increased movement speed from Unholy Presence.     Your runes finish their cooldowns 10% faster in Unholy Presence.

Name: Impurity
Description: The attack power bonus of your Deathknight spells is increased by 20%.

Name: Magic Suppression
Description: You take 6% less damage from all magic.      Your Anti-Magic Shell absorbs an additional 25% of spell damage.

Name: Morbidity
Description: Increases the damage and healing of Grave Coil by 15%.    Reduces the cooldown on Death and Decay by 15 sec.

Name: Necrosis
Description: Your melee auto attacks deal an additional 20% Shadow damage.

Name: Night of the Dead
Description: Increases all damage done by 2%.    Reduces the cooldown on Raise Dead by 90 sec and the cooldown on Army of the Dead by 4 min.

Name: On a Pale Horse
Description: You become as hard to stop as death itself.      The duration of all Stun and Fear effects used against you is reduced by 20%.    Your mounted speed is increased by 20%.    This does not stack with other movement speed increasing effects.  This does not stack with other Stun or Fear reduction effects.

Name: Outbreak
Description: Increases the damage of Plague Strike by 30% and Scourge Strike by 20%.

Name: Rage of Rivendare
Description: Your spells and abilities deal 10% more damage to targets infected with your Blood Plague.    Increases your expertise by 5.

Name: Ravenous Dead
Description: Increases your total Strength by 3% and the contribution your Ghouls get from your Strength and Stamina by 60%

Name: Reaping
Description: Whenever you hit with Blood Strike or Pestilence there is a 100% chance that the Blood Rune becomes a Death Rune when it activates.      Death Runes count as a Blood, Frost or Unholy Rune.

Name: Unholy Blight
Description: Causes the victims of your Grave Coil to be surrounded by a vile swarm of unholy insects, taking 10% of the damage done by the Grave Coil over 10 sec, and preventing any diseases on the victim from being dispelled.

Name: Unholy Command
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Death Grip ability by 10 sec.

Name: Vicious Strikes
Description: Increases the critical strike chance by 6% and critical strike damage bonus by 30% of your Plague Strike and Scourge Strike.

Name: Virulence
Description: Increases your hit chance by 3%.    Reduces the chance that your damage over time diseases can be cured by 30%.

Name: Wandering Plague
Description: When your Death Knight diseases damage an enemy, there is a chance equal to your melee critical strike chance that they will cause 100% additional damage to the target and all enemies within 8 yards.    Ignores any target under the effect of a spell that is cancelled by taking damage.

Name: Barkskin
Description: The caster's skin becomes as tough as bark.  All damage taken is reduced by 20%.  While protected, damaging attacks will not cause spellcasting delays. Lasts 12 sec.    This spell is usable while stunned, frozen, incapacitated, feared or asleep.     This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Cyclone
Description: Tosses the enemy target into the air, preventing all action but making them invulnerable for up to 6 sec. Only one target can be affected by your Cyclone at a time.

Name: Entangling Roots
Description: Roots the target in place and causes 24 Nature damage over 12 sec. (8 seconds on players).     Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

Name: Faerie Fire
Description: Decrease the armor of the target by 5% for 40 sec (20 seconds on players). While affected, the target cannot stealth or turn invisible.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Feline Grace
Description: Reduces damage from falling.

Name: Force of Nature
Description: Summons 3 treants to attack enemy targets for 30 sec. Shares a cooldown with other Force of Nature spells.  Can't be used while having an active pet.    This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Hibernate
Description: Forces the enemy target to sleep for up to 20 sec.  Any damage will awaken the target. Only one target can be forced to hibernate at a time. Only works on Beasts and Dragonkin.

Name: Hurricane
Description: Creates a violent storm in the target area causing 112 Nature damage to enemies every 1 sec, and increasing the time between attacks of enemies by 20%.    Does not stack with other similar effects.    Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Hypnosis
Description: Forces the enemy target to sleep for 30 sec (6 sec versus players). Any damage taken will be increased by 10%, but will awaken the target. Only one target can be forced to sleep at a time.     This spell is castable while moving.

Name: Innervate
Description: Causes the target to regenerate mana equal to 225% of the caster's base mana pool over 10 sec.

Name: Insect Swarm
Description: The enemy target is swarmed by insects, decreasing their chance to hit by 3% and causing 156 Nature damage over 12 sec.

Name: Mass Entanglement
Description: Roots the target and all enemies within 8 yards in place for 8 sec. 6 sec versus players. Damage may interrupt the effect.  When the effect breaks, the target is slowed by 30% for 3 sec.  Usable while shapeshifted.  This spell cannot miss.

Name: Moonfire
Description: Burns the enemy for 5 to 7 Arcane damage and then an additional 9 Arcane damage over 9 sec.

Name: Moonkin Form
Description: Increases armor from cloth and leather by 150%, damage taken while stunned is reduced by 15%. Your direct damaging spells have a 33% chance to regenerate 2% of your total mana.   All party and raid members gain 5% increased spell critical effect chance. Does not stack with similar effects.  Casting any healing spell will take you out of Moonkin Form.

Name: Nature's Grasp
Description: For 45 sec, any time an enemy within 15 yards hits the caster they have a 100% chance to become afflicted by Entangling Roots which roots them in place for 5 sec.     Does not trigger on enemies already affected by a root effect.

Name: Solar Beam
Description: You summon a beam of solar light, silencing all enemies under the beam while it is active. Solar Beam lasts for 6 sec.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Soothe Animal
Description: Soothes the target beast, reducing the range at which it will attack you by 10 yards and reducing its attack speed by 20%. Only affects Beast and Dragonkin targets level 40 or lower. Lasts 30 sec.

Name: Starfall
Description: You summon a flurry of stars from the sky on all targets within 20 yards of the caster, each dealing 66 to 75 Arcane damage. Also causes 12 Arcane damage to all other enemies within 5 yards of the enemy target. Maximum 20 stars. Lasts 10 sec.      Shapeshifting into an animal form or mounting cancels the effect. Any effect which causes you to lose control of your character will suppress the starfall effect.

Name: Starfire
Description: Causes 121 to 149 Arcane damage to the target.

Name: Starsurge
Description: Deals 199 to 241 Spellstorm damage to the target.

Name: Teleport: Moonglade
Description: Teleports the caster to the Moonglade.

Name: Thorns
Description: Thorns sprout from the friendly target causing 3 Nature damage to attackers when hit.  Lasts 30 min.

Name: Typhoon
Description: You summon a violent Typhoon that does 351 Nature damage when in contact with hostile targets, knocking them back and dazing them for 6 sec.

Name: Ursol's Vortex
Description: Conjures a vortex of wind for 8 sec around yourself, reducing the movement speed of all enemies within 5 yards by 30%. When an enemy leaves the vortex, winds will pull that enemy back to its center.     Enemies can only get pulled from any vortex once every 8 seconds.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Wrath
Description: Causes 17 to 19 Nature damage to the target.

Name: Balance of Power
Description: Increases your hit chance by 4%.    Reduces your magic damage taken by 6%.

Name: Brambles
Description: Damage from your Thorns increased by 75% and damage done by your Treants increased by 15%.     Melee attacks done to you while you have Barkskin active have a 15% chance to daze the target for 3 sec.

Name: Celestial Bane
Description: Increases your Nature damage by 6% to targets affected by your Insect Swarm.  Increases your Critical Strike chance with Arcane spells 6% to targets affected by your Moonfire.

Name: Celestial Focus
Description: Increases your haste by 2%.    Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks by 70%.

Name: Dreamstate
Description: Regenerate mana equal to 10% of your Intellect every 5 sec, even while casting.

Name: Earth and Moon
Description: Increases your spell damage by 6%.   Wrath, Starfire and Starsurge apply the Earth and Moon effect, which increases magic damage taken by 13% for 8 sec.    Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Eclipse
Description: Dealing direct Arcane damage grants you a 100% chance to increase the damage of your Wrath and Starsurge by 40% for 15 seconds.    Dealing direct Nature damage grants you a 100% chance to increase your critical strike chance with Starfire and Starsurge by 40% for 15 seconds.    Both effects cannot occur at the same time and each effect can only occur once every 30 seconds.

Name: Gale Winds
Description: Increases your Hurricane and Typhoon damage by 30%.

Name: Genesis
Description: Increases the periodic damage and healing of your spells by 5%.

Name: Improved Faerie Fire
Description: Your Faerie Fire spell also increases the chance the target will be hit by spell attacks by 3%.    Increases the critical strike chance of your damage spells by 3% on targets afflicted by Faerie Fire.

Name: Improved Moonfire
Description: Increases the damage of Moonfire spell by 15% and the critical strike chance of Starfire and Starsurge by 10%.  Capstone Bonus: Your direct Arcane damage critical hits on targets afflicted by your Moonfire instantly trigger an extra Arcane damage. This can happen once every 1.5 sec.

Name: Improved Moonkin Form
Description: Your Moonkin Aura also causes affected targets to gain 3% spell haste.   Does not stack with similar effects.  In Moonkin Form, you to gain 30% of your spirit as additional spell damage.

Name: Lunar Guidance
Description: Increases your spell damage by 12% of your Intellect.

Name: Moonfury
Description: Increases the damage of your Starfire, Moonfire, Wrath, and Starsurge by 10%.

Name: Moonglow
Description: Reduces the mana cost of your Starfire, Wrath, Starsurge, Healing Touch, Regrowth, Rejuvenation, and Swiftmend spells by 9%.

Name: Nature's Grace
Description: Direct damaging or healing Druid spell criticals have a 100% chance to grant you Nature's Grace, increasing your haste by 20% for 4 sec.

Name: Nature's Majesty
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Wrath, Starfire, Starfall, Starsurge, Nourish and Healing Touch spells by 4%.

Name: Nature's Reach
Description: Increases the range of your damaging spells with a channeling or cast time by 6 yards.     Does not stack with other similar effects.  Capstone Bonus: Your Nature non-periodic spells have a 100% chance to spread your Insect Swarm to all enemies within 5 yards, if hitting a target affected by Insect Swarm. This effect has a 6 sec internal cooldown.

Name: Nature's Splendor
Description: Increases the duration of your Moonfire and Rejuvenation by 3 sec, your Regrowth by 6 sec, and your Insect Swarm, Lifebloom, Efflorescence and Flourish by 2 sec.

Name: Owlkin Frenzy
Description: While in Moonkin Form, attacks against you have a 24% chance to trigger a Frenzy, increasing your damage done by 5%.     This also grants immunity to casting pushback for Balance spells and restores 2% base mana every 2 sec. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Starlight Wrath
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of Wrath by 9%.    Increases the damage of Starfire and Starsurge by 6%.

Name: Vengeance
Description: Your spell critical strikes now deal 200% damage.   Does not stack with similar effects.  Capstone Bonus: Your direct Arcane and Nature criticals  have a chance to attract a Vengeful Soul, increasing your magic damage by 3% for 12 seconds. When this effect ends the Soul leaves your body, restoring 5% of your missing mana.

Name: Wrath of Cenarius
Description: Increases the spell damage scaling of your Starfire and Starsurge by 20% and the spell damage scaling of your Wrath by 10%.

Name: Aquatic Form
Description: Shapeshift into aquatic form, increasing swim speed by 50% and allowing the druid to breathe underwater. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects.

Name: Bash
Description: Stuns the target for 2 sec and interrupts non-player spellcasting for 3 sec.

Name: Bear Form
Description: Shapeshift into Bear Form.    Increasing melee attack power by 30, armor contribution from cloth and leather items by 65%, and Stamina by 15%.     Teaches you Growl.

Name: Berserk
Description: When activated, this ability causes your Mangle abilities to hit up to 3 targets and have no cooldown for 15 sec.    Reduces the cost of all your Cat Form and Bear Form abilities by 50%.     While active your Savage Defense absorb effect is doubled.

Name: Cat Form
Description: Shapeshift into cat form, increasing melee attack power by 1 plus 25% of Agility. Allows the use of various cat abilities.

Name: Challenging Roar
Description: Forces all nearby enemies within 10 yards to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

Name: Cower
Description: Cower, causing no damage but lowering your threat a large amount, making enemies less likely to attack you.

Name: Dash
Description: Increases movement speed by 50% while in Cat Form for 15 sec. Does not break prowling.

Name: Demoralizing Roar
Description: The druid roars, decreasing nearby enemies' attack power by 31.  Lasts 30 sec.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Enrage
Description: Generates 20 rage, and then generates an additional 10 rage over 10 sec, but reduces base armor by 27% in Bear Form and 16% in Dire Bear Form.

Name: Faerie Fire (Feral)
Description: Decrease the armor of the target by 5% for 40 sec(20 seconds on players) While affected, the target cannot stealth or turn invisible. Deals 3 damage and additional threat when used in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Feral Charge
Description: Teaches Feral Charge (Bear) and Feral Charge (Cat).       Feral Charge - Bear Causes you to charge an enemy gaining 15 rage, immobilizing them for 3 sec and interrupting any spell being cast for 4 sec.    This shares a cooldown with other Feral Charges.    Feral Charge - Cat Causes you to leap behind an enemy, dazing them for 3 sec.  This shares a cooldown with other Feral Charges.

Name: Ferocious Bite
Description: Finishing move that causes damage per combo point and converts each extra point of energy (up to a maximum of 30 extra energy) into 0.7 additional damage.    1 point  : 18-23 damage    2 points: 31-36 damage    3 points: 44-49 damage    4 points: 56-61 damage    5 points: 69-74 damage

Name: Frenzied Regeneration
Description: Converts up to 10 rage per second into health for 10 sec.  Each point of rage is converted into 0.3% of max health.

Name: Ironfur
Description: Reduces damage taken by 4% plus an additional 4% per active application for 6 sec. Each application has an individual duration.  Max 3 charges. 10 second recharge timer.

Name: Lacerate
Description: Lacerates the enemy target, dealing 7 damage and making them bleed for 35 damage over 15 sec and causing a high amount of threat.  Damage increased by attack power.      Stacks up to 3 times on the same target.

Name: Leader of the Pack
Description: While in Cat, Bear or Dire Bear Form, the Leader of the Pack increases ranged and melee critical strike chance of all party and raid members by 5%.    Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Maim
Description: Finishing move that causes damage and incapacitates the target. Causes more damage and lasts longer per combo point:    1 point  : 131-133 damage, 1 sec    2 points: 215-217 damage, 2 sec    3 points: 299-301 damage, 3 sec    4 points: 383-385 damage, 4 sec    5 points: 467-469 damage, 5 sec    Non-player victim spellcasting is also interrupted for 3 sec.     Any damage caused will interrupt the incapacitating effect.    Does not break from periodic damage.

Name: Mangle
Description: Mangle the target, inflicting damage and causing the target to take 30% additional damage from bleeds for 1 min.   Does not stack with similar effects.  This ability can be used in Cat Form or Dire Bear Form.

Name: Maul
Description: A strong attack that increases melee damage by 18 and causes a high amount of threat. Effects which increase Bleed damage also increase Maul damage.

Name: Pounce
Description: Pounce, stunning the target for 3.50 sec and causing 270 damage over 18 sec. Must be prowling. Awards 1 combo point.

Name: Prowl
Description: Allows the Druid to prowl around, but reduces your movement speed by 30%. Lasts until cancelled.

Name: Rake
Description: Rake the target for 12 bleed damage and an additional 65 damage over 9 sec. Awards 1 combo point.

Name: Ravage
Description: Ravage the target, causing 385% damage plus 77 to the target. Must be prowling and behind the target. Awards 1 combo point.

Name: Rip
Description: Finishing move that causes damage over time.  Damage increases per combo point:     1 point  : 16 damage over 12 sec     2 points: 26 damage over 12 sec     3 points: 36 damage over 12 sec     4 points: 46 damage over 12 sec     5 points: 56 damage over 12 sec

Name: Shred
Description: Shred the target, causing 225% damage plus 15 to the target. Must be behind the target. Awards 1 combo point.  Effects which increase Bleed damage also increase Shred damage.

Name: Stampeding Roar
Description: You roar, increasing the movement speed of all party members within 10 yards by 60% for 6 sec. Does not break prowling.

Name: Survival Instincts
Description: Increases your maximum health by 20% and triples effectiveness of Nurturing Instinct's increased healing received effect for 20 sec. Only usable while in Cat, Bear or Dire Bear Form. After the effect expires, the health is lost.

Name: Swipe (Cat)
Description: Swipe nearby enemies, inflicting 140% weapon damage.

Name: Tiger's Fury
Description: Adds 10 damage to your attacks and increases damage by 5% for 6 sec.

Name: Track Humanoids (Cat Form)
Description: Shows the location of all nearby humanoids on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

Name: Travel Form
Description: Shapeshift into travel form, increasing movement speed by 40%.  Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects. Only usable outdoors.  The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of movement impairing and Polymorph effects.

Name: Brutal Impact
Description: Increases the stun duration of your Bash and Pounce abilities by 1 sec.    Reduces the cooldown of Bash by 30 sec.

Name: Elder Hide
Description: Increases the Armor contribution from cloth and leather items by 12%.

Name: Feral Aggression
Description: Increases the damage you do to targets above 75% health by 9%.    Increases your attack power while in Feral forms by 150% of your level.

Name: Feral Instinct
Description: Increases Swipe and Ravage damage by 30%.  Increases all damage dealt by 3% while Tiger's Fury is active.   Reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while Prowling.   Capstone Bonus: Dealing damage with Swipe and Ravage reduce the cooldown of Tiger's Fury and Enrage by 1 second.

Name: Feral Swiftness
Description: Increases your movement speed by 20% in Cat Form.    Increases your chance to dodge while in Cat Form, Bear Form and Dire Bear Form by 4%.

Name: Ferocity
Description: Increases all attributes by 5% and reduces the energy cost of your Swipe (Cat), Claw, Rake and Mangle (Cat) abilities by 10 Energy.  Reduces the rage cost of your Maul, Swipe (Bear), and Mangle (Bear) by 5 Rage.

Name: Heart of the Wild
Description: Increases your Intellect by 9%.     While in Bear or Dire Bear Form your Stamina is increased by 6%.    While in Cat Form your attack power is increased by 6%.

Name: Improved Leader of the Pack
Description: Leader of the Pack also causes affected targets to heal themselves for 4% of their base health when they critically hit with a melee or ranged attack.      You gain 16% of your base mana when you benefit from this heal.    The healing effect cannot occur more than once every 6 sec.

Name: Improved Mangle
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Mangle (Bear) ability by 1.5 sec.     Reduces the energy cost of your Mangle (Cat) ability by 6.

Name: Improved Shapeshifting
Description: Your Druid shapeshifting spells now cause the act of shapeshifting to free the caster of Polymorph and movement impairment effects.    Increases the Armor contribution from cloth and leather items by 20% while in Bear Form.

Name: Infected Wounds
Description: Shred, Maul, Swipe, and Mangle attacks cause an Infected Wound in the target.     Infected Wound slows the target's movement speed by 50%, and reduces attack speed by 20%. Lasts 12 sec.  Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: King of the Jungle
Description: While in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form, your Enrage ability increases physical damage done by 15%.  While in Cat Form, casting Tiger's Fury restores 60 energy.     Reduces the mana cost of Bear Form, Cat Form, and Dire Bear Form by 60%.  Capstone Bonus: The global cooldown of Cat Form and Bear Form is reduced by 0.5 sec.

Name: Natural Reaction
Description: Increases your chance to dodge by 6% while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form.    You regenerate 15 rage every time you dodge while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form.

Name: Nurturing Instinct
Description: Increases your healing spells by up to 70% of your Agility, and increases healing done to you by 20%  while in Cat form.

Name: Predatory Instincts
Description: While in Cat Form increases your damage from all critical strikes by 15% and reduces the damage taken from area of effect attacks by 10%.     This does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Predatory Strikes
Description: Reduces the energy cost of your Cat Form finishing moves by 9.     Your Feral finishing moves have a 20% chance per combo point spent to make your next Nature spell with a base casting time less than 10 sec. become an instant cast spell.

Name: Primal Fury
Description: Gives you a 100% chance to gain an additional 5 Rage anytime you get a critical strike while in Bear and Dire Bear Form.    Your critical strikes from Cat Form abilities that add combo points have a 100% chance to add an additional combo point.

Name: Primal Gore
Description: Grants the periodic damage from your Lacerate and Rip abilities the ability to critically hit.

Name: Primal Precision
Description: Increases your energy regeneration rate by 20%.    Increases your Expertise by 10.    Cat Form finishing moves that fail to land are refunded 80% of the energy cost.  Capstone Bonus: Your Cat Form finishing moves reduce the cooldown of Berserk by 3 sec. and Tiger's Fury by 2 sec.

Name: Primal Tenacity
Description: While in Cat Form the duration of fear effects are reduced by 30% and all damage taken while stunned by 30%.

Name: Protector of the Pack
Description: While in Bear or Dire Bear Form your attack power is increased by 6% and the physical damage you take is reduced by 12%.

Name: Rend and Tear
Description: Increases damage done by your Maul and Shred attacks on bleeding targets by 20%.    Increases the critical strike chance of your Ferocious Bite ability on bleeding targets by 25%.

Name: Savage Defense
Description: Each time you critically strike with melee damage while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form you have a 100% chance to trigger Savage Defense.    When triggered versus players this effect has 8 sec cooldown and only reduces the damage taken by 1 hit.    Savage Defense Reduces damage from the next 3 physical attacks made against you by an amount equal to 3% of your maximum health plus 8% of your attack power.

Name: Savage Fury
Description: Increases the damage caused by your Claw, Rake, Shred, Mangle (Cat), Mangle (Bear), and Maul abilities by 20%.

Name: Sharpened Claws
Description: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and abilities while in Bear, Dire Bear or Cat Form by 6%.

Name: Shredding Attacks
Description: Reduces the energy cost of your Shred ability by 18.    Reduces the rage cost of your Lacerate ability by 2.

Name: Survival of the Fittest
Description: While you are in Bear Form:    Increases all attributes by 6%.    Reduces the chance you'll be critically hit by melee attacks by 6%.    Increases your armor contribution from cloth and leather items by 33%.

Name: Abolish Poison
Description: Attempts to cure 1 poison effect on the target, and 1 more poison effect every 3 seconds for 12 sec.

Name: Cure Poison
Description: Cures 1 poison effect on the target.

Name: Efflorescence
Description: Restores health to allies within 15 yards of the initial target every 2 sec and increases the caster's healing on affected targets by 18% for 6 sec.

Name: Flourish
Description: Heals a friendly target for 198 to 246 and increases all healing done by your Nature healing over time effects on the target by 100% for 4 sec.

Name: Healing Touch
Description: Heals a friendly target for 21 to 29.

Name: Lifebloom
Description: Heals the target for 84 over 7 sec.      When Lifebloom completes its duration or is dispelled, the target instantly heals themself for 190 to 191 and the Druid regains half the cost of the spell.      This effect can stack up to 3 times on the target.

Name: Mark of the Wild
Description: Increases the friendly target's armor by 25 for 30 min.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Natural Alacrity
Description: When activated, your next Druid Nature spell with a base casting time less than 10 sec. becomes instant. In addition, the effectiveness of your Nature healing spells are increased by 10% for 20 sec.

Name: Nature Ward
Description: Absorbs 290 Nature damage.  Lasts 30 sec.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Nourish
Description: Heals a friendly target for 351 to 415. Heals for an additional 20% if you have a Rejuvenation, Regrowth, Lifebloom, or Wild Growth effect active on the target.

Name: Rebirth
Description: Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 400 health and 700 mana.

Name: Regrowth
Description: Heals a friendly target for 44 to 51 and another 63 over 21 sec.

Name: Rejuvenation
Description: Heals the target for 25 over 15 sec.

Name: Remove Curse
Description: Dispels 1 Curse from a friendly target.

Name: Revive
Description: Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 65 health and 120 mana.  Cannot be cast when in combat.

Name: Swiftmend
Description: Consumes a Rejuvenation or Regrowth effect on a friendly target to instantly heal them an amount equal to 12 sec. of Rejuvenation or 18 sec. of Regrowth.

Name: Tranquility
Description: Heals all nearby group members for 131 every 2 seconds for 8 sec.  Caster must channel to maintain the spell.

Name: Tree of Life
Description: Shapeshift into the Tree of Life.   While in this form you increase healing received by 6% for all party and raid members.  Does not stack with similar effects.  Tree of Life reduces the mana cost of your healing over time spells by 20%.   While in this form, you can only cast healing spells in addition to Innervate, Barkskin, Nature's Grasp, Thorns spells, and non-offensive spells usable while shapeshifted.  If your Primary Stat is Spirit, shapeshifting into Tree of Life will free you from all movement impairing effects.

Name: Wild Growth
Description: Heals up to 5 friendly party or raid members within 15 yards of the target for 126 over 7 sec. The amount healed is applied quickly at first, and slows down as the Wild Growth reaches its full duration.

Name: Empowered Touch
Description: Your Healing Touch gains an additional 40% and your Nourish and Flourish gain an additional 20% of your bonus healing effects.

Name: Furor
Description: Increases your Arcane and Nature spell damage done by 6%.     Increases your Stamina in Bear and Dire Bear Form by 9%.     Increases your damage in Cat Form by 6%.

Name: Gift of Nature
Description: Increases the amount healed by your spells by 10%.    The healing increase does not stack with Spiritual Healing, Purification or Answered Prayers. Only the highest increase applies.

Name: Gift of the Earthmother
Description: Increases your spell haste by 10%.    Reduces the global cooldown of your Lifebloom spell by 10%.

Name: Improved Barkskin
Description: Grants 60% additional armor contribution from cloth and leather items while in Travel Form or while not shapeshifted.    Increases the damage reduction granted by your Barkskin spell by 10%.    Reduces the chance your Barkskin is dispelled by 70%.

Name: Improved Mark of the Wild
Description: Increases all of total attributes by 2%.    Increases the effects of your Mark of the Wild and Gift of the Wild spells by 40%.

Name: Improved Rejuvenation
Description: Increases the effect of your Rejuvenation spell by 15%.

Name: Improved Tranquility
Description: Reduces threat caused by Tranquility by 100%, and reduces the cooldown by 60%.

Name: Improved Tree of Life
Description: Increases your armor contribution from items while in Tree of Life Form by 80%    Increases your healing spell power by 15% of your spirit while in Tree of Life Form.

Name: Intensity
Description: Allows 25% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting.    Your Enrage ability instantly generate 15 rage and 30% base mana.

Name: Living Seed
Description: Critical heals from your Druid direct Nature spells or Lesser Healing Wave have a 100% chance to plant a Living Seed on the target, storing 30% of the healing done.    Living Seed will bloom when the target is next hit by a direct spell or attack. Lasts 15 sec.

Name: Living Spirit
Description: Increases your total Spirit by 15%.  Capstone Bonus: Your Rejuvenation now heals for an additional 50% on targets below 50% health.

Name: Master Shapeshifter
Description: Grants an effect which lasts while the Druid is within the respective shapeshift form.  Bear Form - Increases physical damage by 4%.  Cat Form - Increases melee critical strike chance by 4%.  Moonkin Form - Increases Arcane and Nature damage by 4%.  Tree of Life Form - Increases healing by 4%.

Name: Natural Perfection
Description: Your critical strike chance with all spells is increased by 3% and critical strikes against you give you the Natural Perfection effect reducing all damage taken by 4%.  Stacks up to 3 times.  Lasts 8 sec.

Name: Natural Shapeshifter
Description: Reduces the mana cost of all shapeshifting by 30%.

Name: Naturalist
Description: Increases Physical damage done by 3%.    Increases critical strike chance of your Healing Touch by 9%.

Name: Nature's Bounty
Description: Increases the critical effect chance of your Regrowth and Nourish spells by 25%.

Name: Nature's Focus
Description: Increases your haste by 2%.    Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting any spells by 70%.

Name: Nature's Rejuvenation
Description: The bonus healing effects of your Nature healing over time spells is increased by 20%.

Name: Omen of Clarity
Description: Damage, healing and auto attacks have a 6% chance of causing you to enter a Clearcasting state.     The Clearcasting state reduces the Mana, Rage or Energy cost of your next damage, healing spell or offensive ability by 100%. This effect has a 2 second cooldown.

Name: Revitalize
Description: Your Rejuvenation, Wild Growth and Efflorescence spells have a 15% chance, and your Healing Touch and Regrowth has a 100% chance to restore 8 Energy, 4 Rage and 1% Mana.  Capstone Bonus: Healing a target to full health with Healing Touch will restore 30% of its mana cost.

Name: Subtlety
Description: Increases your haste by 3%.    Reduces the chance your helpful Druid spells, Moonfire, and Insect Swarm will be dispelled by 30%.    Capstone Bonus: All threat generated is reduced by 30%. This capstone effect does not stack with similar capstone effects.

Name: Tranquil Spirit
Description: Reduces the mana cost of your Healing Touch, Nourish and Tranquility spells by 15%.

Name: 'Stealth'
Description: You turn into a crate, hidden to all but the most observant adventurers, also prevents movement since you have no legs.    This uses crate modifiers. Perfect for board players.

Name: Abomination's Limb
Description: Command your undead pet or summoned ghoul to grip nearby enemy monsters to itself.

Name: Absolute Zero
Description: Unleash Absolute Zero around you, dealing 29 Frost damage every 2 seconds and afflicting enemies with Absolute Zero, reducing their movement speed by 20%. Stacks 5 times and stuns for 3 sec at max stacks.    Scales with Frost Nova modifiers.

Name: Abyssal Ward
Description: This spell belongs to Cultist    Coalesce an Abyssal Ward reducing your damage taken by 50% for 10 sec or 5 attacks. For the duration, each attack received will decrease the value by 10%.    Usable while stunned.

Name: Aether Counter
Description: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 32 Spellstrike damage and immobilizes the target for 5 sec.  This uses Counterattack modifiers. Aether Counter cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.

Name: Aether Mangle
Description: Mangle the target, inflicting Spellstrike damage and causing the target to take 30% additional damage from bleeds for 1 min.   Does not stack with other similar effects.  This ability can be used in Cat Form or Dire Bear Form. This uses Mangle modifiers.

Name: Aether Rake
Description: Rake the target for 7 Spellstrike damage and an additional 65 Spellstrike damage over 9 sec. Awards 1 combo point.    This uses Rake modifiers.

Name: Aether Revenge
Description: Instantly counterattack an enemy for 58 to 70 Spellstrike damage. Arcane Vengeance is only usable after the warrior blocks, dodges or parries an attack.  This uses Revenge modifiers.

Name: Aether Rupture
Description: Finishing move that causes Spellstrike damage over time. Lasts longer per combo point:     1 point  : 40 Spellstrike damage over 8 sec     2 points: 61 Spellstrike damage over 10 sec     3 points: 87 Spellstrike damage over 12 sec     4 points: 117 Spellstrike damage over 14 sec     5 points: 153 Spellstrike damage over 16 sec    This uses Rupture modifiers.

Name: Aether Sever
Description: A vicious strike that deals 65% weapon damage as Spellstrike plus 36 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.  This uses Mortal Strike modifiers. Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Aether Siphon
Description: A deadly attack that deals 50% weapon damage as Spellstrike plus 11 and heals you for 5% of your maximum health for each of your diseases on the target.  This uses Death Strike modifiers.

Name: Aether Smash
Description: Blasts nearby enemies dealing 10 Spellstrike damage and increasing the time between their attacks by 10% for 10 sec. This ability causes additional threat.    This uses Thunder Clap modifiers.

Name: Aether Spree
Description: Step through the shadows from enemy to enemy within 10 yards, attacking an enemy for 85% weapon damage as Spellstrike every 0.5 sec with both weapons until 5 assaults are made. Can hit the same target multiple times. Cannot hit invisible or stealthed targets.  This uses Killing Spree modifiers.

Name: Aether Strike
Description: An instant arcane-infused strike that causes 3 Spellstrike damage in addition to 65% of your normal weapon damage (55% if a two-handed weapon is equipped). Awards 1 combo point.    This uses Sinister Strike modifiers.

Name: Aetherpierce
Description: Pierce the target, causing 100% weapon damage as Spellstrike plus 7 to the target. Must be behind the target. Requires a dagger in the main hand. Awards 1 combo point.  This uses Backstab modifiers.

Name: Aethershred
Description: Shred the target, causing 145% weapon damage plus 15 as Spellstrike damage to the target. Must be behind the target. Awards 1 combo point. Effects which increase bleed damage also increase Aethershred damage.    This uses Shred modifiers.

Name: Aethersinger Shot
Description: You attempt to finish the wounded target off, firing a ranged attack dealing 150% weapon damage plus 48 Spellstrike damage. Aethersinger Shot can only be used on enemies that have 20% or less health.  This uses Kill Shot modifiers.

Name: Air Strike
Description: This spell belongs to Tinker    Mark the target location for an Air Strike. After 7 sec, it deals 221 Fire damage to enemies caught within the blast.    This ability always critically strikes.

Name: Align
Description: Heals your target for 64 and applies Aligned for 8 sec. Aligning Time-bound allies causes additional Temporal Distortion.  Casting Align consumes 5 energy, if Temporal Distortion or Eternity is known.  This uses Moonfire modifiers.

Name: Amphibimorph
Description: This spell belongs to Witch Doctor    Transform enemies at target location into a frog, making them unable to attack or cast spells, and slowing their movement speed by 25% for 40 sec. While transformed into a frog the enemy is considered a Beast.    Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

Name: Ancient Curse
Description: This spell belongs to Cultist    Curse an enemy, dealing 140 Shadow damage and increasing all Shadow damage they take from you by 10% for 10 sec.

Name: Ancient of Lore
Description: This spell belongs to Primalist    Funnel nature's energies into yourself, transforming into an Ancient of Lore for 20 sec.    While active, your stats are increased by 10% and nearby party members have their costs reduced by 30%.    While transformed, your movement speed is reduced by 50%.    Applies |CffffffffAncient Weariness|r to nearby party members, preventing them from benefiting from another Ancient form for 10 min.

Name: Ancient of War
Description: This spell belongs to Primalist    Funnel nature's fury into yourself, transforming into an Ancient of War for 20 sec.    While active, nearby party members have their critical strike chance increased by 20%.    While transformed, your movement speed is reduced by 50%.    Applies |CffffffffAncient Weariness|r to nearby party members, preventing them from benefiting from another Ancient form for 10 min.

Name: Apotheosis
Description: This spell belongs to Bloodmage    Enter a blood trance for 10 sec, healing for 100% of all damage dealt.    While active, you suffer 10% of your maximum health as damage every sec.

Name: Arcane Bullet
Description: An aimed shot that deals 100% weapon damage plus 12 as Spellstrike damage and reduces healing done to that target by 50%. Lasts 10 sec.   Does not stack with other similar effects.  This uses Aimed Shot modifiers.

Name: Arcane Execution
Description: Attempt to finish off a wounded foe, causing 65% of 65 Spellstrike damage and converting each extra point of rage into 65% of 2 additional Spellstrike damage (up to a maximum cost of 30 rage). Only usable on enemies that have less than 20% health.  This uses Execute modifiers.

Name: Arcane Finish
Description: Finishing move that causes Spellstrike damage per combo point:     1 point  : 5-7 Spellstrike damage     2 points: 9-11 Spellstrike damage     3 points: 14-16 Spellstrike damage     4 points: 19-21 Spellstrike damage     5 points: 24-26 Spellstrike damage    This uses Eviscerate modifiers.

Name: Arcane Slam
Description: Slams the opponent with arcane force, causing 65% weapon damage plus 6 Spellstrike damage.    This uses Slam modifiers.

Name: Arcane Slash
Description: A strong attack that increases melee damage by 11 as Spellstrike damage and causes a high amount of threat.    This uses Heroic Strike modifiers.

Name: Arcane Swipe (Bear)
Description: Swipe nearby enemies, inflicting 12 Spellstrike damage plus 1 Spellstrike damage.  This uses Swipe modifiers.

Name: Arcane Swipe (Cat)
Description: Swipe nearby enemies, inflicting 90% weapon damage as Spellstrike.  This uses Swipe modifiers.

Name: Arcanist's Explosion
Description: Causes an explosion of arcane magic around the caster, causing 68 Arcane damage to all targets within 15 yards.    This uses Arcane Explosion modifiers.

Name: Arctis
Description: Unleash frostfire that deals 110 Frostfire damage and an additional 41 Frostfire damage over 12 seconds.    This deals 20% less damage than Pyroblast and uses Pyroblast modifiers.

Name: Arrow of the Goddess
Description: This spell belongs to Starcaller    Fire a star-infused arrow in a line, dealing 250% Ranged Weapon Damage as Arcane to enemies struck.

Name: Arrows of Fire
Description: Your ranged attacks also fire Arrows of Fire and consume 2% of your maximum mana.    Arrows of Fire Deals 4 Fire damage every second for 5 sec. Stacks up to 5.

Name: Arrows of Frost
Description: Your ranged attacks now shoot Arrows of Frost and consume 2% of your maximum mana.    Arrows of Frost Deals 6 Frost damage and slows enemy movement speed by 6%. Stacks up to 5 and lasts 4 sec.

Name: Arterial Bind
Description: This spell belongs to Bloodmage    Place a pool of blood on the ground beneath enemies and allies, healing allies for 100 every 1 sec and silencing all enemies for 4 sec.

Name: Astral Flare
Description: Deals 90 to 110 Spellfire damage to the target.    This uses Starfire modifiers.

Name: Astral Plasma
Description: Deals 147 to 177 Spellfire damage to the target.    This uses Starsurge modifiers.

Name: Astral Reconstitution
Description: This spell belongs to Starcaller    Surround yourself with lunar light, causing 30% of damage taken to be converted into mana. Holds 5 charges. Lasts 20 sec.

Name: Astral Storm
Description: You call down spiritual ancestors, dealing 438 to 500 Spellstorm damage to the target. Castable while moving.    This uses Thunderstorm modifiers.

Name: Atal'ai Totem
Description: Summons an Atal'ai Totem with 5 health at your feet for 1.25 min that repeatedly attacks an enemy within 20 yards, dealing 11 to 14 Nature damage.    This ability is usable while shapeshifted.  This uses Searing Totem modifiers and benefits from the Call of Flame talent.

Name: Backtrack
Description: This spell belongs to Chronomancer    Marks an enemy's location, yanking them back to the location after 3.50 sec.

Name: Battle Charge
Description: Battle charge the enemy, dealing 70% weapon damage and generating 9 rage.    This ability is usable while shapeshifted.    This uses Charge modifiers. Usable in melee range.

Name: Beacon of Shadow
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Dealing damage with Mind Flay or healing another target with Shadow Mend now triggers a 211 heal on your Beacon of Shadow ally.    Only one target can be the Beacon of Shadow at a time. Cannot be cast on self. Lasts 30 min.

Name: Beacon of Virtue
Description: Applies Beacon of Virtue to your target and 4 injured allies within 60 yds for 10 sec.    While active, your Holy heals with a cast time will also heal those affected by your Beacon of Virtue for 25% of the original amount    This has reduced global cooldown.

Name: Beam of Hatred
Description: Deals 36 Shadowflame damage every 0.5 sec over 5 sec.    Casting Soul Fire reduces its cooldown by 2 second.

Name: Big Game Shot
Description: Fires an opening shot dealing 263% weapon damage plus 2. Only usable on enemies above 80% health.    Big Game Shot increases the damage of your next Hunter Trap by 100%.    Scales with Aimed Shot modifiers.

Name: Black Widow Strike
Description: A poisonous strike dealing 34 Physical damage and an additional 6 Plague damage every 3 seconds for 15 sec.     This uses Black Arrow modifiers.

Name: Blades of Flame
Description: Instantly Whirlwind up to 4 nearby targets for 65% weapon damage as Firestrike and for the next 6 sec you will perform a whirlwind attack every 1 sec. While under the effects of Blades of Flame, you can move but cannot perform any other abilities and you cannot be stopped unless disarmed or killed.  This uses Bladestorm modifiers.

Name: Blades of Frost
Description: Instantly Whirlwind up to 4 nearby targets for 65% weapon damage as Froststrike and for the next 6 sec you will perform a whirlwind attack every 1 sec. While under the effects of Blades of Frost, you can move but cannot perform any other abilities and you cannot be stopped unless disarmed or killed.  This uses Bladestorm modifiers.

Name: Blades of Light
Description: Instantly Whirlwind up to 4 nearby targets for 65% weapon damage as Holystrike and for the next 6 sec you will perform a whirlwind attack every 1 sec. While under the effects of Blades of Light, you can move but cannot perform any other abilities and you cannot be stopped unless disarmed or killed.  This uses Bladestorm modifiers.

Name: Blades of Lightning
Description: Instantly Whirlwind up to 4 nearby targets for 65% weapon damage as Stormstrike and for the next 6 sec you will perform a whirlwind attack every 1 sec. While under the effects of Blades of Lightning, you can move but cannot perform any other abilities and you cannot be stopped unless disarmed or killed.  This uses Bladestorm modifiers.

Name: Blades of Magic
Description: Instantly Whirlwind up to 4 nearby targets for 65% weapon damage as Spellstrike and for the next 6 sec you will perform a whirlwind attack every 1 sec. While under the effects of Blades of Magic, you can move but cannot perform any other abilities and you cannot be stopped unless disarmed or killed.  This uses Bladestorm modifiers.

Name: Blades of Shadow
Description: Instantly Whirlwind up to 4 nearby targets for 65% weapon damage as Shadowstrike and for the next 6 sec you will perform a whirlwind attack every 1 sec. While under the effects of Blades of Shadow, you can move but cannot perform any other abilities and you cannot be stopped unless disarmed or killed.  This uses Bladestorm modifiers.

Name: Blazing Barrier
Description: Instantly shields you, absorbing 347 damage and making you immune to pushback. Lasts 20 sec. If the shield breaks, a Blast Nova slows enemies for 3 sec.

Name: Blazing Bloodstrike
Description: Instantly strike the enemy, causing 25% weapon damage as Firestrike plus 8, total damage increased by 12.5% for each of your diseases on the target.  This uses Blood Strike modifiers.

Name: Blazing Finish
Description: Finishing move that causes Firestrike damage per combo point:     1 point  : 5-7 Firestrike damage     2 points: 9-11 Firestrike damage     3 points: 14-16 Firestrike damage     4 points: 19-21 Firestrike damage     5 points: 24-26 Firestrike damage    This uses Eviscerate modifiers.

Name: Blazing Flourish
Description: This spell belongs to Witch Hunter    Perform an advanced flourish every 4 sec for 20 sec, dealing 81 Fire damage to nearby enemies.

Name: Blazing Multi-Shot
Description: Fires several missiles, hitting 3 targets for 65% weapon damage as Firestrike.  This uses Multi-Shot modifiers.

Name: Blazing Shield Slam
Description: Slam the target with your shield, causing 191 to 199 Firestrike damage, modified by your shield block value, and dispels 1 magic effect on the target. Causes a high amount of threat.  This uses Shield Slam modifiers.

Name: Blind Revenge
Description: A finishing move that deals damage to the target and two additional enemies.        1 point  : 11-17 damage     2 points: 19-25 damage     3 points: 27-33 damage     4 points: 36-42 damage     5 points: 44-50 damage    This uses Revenge modifiers.

Name: Blood Arrow
Description: A magical attack that deals 100% ranged weapon damage as Shadow and deals 10 damage every 1 sec and heals you for 10% of the damage for 5 sec.    This uses Drain Life modifiers.

Name: Bloom
Description: Heals all allies within 40 yards affected by your Seed of Life, consuming Seed of Life in the process.

Name: Blooming Shot
Description: Launches a blooming shot that deals 10 Spellstorm damage to enemies, heals 5 allies for 9.    Requires 20 sec seconds to fully bloom another shot after firing, which increases its healing and damage by 400% and reduces its mana cost by 40%. Casting Hunter Shot reduces this time by 4 sec.     This uses Arcane Shot modifiers.

Name: Blurred Blade
Description: Requires  Duelist's Glove  A Duelist's Glove is an off-hand item that enables Swashbuckling. It is granted whenever you learn a talent or ability that requires it. Requires a one-handed weapon and does not work while shapeshifted.    While active, your parries cause an immediate follow-up attack.    Finishing move that increases melee attack speed by 10% and decreases all damage taken by 4%. Lasts longer per combo point:     1 point  : 9 seconds     2 points: 12 seconds     3 points: 15 seconds     4 points: 18 seconds     5 points: 21 seconds    Uses Slice and Dice modifiers.

Name: Boltripper
Description: Finishing move that causes Stormstrike damage over time.  Damage increases per combo point:     1 point  : 16 Stormstrike damage over 12 sec     2 points: 26 Stormstrike damage over 12 sec     3 points: 36 Stormstrike damage over 12 sec     4 points: 46 Stormstrike damage over 12 sec     5 points: 56 Stormstrike damage over 12 sec    This uses Rip modifiers.

Name: Boltsinger Shot
Description: You attempt to finish the wounded target off, firing a ranged attack dealing 150% weapon damage plus 48 Stormstrike damage. Boltsinger Shot can only be used on enemies that have 20% or less health.  This uses Kill Shot modifiers.

Name: Bomb Toss
Description: This spell belongs to Tinker    Lob a bomb at an enemy, dealing 46 Fire damage and reducing their armor by 5% for 15 sec, stacking 4 times.

Name: Bonds of Justice
Description: This spell belongs to Starcaller  Send forth bonds of justice to an enemy, tethering them to you for 8 sec.  If the tether is broken through expiration or the target runs at least 10 yds from you, they are gripped back towards you, taking 33 Arcane damage.

Name: Bone Arrow
Description: Fire a bone arrow that deals 32 Physical damage and causes the target to bleed for 11 damage every 3 seconds with a chance to trigger your Rapid Killing talent. Lasts for 21 sec.    Max 2 charges. 30 second recharge timer. Hunter ranged and melee ability casts have a chance to restore a charge.    Rapid Killing can only trigger this way once every 6 sec.

Name: Bone Spear
Description: Throw a Bone Spear that pierces through armor and resistances, dealing 9 Shadow damage and an additional 10 damage every 3 over 9 seconds.

Name: Bone Toss
Description: Throw a bone that bounces to 2 nearby enemies, dealing 14 Shadow damage. This ability causes high threat.

Name: Boulder Dash
Description: This spell belongs to Primalist    Raise a boulder out of the ground and encase yourself within it, preventing you from attacking or casting spells.  For 10 sec, you roll forward at 70% increased movement speed, dealing 8 Physical damage to enemies you roll over, and you are immune to crowd control effects.

Name: Breath of Neltharion
Description: This spell belongs to Pyromancer    Breathe superheated flames in a cone in front of you, melting the weapons of affected enemies and disarming their melee and ranged weapons for 6 sec.

Name: Breath of Sindragosa
Description: Targets in a cone in front of the caster take 362 Frost damage every second for 5 seconds.    Castable while moving but reduces your movement speed by 70%.

Name: Brilliant Bloodstrike
Description: Instantly strike the enemy, causing 25% weapon damage as Holystrike plus 8, total damage increased by 12.5% for each of your diseases on the target.  This uses Blood Strike modifiers.

Name: Brilliant Slam
Description: Slams the opponent with holy force, causing 65% weapon damage plus 6 Holystrike damage.    This uses Slam modifiers.

Name: Build: Firepot Drone
Description: This spell belongs to Tinker    3 Charges, 10 sec recharge  Build a Firepot Drone that flies towards your target, dropping a bomb along its path and exploding upon landing, dealing 12 Fire damage in a 5 yd radius, leaving oil on the ground for 6 sec that slows enemies within by 30%.

Name: Build: Noise Box
Description: This spell belongs to Tinker    Build a Noise Box for 15 sec that periodically unleashes screeching noise on nearby enemies, interrupting spellcasts and preventing spells of that school from being cast for 3 sec.

Name: Build: Oil-Spill Pylon
Description: This spell belongs to Tinker    Build an Oil-Spill Pylon at target location for 10 sec, spilling oil in an 8 yd radius that reduces enemies movement speed by 60% and increases their Fire damage taken by you by 5%.

Name: Build: Repulsion Unit
Description: This spell belongs to Tinker    Build a Repulsion Unit that periodically knocks back enemies within 6 yds every 5 sec for 20 sec.

Name: Build: Spider Bomb Factory
Description: This spell belongs to Tinker    Build a Spider Bomb Factory in front of you for 20 sec.    For the duration, using damaging spells and abilities will summon 2 Spider Bombs that immediately run towards your target and detonate, dealing Fire damage.    This can not occur more than once every 4 seconds.

Name: Build: Spider Bomb
Description: This spell belongs to Tinker    Build a Spider Bomb that will immediately run towards your target and detonate, dealing 63 Fire damage in an 8 yd radius.

Name: Bulwark
Description: Raise a mighty bulwark for 6 sec, granting 60% block chance and causing you to deal Physical damage to enemies in front of you every second, modified by your shield block value. Movement speed reduced by 25%.  Bulwark's damage scales from Shield Slam modifiers.

Name: Burning Execution
Description: Attempt to finish off a wounded foe, causing 65% of 65 Firestrike damage and converting each extra point of rage into 65% of 2 additional Firestrike damage (up to a maximum cost of 30 rage). Only usable on enemies that have less than 20% health.  This uses Execute modifiers.

Name: Burning Slam
Description: Slams the opponent with fire force, causing 65% weapon damage plus 6 Firestrike damage.    This uses Slam modifiers.

Name: Burst of Thorns
Description: Thorns emerge from your ally's armor for 15 sec, damaging nearby enemies and granting Thornscale when struck.    This ability is usable while shapeshifted.    Thornscale can only occur once every 8 sec, and the damage effect can only occur once every 1 sec.      Thornscale Increases armor by 22 and increases mana regeneration by 2. Lasts 5 sec.

Name: Bushcraft
Description: This spell belongs to Ranger    Gain the ability to craft Crude Leather from the Leather obtained from Skinning, gives you a chance to find it when Skinning beasts, and increases your Skinning speed.    Allows you to craft items that require Crude Leather.

Name: Buy Time
Description: This spell belongs to Chronomancer    Put all enemies and allies in an 8 yd radius in target area into a stasis, banishing them for 6 sec, making them invulnerable to all effects but unable to move.

Name: Call Fungarians
Description: Summons 3 Fungarians to assault enemies for 30 sec, emitting a Cloud of Rot that suffocates nearby enemies.    Cannot be used while having an active pet.    This uses Force of Nature modifiers.    Cloud of Rot Inflicts 11 Nature damage to nearby enemies every 2 sec for 30 sec.

Name: Caltrops
Description: This spell belongs to Witch Hunter    Throw caltrops over a 5 yd area, lasting for 12 sec.    Enemies that walk over the caltrops suffer 14 Physical damage and 50% reduced movement speed for 2 sec.

Name: Carnage Incarnate
Description: Encases you in blood and bones. Healing you for 18 and dealing 18 to 27 damage to nearby enemies every second.    Lasts for 5 sec. Duration is doubled in Bear Form.    Damage is split among targets hit.

Name: Carnage Rend
Description: Wounds the target causing them to bleed for 9 every 3 over 15 sec.    This uses Rend modifiers.

Name: Carrion Swarm
Description: Deals 6 Shadow damage to enemies in a cone in front of you and reduces their healing received by 25% for 10 sec.    This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Cat-a-clysm
Description: Deals 41 Fire damage to 6 enemies within 8 yards, increasing your Fire damage dealt to them by 20% for 10 sec.

Name: Cauterize
Description: This spell belongs to Pyromancer    Cauterize an ally's wound, removing 1 bleed effect from them.

Name: Cauterizing Fire
