Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Hurls a fiery ball that deals 14 to 22 Fire damage and an additional 2 Fire damage over 8 sec to enemies or 21 to 27 Radiant healing and an additional 4 Radiant healing over 8 sec to allies.    This uses Fireball modifiers. Immunity spells prevent this healing, and this effect does not benefit from range-increasing effects.

Name: Cavalry Charge
Description: This spell belongs to Guardian    Increases mounted movement speed of all party and raid members within 40 yds by 50% and makes them immune to movement impairing effects for 10 sec.   Can be used while mounted. Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Champion of the Sun
Description: This spell belongs to Sun Cleric    Become a champion of An'she, causing your melee auto attacks to deal an additional 50% of the damage dealt as Holy damage. Lasts 20 sec.

Name: Champion's Spear
Description: Throw a spear at the target location, dealing 150% weapon damage and rooting enemies hit for 4 sec, then dealing 50% weapon damage every second for 8 sec.

Name: Chaos Rush
Description: This spell belongs to Felsworn    2 Charges, 10 sec recharge  Engulf yourself in fel energy and dash forward in the direction you are running.

Name: Charred Bite
Description: Finishing move that deals Firestrike damage per combo point and converts each extra point of energy (up to a maximum of 30 extra energy) into 0.7 additional damage:      1 point  : 13-16 damage      2 points: 21-24 damage      3 points: 30-33 damage      4 points: 38-41 damage      5 points: 47-50 damage    This uses Ferocious Bite modifiers.

Name: Chosen of Elune
Description: Requires  Eclipse (Rank 1)    Reduces the cooldown of Starsurge and Eclipse Blast by 60% for 15 sec and activates both Lunar Eclipse and Solar Eclipse.     This does not incur any cooldown on the Eclipse effects.

Name: Cinder Rupture
Description: Finishing move that causes Firestrike damage over time. Lasts longer per combo point:     1 point  : 40 Firestrike damage over 8 sec     2 points: 61 Firestrike damage over 10 sec     3 points: 87 Firestrike damage over 12 sec     4 points: 117 Firestrike damage over 14 sec     5 points: 153 Firestrike damage over 16 sec    This uses Rupture modifiers.

Name: Cinder Strike
Description: An instant fire-infused strike that causes 3 Firestrike damage in addition to 65% of your normal weapon damage (55% if a two-handed weapon is equipped). Awards 1 combo point.    This uses Sinister Strike modifiers.

Name: Circle of Fire
Description: This spell belongs to Pyromancer    Creates a circle of fire at the target location for 10 sec, dealing 18 Fire damage and incapacitating all enemies inside for 6 sec.    Entering the circle also damages and disorients enemies.

Name: Circle of Life
Description: Create an empowered Halo, forming a potent ring of Holy energy around you that rapidly expands, healing 10 party and raid members within 30 yards for 141 to 163. Heals with greater effect the closer the target is.     This uses Halo modifiers.

Name: Circle of Valor
Description: This spell belongs to Sun Cleric    Place a 10 yd holy circle at target location for 15 sec. Allies that stand inside of it will divert 30% of all damage taken to the caster, and will be healed for 52 every 1.50 sec.    Damage which reduces the caster below 10% maximum health will break the effect.

Name: Clasp of Infinity
Description: This spell belongs to Chronomancer    Conjure a magical binding upon an enemy that bounces to nearby enemies, rooting them in place for 4 sec.

Name: Cleric's Light
Description: Emits sanctified light in all directions, healing 5 allies within 30 yards for 42.    Does not heal self.

Name: Cold Sever
Description: A vicious strike that deals 65% weapon damage as Froststrike plus 36 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.  This uses Mortal Strike modifiers. Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Compound Shot
Description: Finishing move that reduces healing done to that target by 40% for 6 seconds and deals ranged weapon damage:     1 point  : 115% weapon damage plus 31     2 points: 155% weapon damage plus 35     3 points: 195% weapon damage plus 39     4 points: 235% weapon damage plus 43     5 points: 275% weapon damage plus 47    This ability can be recast within 6 seconds to fire a Combo Shot.      Combo Shot 60 Energy Combo Shot harnesses the damage dealt by your Compound Shot to pierce through enemies causing them to bleed over 15 seconds.  This uses Aimed Shot modifiers.

Name: Conduit
Description: Consume your Lightning Shield to create a charged zone around you, dealing 13 Nature damage every 1 sec. Lasts 2 sec plus one second for every Lightning Shield charge consumed.    This uses Lightning Shield modifiers. Usable in Bear Form. This does not trigger any other effects.

Name: Consecrated Weapon
Description: Imbue your weapon with holy, increasing Holy Spell power by 11 and your attack power by 19 Each auto attack and melee ability causes 5.3 to 16.4 additional Holy damage, based on the speed of the weapon. Slower weapons cause more Holy damage per swing. This effect lasts for 2 hours.

Name: Controlled Blast
Description: A wave of flame radiates outward from the caster, damaging all enemies caught within the blast for 177 to 214 Fire damage and dazing them for 10 sec.    This uses Blast Wave modifiers.

Name: Corrupt Mind
Description: This spell belongs to Cultist    Corrupt the mind of an enemy and spread madness, fearing them in place for 40 sec (8 sec vs players), bouncing to up to 2 nearby enemies and applying Mind Rot to them.    Damage dealt may end this effect.   Mind Rot Increases the chance for spells to hit this target by 3%. If dispelled, the caster gains 30% spell critical strike chance for 5 sec.

Name: Cremation
Description: Consumes Fireball, Pyroblast, Living Bomb, or Searing Brand, dealing seven times the total remaining periodic damage and an additional 35 to 37 Fire damage over 10 seconds.    Can only consume the spells specified above.

Name: Crippling Shot
Description: This spell belongs to Ranger    Fire a crippling shot at an enemy slowing movement speed by 50% and knocking them off their mounts, making them unable to mount again for 5 sec.

Name: Crusade Against all Evil
Description: Force the ground to shatter in holy energy in a line in front of you, dealing 2 Holy damage every 1 sec for 4 sec.    Applies Sunder Armor to all targets hit.      Sunder Armor Sunders the target's armor, reducing it by 4%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts for 30 sec. Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Crusader's Hammer
Description: Slams the ground with a holy hammer, stunning all enemies within 20 yards for 4 sec.  Uses Hammer of Justice modifiers.

Name: Crushing Dissonance
Description: This spell belongs to Cultist    Unleash a wave of maddening resonance, interrupting the current spell cast of all enemies around you and preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 2 sec.

Name: Curse of the Swamp Witch
Description: Deals 117 Plague damage every 2 sec and slows the target's movement speed by 35% for 10 sec.  This uses Curse of Exhaustion modifiers.

Name: Cursed Effigy
Description: This spell belongs to Witch Doctor    Drop a Cursed Effigy near you for 15 sec.    Enemies within 15 yds are unable to critically strike.

Name: Daring Escape
Description: This spell belongs to Witch Hunter    Jump backwards, causing all ranged attacks to miss you for 2 sec.

Name: Dark Domination
Description: Increases the damage of your Demon Pet by 30% and Wild Imps by 15% and causes them to regenerate 100 mana and 100 health every 2 seconds for 15 sec.    This uses Fel Domination modifiers.

Name: Dark Iron Land Mine
Description: Places a Dark Iron Land Mine on the ground. The next hostile creature to pass near the mine causes it to explode. Mines are unstable and only last 30 sec.       Detonation Deals 59 to 66 Fire damage to nearby enemies, and knocks them up.

Name: Dark Tonic
Description: This spell belongs to Witch Hunter    Drink a dark tonic, healing you for 124, scaling with your Stamina, and increasing your maximum health by 15% for 15 sec.    Shares a cooldown with other Tonics.

Name: Dark Transfusion
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Restores 10 energy and awards 1 combo point if an enemy is within 30 yards.    Causes an explosion of holy light, dealing 34 Holy damage to enemies within 10 yards and healing up to 6 allies within 30 yards for 68.    Max 3 charges. 10 second recharge timer.    This uses Holy Nova modifiers.

Name: Dawn Counter
Description: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 32 Holystrike damage and immobilizes the target for 5 sec.  This uses Counterattack modifiers. Dawn Counter cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.

Name: Dawn Mangle
Description: Mangle the target, inflicting Holystrike damage and causing the target to take 30% additional damage from bleeds for 1 min.   Does not stack with other similar effects.  This ability can be used in Cat Form or Dire Bear Form. This uses Mangle modifiers.

Name: Dawn Rake
Description: Rake the target for 7 Holystrike damage and an additional 65 Holystrike damage over 9 sec. Awards 1 combo point.    This uses Rake modifiers.

Name: Dawn Revenge
Description: Instantly counterattack an enemy for 58 to 70 Holystrike damage. Righteous Vengeance is only usable after the warrior blocks, dodges or parries an attack.  This uses Revenge modifiers.

Name: Dawn Rupture
Description: Finishing move that causes Holystrike damage over time. Lasts longer per combo point:     1 point  : 40 Holystrike damage over 8 sec     2 points: 61 Holystrike damage over 10 sec     3 points: 87 Holystrike damage over 12 sec     4 points: 117 Holystrike damage over 14 sec     5 points: 153 Holystrike damage over 16 sec    This uses Rupture modifiers.

Name: Dawn Sever
Description: A vicious strike that deals 65% weapon damage as Holystrike plus 36 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.  This uses Mortal Strike modifiers. Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Dawn Smash
Description: Blasts nearby enemies dealing 10 Holystrike damage and increasing the time between their attacks by 10% for 10 sec. This ability causes additional threat.    This uses Thunder Clap modifiers.

Name: Dawn Spike
Description: An instant strike that deals 65% weapon damage as Holystrike and applies Hemorrhage, increasing Physical damage taken by up to 9. Lasts 10 charges or 15 sec. Awards 1 combo point.  Deals 114% weapon damage as Holystrike if a dagger is equipped and 55% if a two-hander is equipped.  This uses Hemorrhage modifiers.

Name: Dawn Spree
Description: Step through the shadows from enemy to enemy within 10 yards, attacking an enemy for 85% weapon damage as Holystrike every 0.5 sec with both weapons until 5 assaults are made. Can hit the same target multiple times. Cannot hit invisible or stealthed targets.  This uses Killing Spree modifiers.

Name: Dawn Strike
Description: An instant holy-infused strike that causes 3 Holystrike damage in addition to 65% of your normal weapon damage (55% if a two-handed weapon is equipped). Awards 1 combo point.    This uses Sinister Strike modifiers.

Name: Dawnchaser
Description: Instantly strike the enemy, causing 65% weapon damage as Holystrike damage. Only usable after the target dodges. Dawnchaser cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.    This uses Overpower modifiers.

Name: Dawnfang Bite
Description: Finishing move that deals Holy damage per combo point and converts each extra point of energy (up to a maximum of 30 extra energy) into 0.7 additional damage:      1 point  : 13-16 damage      2 points: 21-24 damage      3 points: 30-33 damage      4 points: 38-41 damage      5 points: 47-50 damage    This uses Ferocious Bite modifiers.

Name: Dawning Riposte
Description: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 100% weapon damage as Holystrike and slows their melee attack speed by 20% for 30 sec. Awards 1 combo point.  This uses Riposte modifiers.

Name: Dawnpierce
Description: Pierce the target, causing 100% weapon damage as Holystrike plus 7 to the target. Must be behind the target. Requires a dagger in the main hand. Awards 1 combo point.  This uses Backstab modifiers.

Name: Dawnreaver
Description: An instant holy strike that causes 50% weapon damage as Holystrike damage.    This uses Crusader Strike modifiers.

Name: Dawnripper
Description: Finishing move that causes Holystrike damage over time. Name: Dawnsinger Shot
Description: You attempt to finish the wounded target off, firing a ranged attack dealing 150% weapon damage plus 48 Holystrike damage. Dawnsinger Shot can only be used on enemies that have 20% or less health.  This uses Kill Shot modifiers.

Name: Dawnthirst
Description: Instantly attack the target causing 4 Holystrike damage. Each bleed applied by you increases the damage of Dawnthirst by 8%, up to a maximum of 40%. Name: Death Mark
Description: Instantly awards 5 combo points that are lost if not used or increased after 20 sec.

Name: Death Tap
Description: Sacrifice 10% of your maximum health to convert an available Frost, Unholy, or Blood rune into a Death Rune for 15 seconds.

Name: Death's Advance
Description: Increases movement speed by 35% and grants immunity to root and snare effects for 8 seconds.

Name: Death's Due
Description: This spell belongs to Necromancer    Force a target to accept the reality of death, removing any invulnerability or immunity effects from them and cursing them for 5 sec.    If the target's health is below 20% at the end of the duration, they take 802 Shadowfrost damage.

Name: Deathball
Description: This spell belongs to Tinker    Launch 3 Deathballs in a line, increasing in speed the further they travel.    They explode when they come into contact with an enemy, dealing 487 Fire damage to nearby enemies, increased based on distance traveled.

Name: Deconstruct
Description: Sunders the target's armor, dealing 65% Arcanestrike weapon damage (52% if a two-handed weapon is equipped) plus 4. Grants you Deconstruction for 1 second per stack of Sunder Armor on your target.    This uses Devastate modifiers.    Deconstruction Increases your spell power by 1.

Name: Defiance
Description: This spell belongs to Barbarian    Attempt to defy death, reducing all damage taken by 10% to 40% based on your current missing health for 10 sec.

Name: Demonic Mind
Description: While active, your spell critical strike chance is increased by 5%, but your healing done is reduced by 10%. Dealing direct spell damage now has a chance to reduce the target's healing received by 10%, stacking up to 3 times and lasting for 8 sec.  Cannot be used with bar-changing abilities like Stances or Forms.  Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Destabilize Time
Description: This spell belongs to Chronomancer    Reduces enemy casting speed by 10% for 20 sec, increasing by 10% every time they cast.    Gaining stacks does not extend the duration of the spell.

Name: Desynchronization
Description: This spell belongs to Chronomancer    Shift an enemy out of sync with the present, causing their grip to fail, disarming their melee and ranged weapons for 6 sec.    Upon removal, they are resynced, preventing them from regenerating their health for 6 sec.

Name: Devil's Ignition
Description: Deals 73 Fire damage to the target. Awards 2 combo points, and lowers the cooldown of Cat-a-Clysm by 3 sec.    This uses Incinerate modifiers.

Name: Devour Mind
Description: Afflicts a target with a disease that deals 61 Shadow damage every 2 sec and heals you for 15% of the damage done for 5 seconds.    Continuing to channel increases Devour Mind's duration by 2 every 0.50 sec.    This uses Devouring Plague modifiers.

Name: Dimensional Divergence
Description: This spell belongs to Chronomancer    Swap places with a target player.    If they're an enemy, you steal 80% of their movement speed for 3 sec.

Name: Disease Cloud
Description: A cloud of disease surrounds the bearer, dealing 19 Plague damage to enemies within 3 yards every 2 seconds for 12 sec.

Name: Disembowel
