Name: Storm Breaker
Description: Sunder the target's armor causing the Sunder Armor effect. In addition, causes 78% weapon damage (62% if a two-handed weapon is equipped) plus 3 as Stormstrike damage for each application of Sunder Armor on the target. The Sunder Armor effect can stack up to 5 times.    Sunder Armor Sunders the target's armor, reducing it by 4%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts for 30 sec. Does not stack with other similar effects.    This uses Devastate modifiers.

Name: Storm Counter
Description: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 32 Stormstrike damage and immobilizes the target for 5 sec.  This uses Counterattack modifiers. Storm Counter cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.

Name: Storm Mangle
Description: Mangle the target, inflicting Stormstrike damage and causing the target to take 30% additional damage from bleeds for 1 min.   Does not stack with other similar effects.  This ability can be used in Cat Form or Dire Bear Form. This uses Mangle modifiers.

Name: Storm Maul
Description: A strong attack that increases melee damage by 18 as Stormstrike damage and causes a high amount of threat. Effects which increase bleed effects also increase Maul damage.    This uses Maul modifiers.

Name: Storm Multi-Shot
Description: Fires several missiles, hitting 3 targets for 65% weapon damage as Stormstrike.  This uses Multi-Shot modifiers.

Name: Storm Rake
Description: Rake the target for 7 Stormstrike damage and an additional 65 Stormstrike damage over 9 sec. Awards 1 combo point.    This uses Rake modifiers.

Name: Storm Revenge
Description: Instantly counterattack an enemy for 58 to 70 Stormstrike damage. Storming Vengeance is only usable after the warrior blocks, dodges or parries an attack.  This uses Revenge modifiers.

Name: Storm Sever
Description: A vicious strike that deals 65% weapon damage as Stormstrike plus 36 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.  This uses Mortal Strike modifiers. Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Storm Siphon
Description: A deadly attack that deals 50% weapon damage as Stormstrike plus 11 and heals you for 5% of your maximum health for each of your diseases on the target.  This uses Death Strike modifiers.

Name: Storm Slam
Description: Slams the opponent, causing 65% weapon damage plus 6 Stormstrike damage.    This uses Slam modifiers.

Name: Storm Smash
Description: Smash the ground dealing 17 Physical damage to nearby enemies and increasing the time between attacks by 10% for 10 sec. This ability causes additional threat.

Name: Storm Spree
Description: Step through the shadows from enemy to enemy within 10 yards, attacking an enemy for 85% weapon damage as Stormstrike every 0.5 sec with both weapons until 5 assaults are made. Can hit the same target multiple times. Cannot hit invisible or stealthed targets.  This uses Killing Spree modifiers.

Name: Storm Swipe (Bear)
Description: Swipe nearby enemies, inflicting 12 Stormstrike damage plus 1 Stormstrike damage.  This uses Swipe modifiers.

Name: Storm Swipe (Cat)
Description: Swipe nearby enemies, inflicting 90% weapon damage as Stormstrike.  This uses Swipe modifiers.

Name: Storm Talon
Description: A strong attack that increases melee damage by 5 as Stormstrike damage.    This uses Raptor Strike modifiers.

Name: Stormbound Cleave
Description: A sweeping attack that does your weapon damage plus 9 as Stormstrike damage to the target and his nearest ally.    This uses Cleave modifiers.

Name: Stormbound Shot
Description: An aimed shot that deals 100% weapon damage plus 12 as Stormstrike damage and reduces healing done to that target by 50%. Lasts 10 sec.   Does not stack with other similar effects.  This uses Aimed Shot modifiers.

Name: Stormchaser
Description: Instantly strike the enemy, causing 65% weapon damage as Stormstrike damage. Only usable after the target dodges. Stormchaser cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.    This uses Overpower modifiers.

Name: Stormcloak
Description: This spell belongs to Stormbringer    Cover yourself in a barrier of volatile energy for 15 sec, causing all attacks against you to have a 25% chance to deal half damage.    Stormcloak has a 60% chance to resist dispel effects.

Name: Stormhammer
Description: Throw a Lightning infused hammer at the target, dealing 162 Nature damage. Causes a high amount of threat.    This uses Concussion Blow modifiers.

Name: Storming Execution
Description: Attempt to finish off a wounded foe, causing 65% of 65 Stormstrike damage and converting each extra point of rage into 65% of 2 additional Stormstrike damage (up to a maximum cost of 30 rage). Only usable on enemies that have less than 20% health.  This uses Execute modifiers.

Name: Stormpierce
Description: Pierce the target, causing 100% weapon damage as Stormstrike plus 7 to the target. Must be behind the target. Requires a dagger in the main hand. Awards 1 combo point.  This uses Backstab modifiers.

Name: Stormreaver
Description: An instant storm strike that causes 50% weapon damage as Stormstrike damage.    This uses Crusader Strike modifiers.

Name: Stormshred
Description: Shred the target, causing 145% weapon damage plus 15 as Stormstrike damage to the target. Must be behind the target. Awards 1 combo point. Effects which increase bleed damage also increase Stormshred damage.    This uses Shred modifiers.

Name: Stormthirst
Description: Instantly attack the target causing 4 Stormstrike damage. Each bleed applied by you increases the damage of Stormthirst by 8%, up to a maximum of 40%. In addition, the next 3 successful melee attacks will restore 1% of max health. This effect lasts 8 sec.  This uses Bloodthirst modifiers.

Name: Summon Void Zone
Description: Summons a Void Zone at the target location, dealing 55 Shadow damage. Enemies within 4 yards take 25 to 29 damage every 2 sec and take 5% increased Shadow damage for 10 sec.

Name: Sun Down
Description: This spell belongs to Sun Cleric    Bring the wrath of the sun down upon an enemy after 2 sec, dealing 352 Holyflame Damage and scorching the earth beneath them for 9 sec.    While inside, enemies are struck by a Solar Flare every 3 sec.  Solar Flare Deals 40 Holyflame Damage and reduces the target's chance to hit by 3% for 10 sec.

Name: Sun Gate
Description: This spell belongs to Sun Cleric    Shift 25 yds forward at light speed, removing all root effects.    This leaves behind a Sun Gate for 15 sec that allies can interact with to blink themselves the same distance forward. Allies can only use |CffffffffSun Gate|r every 1.50 min.

Name: Sunburst
Description: Deals 84 Nature damage to the target and 4 enemies within 5 yards.    This uses Starsurge modifiers.

Name: Sunder Soul
Description: Sunders the target's soul, dealing 65% Shadowstrike weapon damage (52% if a two-handed weapon is equipped) plus 3 and increases your spell critical strike chance against the target by 3%. Stacks 5 times and lasts for 15 sec.    This uses Devastate modifiers.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Sunfire
Description: Burns your target and 4 additional targets within 8 yards, dealing 9 to 12 Firestorm damage and 30 additional damage over 15 sec.

Name: Sunwell
Description: This spell belongs to Sun Cleric    Become an embodiment of the sun for 30 sec, periodically dispelling fear, sleep, and charm effects every 3 sec from allies within 40 yds.

Name: Surging Tonic
Description: This spell belongs to Witch Hunter    Drink a bitter tonic, increasing your haste by 15% and reducing the cost of all abilities by 20% for 15 sec.    Shares a cooldown with other Tonics.

Name: Survival Potion
Description: This spell belongs to Ranger    Drink a survival potion, immediately dispelling all poison and disease effects. Every 3 sec for 9 sec, heal for 10% of your maximum health and remove one additional poison and disease effect.

Name: Synchronize
Description: Heals all nearby Aligned or Time-bound allies every second for 4 seconds. While channeling, time is stalled, freezing the duration of your active Aligned buffs.    Max 2 charges. 6 second recharge timer.    Casting Synchronize consumes 70 energy, if Temporal Distortion or Eternity is known.    This uses Arcane Missiles modifiers.

Name: Syndicate Sniper Shot
Description: Fire a shot from Stealth, dealing 205% weapon damage plus 11. Awards 2 combo points.

Name: Tectonic Shockwave
Description: Unleashes a wave of force in front of you, dealing 144 Physical damage and granting you Tectonic Echo for each enemy hit causing your next Earth Shock to hit 1 additional target. Stacks up to 6 times and lasts 20 sec.

Name: Tempest Shield Slam
Description: Slam the target with your shield, causing 191 to 199 Stormstrike damage, modified by your shield block value, and dispels 1 magic effect on the target. Causes a high amount of threat.  This uses Shield Slam modifiers.

Name: Tempest Smash
Description: Blasts nearby enemies dealing 10 Stormstrike damage and increasing the time between their attacks by 10% for 10 sec. This ability causes additional threat.    This uses Thunder Clap modifiers.

Name: Templar's Slash
Description: Launch a powerful swing, dealing 150% weapon damage to up to 6 enemies in a cone in front of you.    Max 3 charges, 8 seconds recharge timer.

Name: Temporal Blast
Description: Blasts your target with energy, dealing 143 Arcane damage.    If canceled early, your next Temporal Blast is reduced by the time spent casting.    Casting this increases all Arcane damage by 15% and its mana cost by 150%. Stacks up to 4 times and lasts 6 sec. Removed if you cast another Arcane ability that deals damage.    This uses Arcane Blast modifiers.

Name: Temporal Rift
Description: Create a temporal rift that explodes after 4 seconds, dealing 43 to 50 Arcane damage to enemies within 10 yards.     Max 3 charges. 10 seconds recharge timer.    This uses Arcane Explosion modifiers.

Name: Temporal Shield
Description: Envelops you in a temporal shield for 4 sec. If the shield lasts its full duration, 75% of the damage taken is instantly restored.

Name: Testament of Fortitude
Description: This spell belongs to Templar    Meditate for 15 sec, restoring 5% of your base health every 1 sec and reducing damage taken by 20%.    Each second you will also remove 1 disease effect from yourself.

Name: The Eye of the Storm
Description: This spell belongs to Stormbringer    Mark an enemy for 4 sec. Every 1 sec, enemies near them take 21 Nature damage.    At the end of the duration, enemies near them also take 70 Nature damage and are rooted for 4 sec.

Name: Thief of Fate
Description: Steals a beneficial magic effect from the target. Stolen effects last a maximum of 2 min.    Does not break stealth.    This uses Pick Pocket modifiers.

Name: Thrash (Bear)
Description: Deals 9 damage, and causes all targets within 8 yards to bleed for 2 damage over 10 sec sec, this bleed can stack up to 5 times.    This ability scales with modifiers to Swipe (Bear).

Name: Throw Weapon
Description: Throws your weapon, inflicting 100% weapon damage and stunning the target for 1 second. Disarms you for 2 sec.

Name: Thrust
Description: An instant strike that causes 3 damage in addition to 75% of your normal weapon damage. Awards 1 combo point and ignores 20% of the armor.    This uses Sinister Strike modifiers.

Name: Thunder Hide
Description: The caster's fur becomes electrically charged, reducing damage taken from creatures by 5%.    When hit by a spell, melee, or ranged attack, the attacker is struck for 13 Nature damage. This consumes a charge of Thunder Hide and lasts 10 min.    This uses Lightning Shield modifiers. This effect can only occur once every 3 sec.

Name: Thunder Slam
Description: Slams up to 5 nearby opponents, causing 30% Nature weapon damage plus 17 Nature damage within a 10-yard frontal cone.     This uses Slam modifiers.

Name: Thundering Bloodstrike
Description: Instantly strike the enemy, causing 25% weapon damage as Stormstrike plus 8, total damage increased by 12.5% for each of your diseases on the target.  This uses Blood Strike modifiers.

Name: Thundering Riposte
Description: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 100% weapon damage as Stormstrike and slows their melee attack speed by 20% for 30 sec. Awards 1 combo point.  This uses Riposte modifiers.

Name: Thunderlizard Bite
Description: Attack the enemy for 11 Stormstrike damage.    This uses Mongoose Bite modifiers.

Name: Thunderwave
Description: Sends a wave of force in front of the caster, causing 4 Stormstrike damage (based on attack power) and stunning all enemy targets in a frontal cone for 4 sec.  This uses Shockwave modifiers.

Name: Time Bomb
Description: Applies a Time Bomb to the enemy that stores 50% of your Arcane damage dealt against the target and detonates it after 10 sec.    Dealing damage with Arcane Barrage decreases the cooldown by 8 seconds.

Name: Time Out!
Description: This spell belongs to Chronomancer    Enter a stasis for 6 sec, instantly restoring 15% of your maximum mana and regenerating 5% of your maximum mana every 0.50 sec.  While active, your damage taken is reduced by 50% but any direct damage taken may end the effect.

Name: Time Warp
Description: Returns you to your active Temporal Anomaly.    While you know this spell casting Blink leaves behind a Temporal Anomaly.

Name: Time-bind
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Creates a bond with Eternity with your ally. After 6 sec, it applies a periodic heal, restoring 30% of the damage taken during the bond. This effect is increased by healing power.    Casting Time-bind consumes 30 energy, if Temporal Distortion or Eternity is known.    Duration cannot be extended.    Only one target can be affected by Time-bind at a time.    This uses Renew modifiers.

Name: Timeguard
Description: This spell belongs to Chronomancer    Place a magical guard on an ally for 2 min, causing the next 3 instances of direct damage that would reduce the target below 35% health to deal 40% less damage.

Name: Titanic Mutilate
Description: Instantly attacks with both weapons for 70% weapon damage. Damage is increased by 20% against bleeding targets. Awards 2 combo points.    This uses Mutilate modifiers.

Name: Titanic Strike
Description: Strike with both weapons, dealing weapon damage per combo point.     1 point  : 90% combined weapon damage     2 points: 120% combined weapon damage     3 points: 150% combined weapon damage     4 points: 180% combined weapon damage     5 points: 210% combined weapon damage

Name: Touch of Elune
Description: Place the Touch of Elune on an enemy. For the next 10 sec, casting Wrath, Starfire and Starsurge spells to other targets also triggers them on the target marked by your Touch of Elune.    Increases the damage and critical strike chance of Wrath, Starfire and Starsurge by 15%.

Name: Tracer Augmentation
Description: This spell belongs to Tinker    Add a Tracer Augmentation to your gun for 1 hour, causing your ranged auto attacks to deal an additional 5% weapon damage as Fire damage.

Name: Tranquil Circle
Description: This spell belongs to Templar    Place a holy circle on the ground at the target location for 4 sec, slowing enemy movement speed within by 70%.    Every 2 sec, enemies within the radius enter a tranquil state, falling asleep for 40 sec.

Name: Trap Launcher: Explosive Trap
Description: Launches your Explosive Trap at the target location.

Name: Trap Launcher: Immolation Trap
Description: Launches your Immolation Trap at the target location.

Name: Tree of Wrath
Description: Grants the ability to shapeshift into the Tree of Wrath, freeing you from all movement impairing effects.    While active, you increase your party and raid's healing received by 6%.    In this form, you can only cast healing spells, Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning, and their chance to hit is increased by 100%.    Tree of Wrath reduces the mana cost of your Druid healing over time spells by 20%.

Name: Twilight Shieldtoss
Description: This spell belongs to Cultist    Hurl a cursed shield, dealing 72 Shadow damage to up to 3 enemies, reduced by 20% with each jump.

Name: Twilight Shock
Description: Instantly blasts the target for 132 Twilight damage and causes the target to take 9 damage every 2 seconds for 6 sec.    This uses Shadowburn modifiers.

Name: Twisted Mind
Description: Your mind becomes twisted, increasing your spell power by 1 and your hit chance by 3%, but reduces your healing and absorbs by 5%.    This cannot be used together with other bar-changing abilities such as Stances or Forms.

Name: Twisted Seal
Description: This spell belongs to Cultist    Create a warped sigil that bends hostile force away from you, deflecting all spells for 5 sec, but making you unable to attack or cast spells.    Casters whose magic is deflected are silenced for 3 sec.

Name: Tyr's Deliverance
Description: Releases the Light within yourself, healing 10 injured allies for 401 within 40 yards. Afterward, heals 3 allies for 161 every 1 sec for 15 sec.

Name: Umbral Shield Slam
Description: Slam the target with your shield, causing 191 to 199 Shadowstrike damage, modified by your shield block value, and dispels 1 magic effect on the target. Causes a high amount of threat.  This uses Shield Slam modifiers.

Name: Umbral Smash
Description: Blasts nearby enemies dealing 10 Shadowstrike damage and increasing the time between their attacks by 10% for 10 sec. This ability causes additional threat.    This uses Thunder Clap modifiers.

Name: Unchained Blink
Description: Teleports the caster 20 yards forward.    This ability can be used while casting, but not channeling, and does not trigger a global cooldown.    This uses Blink modifiers.

Name: Unrelenting Wrath
Description: Send your Tamed Pet into a rage for 8 sec causing 30% additional damage, reducing its threat generated by 15%, and resetting the cooldown of your Frenzy Shot.    Max 2 charges. 2 minute recharge timer. Bestial Assault rapidly restores charges.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.    Will trigger a lesser version of Beast Within if any rank is known, you are not immune to crowd control effects during this.

Name: Unstable Chronoglass
Description: This spell belongs to Chronomancer    Place an Unstable Chronoglass at target location for 30 sec that will redirect the next 3 enemy spell casts onto itself.

Name: Unstable Evocation
Description: While channeling, you are immune to interrupts, silences and stuns, and you gain 32% of your total mana over 4 sec. After completing Unstable Evocation, nearby enemies are blasted with 56 Arcane damage and knocked back.    This scales with Evocation modifiers.

Name: Upheaval
Description: You stomp the ground, causing a stone spike to erupt beneath your target, dealing 125% off-hand Weapon damage. Deals 100% increased damage if your off-hand weapon is imbued with Rockbiter Weapon.    This uses Lava Lash modifiers.

Name: Valkyr's Calling
Description: This spell belongs to Sun Cleric    Target an enemy and leap into the air, becoming immune to all physical attacks and spells for 2 sec.    At the end of the duration, you charge back down, dealing 127 Holy damage to all enemies within 8 yds.

Name: Vampiric Bite
Description: Deals 66 Shadow damage every 3 seconds and increases your chance to critically strike the target by 3%. Lasts 15 sec.    This uses Vampiric Touch modifiers. This periodic damage can critically strike.

Name: Vampiric Tonic
Description: This spell belongs to Witch Hunter    Drink a vampiric tonic, causing Physical damage dealt to heal you for 10% of the damage dealt for 15 sec. This healing cannot exceed 10% of your maximum health per heal.    Shares a cooldown with other Tonics.

Name: Veil of Shadows
Description: Veil the target with sinister shadow magic, dealing 37 Shadow damage every 2 seconds for 20 sec.    Reduces all magical resistances by 45 and increases magic damage taken by 6% and applies Corrupting Shadows.    Does not stack with other similar effects. This uses Curse of the Elements modifiers.    Corrupting Shadows Reduces healing received by 30% for 8 sec.

Name: Veilwalk
Description: This spell belongs to Reaper    2 Charges, 60 sec recharge  Move with spectral agility, gaining 50% increased movement speed for 5 sec.    Removes all movement impairing effects. Usable while stealthed.

Name: Venom Belch
Description: Spawns a pool of vile poison at the target location that inflicts 3 Nature damage to nearby enemies every 1 second for 10 sec.    This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Venomous Fury
Description: Finishing move that deals Stormstrike damage per combo point and converts each extra point of energy (up to a maximum of 30 extra energy) into 0.7 additional damage:      1 point  : 13-16 damage      2 points: 21-24 damage      3 points: 30-33 damage      4 points: 38-41 damage      5 points: 47-50 damage    This uses Ferocious Bite modifiers.

Name: Viper's Bite
Description: This spell belongs to Ranger    Unleash 4 quick strikes over 1 sec. Each strike deals 40% weapon damage and generates 1 combo point.    Against a bleeding target, each strike also deals 10% Physical weapon damage. Against a poisoned target, each strike also deals 10% Nature weapon damage.    Requires a one-handed weapon. Usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Voice of Bwonsamdi
Description: This spell belongs to Witch Doctor    Let the spirit of Bwonsamdi possess you for 15 sec.    Dealing periodic damage unleashes a trapped voodoo spirit at enemies, exploding for 0 Shadow damage.

Name: Void Lash
Description: You charge your off-hand weapon with elemental force, instantly dealing 100% off-hand Weapon damage as Shadowstrike damage.     Damage is increased by 25% if your off-hand weapon is enchanted with Windfury.    This uses Lava Lash modifiers.

Name: Void Multi-Shot
Description: Fires several missiles, hitting 3 targets for 65% weapon damage as Shadowstrike.  This uses Multi-Shot modifiers.

Name: Void Spree
Description: Step through the shadows from enemy to enemy within 10 yards, attacking an enemy for 85% weapon damage as Shadowstrike every 0.5 sec with both weapons until 5 assaults are made. Can hit the same target multiple times. Cannot hit invisible or stealthed targets.  This uses Killing Spree modifiers.

Name: Void Strike
Description: An instant shadow-infused strike that causes 3 Shadowstrike damage in addition to 65% of your normal weapon damage (55% if a two-handed weapon is equipped). Awards 1 combo point.    This uses Sinister Strike modifiers.

Name: Voidborne
Description: This spell belongs to Cultist    Tap into your inner voidborne rage, increasing your damage dealt and critical strike chance by 25%, and granting you immunity to stun effects for 10 sec.

Name: Voidbound Cleave
Description: A sweeping attack that does your weapon damage plus 9 as Shadowstrike damage to the target and his nearest ally.    This uses Cleave modifiers.

Name: Voidbound Shot
Description: An aimed shot that deals 100% weapon damage plus 12 as Shadowstrike damage and reduces healing done to that target by 50%. Lasts 10 sec.   Does not stack with other similar effects.  This uses Aimed Shot modifiers.

Name: Voidchaser
Description: Instantly strike the enemy, causing 65% weapon damage as Shadowstrike damage. Only usable after the target dodges. Voidchaser cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.    This uses Overpower modifiers.

Name: Voidwave
Description: Sends a wave of force in front of the caster, causing 4 Shadowstrike damage (based on attack power) and stunning all enemy targets in a frontal cone for 4 sec.  This uses Shockwave modifiers.

Name: Volcanic Shell
Description: This spell belongs to Pyromancer    Conjure a shield of magma and fire around you, absorbing 500 damage. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Volt Spike
Description: An instant strike that deals 65% weapon damage as Stormstrike and applies Hemorrhage, increasing Physical damage taken by up to 9. Lasts 10 charges or 15 sec. Awards 1 combo point.  Deals 114% weapon damage as Stormstrike if a dagger is equipped and 55% if a two-hander is equipped.  This uses Hemorrhage modifiers.

Name: Volt Strike
Description: An instant storm-infused strike that causes 3 Stormstrike damage in addition to 65% of your normal weapon damage (55% if a two-handed weapon is equipped). Awards 1 combo point.    This uses Sinister Strike modifiers.

Name: Voltaic Bite
Description: Instantly bite the target for 150% weapon damage as Nature.    This uses Stormstrike modifiers.

Name: War Golem
Description: This spell belongs to Witch Doctor    Summon a War Golem for 10 sec, absorbing damage dealt to you and redirecting harmful spells cast on nearby allies to itself.    The golem is passive and has no offensive abilities.

Name: Warbreaker
Description: Stomp the ground, dealing 90% armor piercing weapon damage to nearby enemies and causing your attacks to pierce 30% of their armor for 10 sec.    This uses Colossus Smash modifiers.

Name: Warcry
Description: Increases your melee and ranged critical strike chance by 15% for 15 sec.

Name: Warding Rune
Description: This spell belongs to Runemaster    Engrave anti-magic runes around you, removing all harmful magic effects and causing harmful magic effects to have no duration when cast on you for 6 sec.

Name: Water Ascendance
Description: Transform into a being of raw elemental power for 15 sec, applying Riptide (if known) to 4 nearby allies.     While active, your Chain Heal is infused with healing waters and now jumps to twice as many allies.     You can cast Shaman Nature healing spells while moving but your movement speed is reduced by 40%.

Name: Water Nova
Description: Deals 15 Frost damage to all enemies in the area.    This uses Frost Nova modifiers.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Wave of Despair
Description: Unleash a shadowy onslaught, dealing 632 Shadow damage to 8 enemies.    This uses Seed of Corruption modifiers.

Name: Waves of Time
Description: This spell belongs to Chronomancer    Blast enemies in a frontal cone with time fractals, knocking them back slightly.    The knockback repeats 1 additional time after 2 sec.

Name: Weighted Reinforcement
Description: This spell belongs to Guardian    Reinforce your shield with heavy alloys, increasing your attack power by 5%, but reducing your haste by 5%. Lasts 1 hr.

Name: Wendigo Bite
Description: Attack the enemy for 11 Froststrike damage.    This uses Mongoose Bite modifiers.

Name: Whirling Aether
Description: In a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing 65% weapon damage as Spellstrike damage from both melee weapons to each enemy.    This uses Whirlwind modifiers.

Name: Whirling Flames
Description: In a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing 65% weapon damage as Firestrike damage from both melee weapons to each enemy.    This uses Whirlwind modifiers.

Name: Whirling Ice
Description: In a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing 65% weapon damage as Froststrike damage from both melee weapons to each enemy.    This uses Whirlwind modifiers.

Name: Whirling Light
Description: In a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing 65% weapon damage as Holystrike damage from both melee weapons to each enemy.    This uses Whirlwind modifiers.

Name: Whirling Shadows
Description: In a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing 65% weapon damage as Shadowstrike damage from both melee weapons to each enemy.    This uses Whirlwind modifiers.

Name: Whirling Storm
Description: In a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing 65% weapon damage as Stormstrike damage from both melee weapons to each enemy.    This uses Whirlwind modifiers.

Name: Wind Gate
Description: This spell belongs to Stormbringer    Place a Wind Gate at target location for 1 min.     You may cast Wind Gate: Evacuate on an ally to pull them to your Wind Gate.

Name: Winds of Winter
Description: Finishing move that deals Frost damage per combo point to enemies in a cone in front of the caster:     1 point  : 36-57 damage     2 points: 70-91 damage     3 points: 104-125 damage     4 points: 138-159 damage     5 points: 173-194 damage    This uses Cone of Cold modifiers.

Name: Winterfall Firebreath
Description: Targets in a cone in front of the caster take 80 to 88 Fire damage and an additional 6 Fire damage every 2 seconds for 6 sec. Enemies hit are slowed by 30%.     This uses Cone of Cold modifiers.  This ability can be used while shapeshifted.

Name: Witchblood Tonic
Description: This spell belongs to Witch Hunter    Drink a shadowy tonic, removing all curse effects from you and reducing all Magic damage taken by 40% for 10 sec.    Shares a cooldown with other Tonics.

Name: Worgen Form
Description: Transform into a Worgen, increasing melee attack power by 1 plus 25% of Agility, allowing the use of Cat Form and Shadow Priest abilities.     Grants Shadow Word: Pain, Devouring Plague, and Vampiric Touch the ability to benefit from haste.    Direct Shadow damage reduces the cooldown of Goldrinn's Fury by 2 seconds.

Name: Worthy Sacrifice
Description: This spell belongs to Bloodmage    Instantly generate 50 Rage.

Name: Wraith
Description: Finishing move that haunts your target, dealing damage and increasing the damage of your Physical damage-over-time effects against it.   When Wraith ends or is dispelled, it heals you for 100% of the direct damage done.    1 point : 111 Physical damage; 2% increase for 12 sec    2 points: 191 Physical damage; 4% increase for 12 sec    3 points: 270 Physical damage; 6% increase for 12 sec    4 points: 350 Physical damage; 8% increase for 12 sec    5 points: 430 Physical damage; 10% increase for 12 sec    This uses Haunt modifiers.

Name: Wyrm Bite
Description: Attack the enemy for 11 Spellstrike damage.    This uses Mongoose Bite modifiers.

Name: Xorothian Sigil
Description: This spell belongs to Knight of Xoroth    Create a demonic sigil that protects party members within 20 yds of you, causing them to deflect the next harmful spell cast against them within 3 sec.

Name: Zandalari Glaive
Description: Hurl two glaives toward the target, each dealing 120% melee weapon damage.    This uses Glaive Toss modifiers and shares a cooldown with Glaive Toss.

Name: Zulian Guardian
Description: Summons two prowling Zulian Guardians for 20 sec.    This ability is usable while shapeshifted.    This uses Feral Spirits modifiers.

Name: A Quick Death
Description: Using Execute or Kill Shot now grants you A Quick Death.    A Quick Death Melee and ranged haste increased by 3%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 15 sec.

Name: Abjurer's Ward: Arcane
Description: Absorbing damage with a Ward spell now reduces the cooldown of Presence of Mind by 10 seconds.

Name: Abjurer's Ward: Fire
Description: Absorbing damage with a Ward spell now reduces the cooldown of your Combustion by 10 seconds.

Name: Abjurer's Ward: Frost
Description: Absorbing damage with a Ward spell now reduces the cooldown of Cold Snap by 10 seconds.

Name: Absolute Hellfire
Description: Dealing damage with Flamestrike and Meteor marks the target for 3 sec.    Each tick of Rain of Fire triggers additional 1 Fire damage on the marked targets.    This uses Rain of Fire modifiers

Name: Accelerated Ascension
Description: Reduces the cooldown of Holy Fire by 3 seconds and increases its damage over time by 50%.

Name: Adrenaline Junkie
Description: Your finishing moves have a 4% chance per combo point to reduce the cooldown of Adrenaline Rush by 6 seconds.

Name: Adumbral Companion
Description: Your Tamed Pet's auto attacks now deal Shadow damage.    Your Tamed Pet's auto attacks can only be transformed to one damage type at once.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.

Name: Aegis Overdrive
Description: Requires Mana-Forged Barrier.    Activating Mana Shield triggers Aegis Explosion. When Mana Shield expires or is fully depleted by damage, it triggers Aegis Explosion again.    Dodging, blocking or parrying an attack has a 20% chance to trigger Aegis Explosion while Mana Shield is active, this can only occur once every 5 seconds.    The activation explosion can not occur more than once every 4 sec.

Name: Aegis
Description: Each time a melee attack strikes you, you have a chance to gain 6 armor for 10 sec.

Name: Afflicted Soul
Description: Dealing damage with Drain Soul now applies Afflicted Soul, and consumes 12 stacks to apply Ruptured Soul.      Ruptured Soul You deal 25% increased periodic Shadow damage against the target. Lasts 30 sec.

Name: Against All Odds
Description: Killing an enemy that yields experience or honor while below 20% health instantly heals you for 10% of your health.    This effect can only occur once every 10 sec.

Name: Agile Coordination
Description: Your finishing moves have a 5% chance per combo point to grant your Tamed Pet Agile Coordination.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin or Tether Elemental, and Tame Beast.    Agile Coordination Increases your Tamed Pet's attack power by 15% of your Agility for 8 sec.

Name: Agonizing Coil
Description: Death Coil deals 200% increased damage.    Drain Life or Drain Soul damage over time has an 25% chance to reduce the cooldown of Death Coil by 8 seconds.    Death Coil deals 25% increased damage against players.

Name: Alembic
Description: Being hit by a melee or ranged attack now has a 5% chance to grant you 20% of your base mana.    This effect can only occur once every 10 sec.

Name: Aligned with Time
Description: Time-Bind now increases the healing your ally receives from your Align by 15%.

Name: All that is Right
Description: When Seal of Righteousness deals damage you gain a stack of All that is Right.      All that is Right Increases the damage of your Seal of Righteousness by 7% and Seal of Vengeance by 10%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 12 sec.  At max stacks, the duration cannot be refreshed.

Name: Ambidextrous
Description: Your Single-Minded Fury off-hand attacks trigger an instant attack with your main-hand weapon and grant you Dominant.    Dominant Increases your attack power by 10% for 9 sec.  This effect can only occur once every 16 sec and Dominant cannot be active at the same time as Southpaw.

Name: Ambush Predator
Description: Dealing damage with Rake or Rip has a 10% chance and Shred has a 50% chance to grant you Ambush Predator.    Ambush Predator Your next Ravage can be cast outside of Prowl, has no positional requirement, and costs 20 less energy.

Name: An Honest Mistake
Description: Missing with a spell now increases your hit chance by 5% and spell haste by 5% for 10 sec.

Name: Arcane Aiming
Description: When Clearcasting is consumed, you gain Arcane Aiming.  Does not trigger from Elemental Clearcasting consumption.   Arcane Aiming Your next 3 Hunter Shots deal 11 additional Arcane damage and restore 6% of your total mana. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Arcane Arrows
Description: Dealing damage with Arcane Missiles grants a charge or Arcane Arrows making your Auto Shot fire an additional projectile dealing arcane damage. Holds up to 10 charges. Lasts 15 seconds.

Name: Arcane Charge
Description: Charge and Feral Charge deal 8 Arcane damage to nearby enemies on impact, instantly restoring 3% of your missing mana and granting nearby allies Charged Brilliance, restoring 3% missing mana every second for 6 sec.

Name: Arcane Fulmination
Description: Increases your threat generated by Arcane damage by 40%.  Reduces all damage taken by 2%.

Name: Arcane Gunslinger
Description: Arcane Shot now grants you Arcane Gunslinger.      Arcane Gunslinger Your Arcane Barrage deals 25% increased damage and has a 50% chance to grant you Missile Barrage. Aimed Shot deals 30% increased damage against monsters. Stacks up to 2 times and lasts 8 sec or until you gain Missile Barrage.    Aimed Shot deals 4% increased damage against players.      Missile Barrage Reduces the channeled duration of your next Arcane Missiles spell by 2.5 sec, reduces the mana cost by 100%, and the missiles fire every 0.4 sec. Lasts for 15 sec.

Name: Arcane Infusion
Description: Increases critical strike chance of Arcane Shot by 15%.    Casting Arcane Shot grants you Arcane Infusion.    Arcane Infusion Grants you Missile Barrage at 3 stacks. Lasts 12 sec.    Missile Barrage Reduces the channeled duration of your next Arcane Missiles spell by 2.5 sec, reduces the mana cost by 100%, and the missiles fire every 0.4 sec. Lasts for 15 sec.

Name: Arcane Motes
Description: Your Arcane Missiles and Arcane Barrage now generate Arcane Motes.    Arcane Motes Increases the damage of your Starfire, Moonfire by 10%. Stacks up to 5. Lasts 8 sec.

Name: Arcane Reloading
Description: Dealing damage with Arcane Missiles reduces the active cooldown of Aimed Shot by 1.5 seconds.

Name: Arcane Reprisal
Description: Dealing damage with Arcane Barrage reduces the cooldowns of Crusader Strike and Divine Storm by 3 seconds.

Name: Arcane Shelling
Description: Dealing damage with Arcane Shot now grants you Arcane Shelling.    Arcane Shelling Your Arcane Barrage and Aimed Shot deal 30% increased damage. Stacks up to 3 times and lasts for 20 sec.

Name: Arcane Synergy
Description: Arcane Missiles now grant you Arcane Synergy.    Arcane Synergy The cast time of your next Starfire is reduced by 5%, and its damage increased by 5%. Stacks up to 20. Lasts 15 sec.

Name: Arcane Thunder
Description: Arcane Missiles now channels for 2 more seconds. While channeling, your Lightning Bolt is transformed into Thunder Bolt and its damage is increased by 30%.  You can no longer trigger Missile Barrage.    Thunder Bolt Casts a bolt of arcane infused lightning at the target for 11 to 12 Spellstorm damage.     This spell is castable during the channeling of Arcane Missiles.

Name: Arcane Vanguard
Description: Dealing direct damage with Arcane Blast marks the target with Arcane Breach for 12 sec.    Casting Charge or Intercept on a target marked by you consumes Arcane Breach, triggers your highest known rank of Arcane Explosion 750 milliseconds later, and reduces the remaining cooldown of Blink by 5 sec.

Name: Archmage
Description: Increases the chance to trigger Missile Barrage and Brain Freeze by an additional 10%.

Name: Arctic Stalker
Description: Dealing damage with Aimed Shot or Steady Shot reduces the remaining cooldown of Deep Freeze by 1 sec.

Name: Armor of Faith
Description: When you cast Greater Heal or Flash Heal on an ally with Weakened Soul, they receive Armor of Faith, which heals them the next time they take damage. This healing is equal to 20% of the heal that granted them Armor of Faith.    Heals for 50% when triggered by player damage

Name: Armor of Wrath
Description: Casting Hammer of Wrath now reduces your damage taken by 12% for 6 sec.    This effect can only occur once every 12 sec.

Name: Arugal's Blink
Description: Casting Blink unleashes a wave of Shadow Bolts at your arrival point, dealing 65 Shadow damage to nearby enemies.

Name: Arugal's Tainted Arcanum
Description: Dealing damage with Arcane Missiles applies Tainted.      Tainted Increases your damage dealt to the target with Unstable Affliction by 65% and Curse of Agony by 65%.    Each tick consumes one charge. Stores up to 10 charges and lasts for 18 sec.

Name: Assuaging Shadows
Description: Casting Shadow Dance now releases a Shadow Nova.    Shadow Nova Deals -180 Shadow damage to nearby enemies and slows them by 80% for 3 seconds.

Name: Astral Fusion
Description: Dealing damage with Starfire or Wrath grants Astral Fusion.    Astral Fusion Reduces the cast time of your next Starsurge by 34% and increases its damage by 15%. Stacks up to 3 times. Lasts 8 sec.  Reaching 3 stacks resets the cooldown of Starsurge.

Name: Astral Realm
Description: Dealing damage with Thunderstorm restores an additional 10% of your maximum mana.    If a target player is afflicted by your Unrelenting Storm when damaged by Thunderstorm, you and your target are forced into an alternate dimension for 8 seconds, reducing the target's damage and healing by 20%.

Name: Atonement
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Dealing direct damage with Smite or Holy Fire triggers a heal on a nearby ally for 285.    Dealing periodic damage with Holy Fire triggers a heal on a nearby ally for 15.    Heals from Atonement benefit from healing modifiers and can trigger additional effects.

Name: Authority
Description: Execution Sentence periodic damage applies Authority, increasing damage taken from your next Shield of Righteousness by 10%. Stacks up to 4.     Consuming Authority reduces the damage you take by 3% per stack consumed for 8 sec.    Using Shield of Righteousness has a 20% chance to reset the cooldown of Execution Sentence.

Name: Avatar of Lightning
Description: Elemental Mastery sacrifices its instant cast and mana cost reduction to reduce its cooldown by 50% and allow you to cast Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning while moving.

Name: Bane of the Wicked
Description: Hammer of the Righteous now applies Bane of the Wicked to enemies hit.    Bane of the Wicked Increases Holy damage taken from you by 4% for 15 sec. Stacking up to 5.    The duration of Bane of the Wicked cannot be refreshed.

Name: Barrage Overload
Description: When Missile Barrage is consumed, you gain Barrage Overload.    Barrage Overload Your next Arcane Barrage causes you to overload, unleashing 1 arcane bolt per stack. Stacks up to 6 times. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Bathe in Blood
Description: Eviscerate, Envenom now have a 20% chance per combo point to grant you Bathe in Blood for each of your bleeds on the target.      Bathe in Blood Your bleeds deal 7% increased damage. Stacks up to 30 times and lasts 12 sec. At max stacks, the duration cannot be refreshed.

Name: Battering Ram
Description: Casting Slam now ignores 15% armor.    Slam now applies a stack of Sunder Armor.    Sunder Armor Sunders the target's armor, reducing it by 4%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts for 30 sec. Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Battle Cultist: Firebrand
Description: Melee critical strikes refresh your Immolate effect on the target.

Name: Battle Fatigue
Description: Your Warrior Shouts, Banners and Warcry now apply Battle Fatigue to enemies within 10 yards of you.    Your physical melee attacks and abilities have a 30% chance to increase the duration of Battle Fatigue by 1 sec.     This effect can only occur once every 30 sec from Warrior Shouts or Banners.    Battle Fatigue Increases your physical damage dealt to the target by 8%. Lasts 20 sec.

Name: Battle Fervor
Description: Charge now grants you Battle Fervor.    This effect can only occur once every 6 sec.    Battle Fervor Increases your haste by 15% and movement speed by 30% for 4 sec.

Name: Battle Glaive
Description: Using 3 Warrior direct damaging abilities in quick succession resets the cooldown of Glaive Toss and increases the damage of your next Glaive Toss by 40%. Lasts 10 sec.  Does not work with 'on next swing' abilities.

Name: Battlemage
Description: Fireball, Frostbolt or Arcane Blast empowers your Warrior abilities to deal an additional 20% weapon damage as Fire, Frost or Arcane for 10 seconds.

Name: Bear Attack
Description: This seems to do nothing. Best keep on your toes though. Cause that's the thing about bear attacksâ€¦ They come when you least expect it.     Cannot be used with pets.

Name: Bestial Assault
Description: Casting direct damage Hunter abilities now grant you Bestial Assault    Bestial Assault Reaching 5 stacks restores a charge of Unrelenting Wrath. Lasts 12 sec.

Name: Big Flaming Grimfire
Description: Your Soul Fire has 15% increased critical strike chance.  Casting Pyroblast makes your next Soul Fire release a secondary projectile half as strong.  Casting Soul Fire extends the duration of Living Bomb on your target by 2.5 seconds.

Name: Biting Cold
Description: When your Deep Freeze deals damage, its cooldown is reduced by 33%.

Name: Biting Drain
Description: Grants the periodic damage from your Drain Life and Drain Soul spells the ability to critically hit.    Critical strike damage bonus of your Drain Life and Drain Soul is increased by 35%.

Name: Bitter Cold
Description: Casting Ice Barrier or Icebound Fortitude causes you to be surrounded by a bitter cold dealing 10 Frost damage every second to all enemies within 8 yards. Lasts for 10 sec.    While active, your damaging frost spells or abilities have a 20% chance to apply Sunder Armor to targets hit.

Name: Black Ice Arsenal
Description: Dealing damage with Howling Blast, Icy Touch, and Frost Strike applies Black Ice.      Black Ice Increases damage taken from the caster's next Frostbolt and Frostfire Bolt by 20%. Stacks up to 3. Lasts for 12 sec.

Name: Blade Vortex
Description: While Blade Flurry is active your damaging melee finishing moves have a 20% chance per combo point to create a Blade Vortex.      Blade Vortex Deals 5 Physical damage to nearby enemies every second for 3 sec.

Name: Blademaster
Description: Parrying an attack now grants you Blademaster.    Blademaster cannot trigger while it is active.    Blademaster Your blade is empowered for 10 sec.    - Devastate: Deals 50% additional damage to nearby enemies and reduces their armor by an additional 10%.    - Death Strike: Hits 2 additional targets.    - Riposte: Awards 2 additional combo points and slows the target's attack speed by an additional 10%.

Name: Blades of Blood
Description: Using Charge or Colossus Smash grants you Blades of Blood.    Blades of Blood Your Whirlwind now hits 5 additional targets and applies a Rend (if known). Lasts 3 sec.

Name: Blaze Ward
Description: Taking direct damage or avoiding attacks has a chance to activate Blaze Aura.    Blaze Aura Ignites the area surrounds you, causing 5 Fire damage to all nearby enemies every 1 sec. Lasts 5 sec. Causes a high amount of threat.

Name: Blaze
Description: Your Fire Blast spreads your Immolate to enemies within 10 yards. The spread Immolate cannot critically strike.

Name: Blessed by the Elune
Description: Solar Eclipse causes your next Wrath or Starsurge to apply Insect Swarm.    Lunar Eclipse causes your next Starfire or Starsurge to apply Moonfire.

Name: Blessing of the Divines
Description: Your direct Holy and Nature heals now have a 10% chance to trigger a random blessing.    This effect can only occur once every 1 sec and can only trigger from heals with a resource cost.    Blessing of the Titan Increases the target's Health by 5% and reduces damage taken by 5% for 8 sec.    Blessing of Creation Grants 12 mana, 22 energy, and 10 rage to you and your party.    Blessing of Time Increases you and your target's spell haste by 10% for 10 sec.    Blessing of Mending Heals party members within 30 yards of you -39.    Blessing of the Divines Heals party members within 30 yards of you for -30 every 3 seconds for 15 sec.

Name: Blind Rage
Description: You now generate 10 rage after each missed attack.

Name: Blinding Dispersion
Description: Dispersion's cooldown is now reduced by 10 seconds. When Dispersion ends, a shadowy nova blinds and disorients nearby enemies for 2 sec.

Name: Blink and you'll miss it!
Description: Your damaging spells with a cast time reduce the cooldown of Blink by 1 seconds.    This effect can only occur once every 1 sec and only works against creatures.

Name: Blood and Guts
Description: Using Execute on targets affected by your Disembowel deals 156 damage to 5 nearby enemies.    This damage uses Execute modifiers.

Name: Blood Bane
Description: Dealing periodic damage with Rend or Deep Wounds grants Blood Bane.    Dealing damage with Deadly Poison grants Venom Coated Blade.      Blood Bane Increases the damage of your Deadly Poison by 15%. Stacks up to 3 times. Lasts 8 sec.    Venom Coated Blade Increases the damage of your next 5 Instant Poisons by 100%. Lasts 16 sec.

Name: Blood Drinker
Description: Your Bloodthirst now consumes Taste for Blood to heal you for 4.

Name: Blood Hunting
Description: Critical strikes with Hunter abilities against targets afflicted by your Piercing Shots randomly reduce the cooldown of either: - Kill Command by 3 sec - Frenzy Shot by 3 sec - Bestial Wrath by 7 sec  Abilities you do not currently have learned can still be randomly selected for the cooldown reduction.

Name: Blood Rain
Description: Your Stormstrike now increases your bleed damage against the target by 30% for 6 sec.

Name: Blood Shield
Description: Requires Frost Presence.    Death Strike no longer heals you.     Instead it shields you for 5% of your maximum health for each of her diseases on the target.     The shield is capped at 20% of your maximum health, 10% against players.

Name: Blood Venom
Description: Bloodthirst makes your Envenom preserve 2 combo points.    Envenom used this way increases the damage done by Warrior abilities by 20% for 8 seconds.

Name: Bloodletter's Rhythm
Description: Blood Strike grants Bloodletter's Rhythm.      Bloodletter's Rhythm At 3 stacks, your next Heart Strike, Rune Strike, or Death Strike costs no resource. Lasts 15 sec.

Name: Bloodletting
Description: Rupture deals 25% more damage to targets affected by Rend.    Rend deals 30% more damage to targets affected by Rupture.

Name: Bloodstained Recklessness
Description: Killing an enemy during Recklessness extends its duration by 3 seconds.    This effect can only occur once every 1 sec.

Name: Bloody Business
Description: Casting Mangle 3 times within 5 sec, spreads your Pounce to up to 7 nearby targets.

Name: Bloody Claws
Description: Claw costs 12 less energy and gains additional damage equal to 20% of your attack power.

Name: Bloody Maelstrom
Description: Consuming Maelstrom Weapon at max stacks empowers your next Bloodthirst, Mortal Strike or Heart Strike to deal 8 Elemental damage to 6 nearby enemies.     Bloody Maelstrom deals 15% more damage per stack. Stacks up to 5. Lasts 12 seconds.

Name: Bloody Resets
Description: Hemorrhage and Ghostly Strike can now trigger your Sword and Board talent.

Name: Blooming Growth
Description: Critically healing with Regrowth now applies its heal over time effect to 3 party or raid members within 20 yards.    Regrowth effects applied this way have their healing reduced by 10%.

Name: Blooming Power
Description: Casting Swiftmend increases your next Regrowth's chance to critically heal by 100%.    Swiftmend now grants you Nature's Grace.    Nature's Grace Increases your haste by 20% for 4 sec.

Name: Blunt Force Trauma
Description: Your Damage Shield talent now deals additional threat and applies Blunt Force Trauma.   Blunt Force Trauma Bleeding for 3 damage every 3 seconds and your Damage Shield deals 20% increased damage against the target. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 9 sec.     This cannot trigger other effects

Name: Boomer
Description: Direct damage Fire spells have a chance to cause an explosion around you, dealing -15 and increase your spell critical strike chance by 3% for 5 sec.    This effect can only occur once every 8 sec.

Name: Booming Thunder
Description: Dealing direct Nature damage with spells grants Booming Thunder.   Booming Thunder Increases the damage of your next Earth Shock by 20% and increases its critical strike chance by 3%. Against monsters, Earth Shock deals an additional 10% damage per stack. Stacks up to 25 times and lasts 15 sec.

Name: Borrowing Time
Description: Casting Align, Renew and Synchronize now grants you Borrowed Time.    Borrowed Time Grants spell haste for your next spell after casting Power Word: Shield.  This effect is not consumed by instant-cast spells.

Name: Boundless Salvation
Description: Your direct Holy heals reduce the cooldown of Tyr's Deliverance by 3 sec.  Holy Light reduces the cooldown of Tyr's Deliverance by an additional 3 sec.

Name: Brand of the Pyromaniac
Description: Combustion also causes your next two Pyroblasts to bounce to 2 additional enemies, dealing 30% less damage with each bounce.

Name: Bright Lights
Description: Holy Fire grants you Light's Grace.    Your Light's Grace talent also increases your spell haste and Holy damage by 3%.    Light's Grace The cast time of your next Holy Light spell is reduced by 0.5 sec. Lasts for 15 sec.

Name: Brilliance of Faith
Description: Divine Favor now empowers the cast and further empowers 2 casts of the spell that consumed it.  Holy Shock - Has no cooldown and has its global cooldown reduced by 33%.  Flash of Light - Heals up to 3 targets.  Holy Light - Heals for 30% more.

Name: Built up Thirst
Description: Finishing moves grant you Built up Thirst.      Built up Thirst Increases the damage of your next Bloodthirst by 15% per combo point consumed. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Bullseye!
Description: Disengage now doubles the effectiveness of your Piercing Shots talent and makes your hunter shots ignore 20% of your target's armor for 10 seconds.

Name: Burning Desire
Description: Increases the damage taken by your Hellfire ability by 8% and increases the damage it deals by 25%.

Name: Burst of Flames
Description: Dealing periodic damage with Corruption, Conflagrate, Immolate and Shadowflame now grants you Pyromancers Kindling.     Pyromancers Kindling Your next Pyroblast deals 8% increased damage. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 6 sec.

Name: By Fire Be Purged
Description: Fire Nova now purges a beneficial spell effect from damaged targets.    This effect can only occur once every 15 seconds.

Name: Calculated Ambush
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Ambush ability by 6% and the damage by 3%.

Name: Cat-a-clysmic Entrance
Description: Casting Searing Pain now grants you Cat-a-Clysmic Entrance for 10 sec. While at 5 stacks your next Cat Form shapeshift has no global cooldown and unleashes Cat-a-clysm.    Cat-a-clysm Deals 41 Fire damage to 6 enemies within 8 yards, increasing your Fire damage dealt to them by 20% for 10 sec.

Name: Cataclysmic Power
Description: This spell belongs to Pyromancer    The damage of Fireball and Incinerate is increased by 2% for each of your Fire periodic effects on the target.

Name: Cataclysmic Sundering
Description: Sundering leaves a burning patch on the ground for 8 sec. Dealing 118 Fire damage to enemies every second and increasing the damage of your Flame shock by 50%.

Name: Celestial Fury
Description: Critical strikes with Wrath while Nature's Grace is active grant you Celestial Fury.   Celestial Fury Your next direct Arcane spell deals 5, increased by 20% per stack, additional Arcane damage to nearby enemies. Stacks up to 10 times and lasts 15 sec.

Name: Celestial Replenishment
Description: Triggering an Eclipse now restores 16% of your missing mana.

Name: Centered
Description: Your direct Holy heals now grant you Centered.    Centered Your Smite, Holy Fire, and Penance deal 2% increased damage and have 3% increased chance to hit. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 10 sec.

Name: Chaos Manifesting
Description: After casting Chaos Bolt, you receive a Fire or Shadow Empowerment, increasing your damage dealt with that school by 10% for 8 sec.

Name: Charged Ice
Description: Consuming Fingers of Frost with Frostbolt, Frostfire Bolt, Ice Lance or Deep Freeze grants Charged Ice.      Charged Ice Increases the damage of Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Thunderstorm and Lava Burst by 40%. Stacks up to 2. Lasts 7 sec. The duration cannot be refreshed.

Name: Charged Thunder
Description: Stormstrike now refunds all charges of your Lightning Shield.

Name: Charged Tides
Description: Casting Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning or triggering Lightning Rod grants you Charged Tides.      Charged Tides Your next Chain Heal or Healing Wave deals 10% increased healing and has a 25% reduced cast time. Stacks up to 4 times and lasts 12 sec.

Name: Chasing the Flames
Description: Dealing damage with Flametongue Weapon reduces the active cooldown of Immolation and Explosive Trap by 3 seconds.

Name: Chilling Blows
Description: Your Frostbrand hits extend the duration of your Deep Freeze by 0.3 seconds or reduces its cooldown by 1.5 seconds against enemies permanently immune to stuns.    Dealing damage with Deep Freeze increases your attack speed by 15% for 8 sec.

Name: Clad in Frost
Description: Requires Frost Presence or Mana-Forged Barrier.    Casting Ice Barrier or Icebound Fortitude now grants you Clad in Frost.    Clad in Frost Reduces all damage taken by 12%, 30% increased threat from Frost sources and increases the chance to trigger Fingers of Frost by 10%. Lasts for 10 sec.    While active, casting a Frost spell reduces the remaining cooldown of Ice Barrier by 1 sec.    While Clad in Frost is active, Frost spell and ability casts reduce the remaining cooldown of Ice Barrier by 1 sec.

Name: Clarity of the Mind
Description: Your Omen of Clarity talent has an additional 4% chance to activate.

Name: Clean Pass
Description: Your Glaive Toss consumes your Piercing Shots bleed to deal its full damage increased by 100%.

Name: Cleanse In Flames
Description: Exorcism, Judgement, Hammer of Wrath and Holy Shock deal 10% increased damage to targets afflicted by your Holy Fire.

Name: Cleansing Flames of the Apostate
Description: Requires  Path of Healing Casting Cauterizing Fire or Pyroblast grants you Flames of the Apostate while in combat.  Dealing direct damage with Pyroblast heals three nearby allies for 356.  Dealing periodic damage with Pyroblast heals one nearby ally for 11.  Flamestrike applies Cauterizing Embers to allies standing within it.   Cauterizing Embers Heals the target for 12 every 2 seconds.   Flames of the Apostate Flamestrike's cast time is reduced by 10% per stack.     At 10 stacks, Flamestrike also grants a shield that absorbs 18 damage on up to 5 allies.

Name: Clear Mind
Description: Your Elemental Focus Clearcasting gains an extra charge, reduces mana cost by an additional 10%, and now grants 5% spell haste.

Name: Cloudburst
Description: Increases the damage of your Thunderstorm by 100%.    The mana restored by your Thunderstom is increased by 100%.    Your Thunderstorm gains, or increases its cast time by 1 second.

Name: Coagulation
Description: Blood Horror's damage is increased by 50%, healing by 125%, and you take 30% less damage.

Name: Cobra Combo
Description: Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per combo point to increase your Tamed Pet's critical strike chance by 15% for 12 sec.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.

Name: Cold Dark Thoughts
Description: Dealing direct Frost damage has a 15% chance to grant you Mindblast!.   Mindblast! Your next Mind Blast spell is instant, costs no mana, deals 25% more damage. Lasts for 15 sec.

Name: Cold Seeking Missiles
Description: Dealing damage with Frostbolt increases the damage the target takes from your Arcane Missiles by 10%.

Name: Coldshot
Description: Hunter shots reduce the cast time of your next Ray of Frost by 15%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 30 sec.

Name: Coldstrike Marksmanship
Description: Direct Frost Spell critical strikes grant you a charge of Coldstrike Marksmanship.    Coldstrike Marksmanship Increases the damage of your next Hunter Shot by 20%. Holds 6 charges. Lasts 20 sec.

Name: Collective Conscious
Description: Your Tranquility also restores 15% base mana when it heals.

Name: Combat Medic
Description: Your Bandage now grows more effective with each heal, increasing the healing your ally receives from Bandage by 10%, stacks up to 8 times.

Name: Combusting Shots
Description: Direct Fire spell damage while Combustion is active grants Combusting Shots. Subsequent casts increase the duration by 3 seconds.   Combusting Shots Increases the damage done by Explosive Shot by 20%. Lasts for 3 seconds.

Name: Compound Power
Description: Your damaging Steady Shot and Arcane Shot now award 2 combo points.

Name: Compound Speed
Description: Slice and Dice also increases your Ranged Attack Speed by 30%.

Name: Conductive Affliction
Description: Dealing damage with Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning applies Conductive Affliction to the target for 15 sec. Holds up to 10 charges. Damage from your Unstable Affliction or Vampiric Touch consumes a charge to deal 35% increased damage.

Name: Conductive Venom
Description: Dealing damage with Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning applies Conductive Venom for 15 sec, increasing the damage the target takes from your Serpent Sting by 5%. Stacks up to 10 times.

Name: Conductor
Description: Casting Frostbolt, Frostfire Bolt and Frost Nova grants Conductor.      Conductor Your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning or Lava Burst has 34% reduced cast time. Stacks up to 3 times and lasts 10 sec.

Name: Consecrated Target
Description: Dealing damage with ranged abilities marks the target for 15 sec, increasing the damage it takes from your Holy Fire by 5%. Stacks up to 10 times.

Name: Consecrated Zeal
Description: Dealing damage with Consecration grants you a stack of Consecrated Zeal.    Consecrated Zeal Increases holy damage done by 1% and reduces physical damage taken by 1%. Stacks up to 3 times and lasts 3 sec.

Name: Conservation
Description: Effective direct heals grant you Conservation.    Conservation Increases your mana regeneration by 1, increasing with level, and allows 5% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting for 6 sec.    Stacks up to 5 times.

Name: Consumed By Shadows
Description: Requires  Shadowform    After exiting Stealth you will enter Shadowform.

Name: Consuming Flames
Description: Increases the potency of your Ignite talent by an additional 15%, but your Fire critical strikes deal 5% less damage.

Name: Controlled Burn
Description: Chaos Bolt extends the duration of your Immolate by 6 sec.

Name: Controlled Chaos
Description: Spells with a cast time reduce the cooldown of Chaos Bolt by 2 seconds.

Name: Corrupted Bear Form
Description: Corrupts your Bear Form, causing your melee attacks to deal additional high-threat Shadow damage while reducing Physical damage dealt by 20%.

Name: Corrupted Blade
Description: Your Sinister Strike and Gloomblade casts spread your Corruption to enemies within 10 yards of the target.    Corruption will not spread to crowd controlled players or totems.

Name: Corrupted Shiv
Description: Dealing damage with Shiv now applies Corruption and refreshes Shadow Word: Pain.

Name: Corrupting Shadows
Description: Your Shadowburn applies Corruption to the target.

Name: Counterpoise
Description: While above 50% rage, you gain 5% melee haste. While below 50% rage, you gain 3% melee critical strike chance.

Name: Courage of Elune
Description: Your Maul, Swipe, and Mangle (Bear) have a chance to grant party members 2% Strength for 10 sec. Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Covering Crown
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Casting Rejuvenation now grants your target Covering Crown.    Covering Crown Reduces the damage taken from area of effect attacks by 30% for 3 sec. This does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Coward's Bane
Description: Your Warrior abilities have a chance to daze enemies facing away from you for 3 seconds.

Name: Crackling Thunder
Description: Thunder Clap creates Crackling Thunder on the ground, dealing 3 Nature damage and increasing your critical strike chance against nearby enemies by 5%.     This damage generates additional threat.

Name: Crazy Cultist
Description: Your offensive Warlock spell casts have a 15% chance to cast an additional random Warlock spell for free.

Name: Creeping Frost
Description: Your Deep Freeze now spawns creeping frost beneath the target that grows in size every second and reduces enemy movement speed by 40%.

Name: Crimson Claws
Description: Dealing damage with Crimson Tempest has a 20% chance per combo point to send your Tamed Pet into a frenzy, causing its auto attacks to hit 5 nearby enemies for 8 sec.    This effect can only occur once every 15 sec.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin or Tether Elemental, and Tame Beast.      Crimson Claws Auto attacks strike 5 nearby enemy targets for 20% of the damage dealt.

Name: Crimson Defense
