Name: Glyph of Metamorphosis
Description: Increases the duration of your Metamorphosis by 6 sec.

Name: Glyph of Mind Flay
Description: Increases the damage done by your Mind Flay spell by 20% when your target is afflicted with Shadow Word: Pain.

Name: Glyph of Mind Sear
Description: Increases the radius of effect on Mind Sear by 5 yards.

Name: Glyph of Mirror Image
Description: Your Mirror Image spell now creates a 4th copy.

Name: Glyph of Monsoon
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Typhoon spell by 3 sec.

Name: Glyph of Moonfire
Description: Increases the periodic damage of your Moonfire ability by 75%, but initial damage is decreased by 90%.

Name: Glyph of Mortal Strike
Description: Increases the damage of your Mortal Strike ability by 10%.

Name: Glyph of Multi-Shot
Description: Decreases the cooldown of Multi-Shot by 1 sec and increases its critical strike chance by 10%.

Name: Glyph of Mutilate
Description: Reduces the cost of Mutilate by 5 energy.

Name: Glyph of Nourish
Description: Your Nourish heals an additional 6% for each of your heal over time effects present on the target.

Name: Glyph of Obliterate
Description: Increases the damage of your Obliterate ability by 25%.

Name: Glyph of Overpower
Description: Adds a 100% chance to enable your Overpower when your attacks are parried.

Name: Glyph of Pain Suppression
Description: Allows Pain Suppression to be cast while stunned.

Name: Glyph of Penance
Description: Reduces the cooldown of Penance by 2 sec.

Name: Glyph of Pestilence
Description: Increases the radius of your Pestilence effect by 5 yards.

Name: Glyph of Plague Strike
Description: Your Plague Strike does 20% additional damage.

Name: Glyph of Polymorph
Description: Your Polymorph spell also removes all damage over time effects from the target.

Name: Glyph of Power Word: Shield
Description: Your Power Word: Shield also heals the target for 20% of the absorption amount.

Name: Glyph of Prayer of Healing
Description: Your Prayer of Healing spell also heals an additional 25% of its initial heal over 6 sec.

Name: Glyph of Preparation
Description: Your Preparation ability also instantly resets the cooldown of Blade Flurry, Dismantle, and Kick.

Name: Glyph of Psychic Scream
Description: Increases the duration of your Psychic Scream by 2 sec. and increases its cooldown by 8 sec.

Name: Glyph of Quick Decay
Description: Your haste now reduces the time between periodic damage ticks of your Corruption spell.

Name: Glyph of Raise Dead
Description: Your Raise Dead spell no longer requires a reagent.

Name: Glyph of Rake
Description: Your Rake deals 20% more damage and prevents targets from fleeing.

Name: Glyph of Rapid Charge
Description: Killing an enemy that yields experience or honor reduces the active cooldown of your Charge by 4 seconds.

Name: Glyph of Rapid Fire
Description: Increases the haste from Rapid Fire by an additional 8%.

Name: Glyph of Rapid Rejuvenation
Description: Your haste now reduces the time between the periodic healing ticks of your Rejuvenation spell.

Name: Glyph of Rebirth
Description: Players resurrected by Rebirth are returned to life with 100% health.

Name: Glyph of Regrowth
Description: Increases the healing of your Regrowth spell by 20% if your Regrowth effect is still active on the target.

Name: Glyph of Rejuvenation
Description: While your Rejuvenation targets are below 50% health, you will heal them for an additional 50% health.

Name: Glyph of Remove Curse
Description: Your Remove Curse spell also makes the target immune to all curses for 4 sec.

Name: Glyph of Rending
Description: Rend no longer costs rage and lasts for an additional 6 sec.

Name: Glyph of Renew
Description: Reduces the duration of your Renew by 3 sec. but increases the amount healed each tick by 35%.

Name: Glyph of Resonating Power
Description: Your Thunder Clap ability costs 5 less rage.

Name: Glyph of Revenge
Description: After using Revenge, your next Heroic Strike costs no rage.

Name: Glyph of Rip
Description: Increases the duration of your Rip ability by 4 sec.

Name: Glyph of Riptide
Description: Increases the duration of Riptide by 6 sec.

Name: Glyph of Rune Strike
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Rune Strike by 10%.

Name: Glyph of Rune Tap
Description: Your Rune Tap heals yourself for an additional 10% of the effect, and also heals your party for 10% of their maximum health.

Name: Glyph of Rupture
Description: Increases the duration of Rupture by 4 sec.

Name: Glyph of Salvation
Description: When you cast Hand of Salvation on yourself, it also reduces damage taken by 20%.

Name: Glyph of Sap
Description: Increases the duration of Sap by 20 sec.

Name: Glyph of Scatter Shot
Description: Increases the range of Scatter Shot by 3 yards.

Name: Glyph of Scorch
Description: Increases the damage of your Scorch spell by 20%.

Name: Glyph of Scourge Imprisonment
Description: Reduces the cast time of your Shackle Undead by 1.0 sec.

Name: Glyph of Scourge Strike
Description: Your Scourge Strike increases the duration of your Death Knight diseases on the target by 3 sec, up to a maximum of 12 additional seconds.

Name: Glyph of Seal of Command
Description: You gain 8% of your base mana each time you use a Judgement with Seal of Command active.

Name: Glyph of Seal of Light
Description: While Seal of Light is active, the effect of your Paladin healing spells is increased by 5%.

Name: Glyph of Seal of Righteousness
Description: Increases the damage done by Seal of Righteousness by 10%.

Name: Glyph of Seal of Wisdom
Description: While Seal of Wisdom is active, the cost of your Paladin healing spells is reduced by 5%.

Name: Glyph of Searing Pain
Description: Increases the critical strike bonus of your Searing Pain by 20%.

Name: Glyph of Serpent Sting
Description: Increases the damage done by your Serpent Sting by 20% and increases the duration of your Serpent Sting by 6 sec.

Name: Glyph of Shadow Bolt
Description: Reduces the cast time of your Shadow Bolt by 15%.

Name: Glyph of Shadow Word: Death
Description: Reduces the damage you take from Shadow Word: Death by 25% and targets below 35% health take an additional 1% damage for every 1% health they are under 35%.

Name: Glyph of Shadow Word: Pain
Description: The periodic damage ticks of your Shadow Word: Pain spell restore 1% of your base mana.

Name: Glyph of Shadowburn
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of Shadowburn by 20% when the target is below 35% health.

Name: Glyph of Shadowflame
Description: Your Shadowflame also applies a 70% movement speed slow on its victims.

Name: Glyph of Shamanistic Strikes
Description: Increases the damage dealt by Stormstrike by 5%.

Name: Glyph of Shield of Righteousness
Description: Reduces the mana cost of Shield of Righteousness by 80%.

Name: Glyph of Shield Wall
Description: Reduces the cooldown on Shield Wall by 2 min, but Shield Wall now only reduces damage taken by 40%.

Name: Glyph of Shocking
Description: Reduces the global cooldown triggered by your shock spells to 1 sec.

Name: Glyph of Shockwave
Description: Reduces the cooldown on Shockwave by 3 sec.

Name: Glyph of Shred
Description: Each time you Shred, the duration of your Rip on the target is extended 2 sec, up to a maximum of 10 sec.

Name: Glyph of Sinister Strike
Description: Your Sinister Strike critical strikes have a 50% chance to add an additional combo point.

Name: Glyph of Siphon Life
Description: Increases the healing you receive from your Siphon Life talent by 25%.

Name: Glyph of Slice and Dice
Description: Increases the duration of Slice and Dice by 3 sec.

Name: Glyph of Smite
Description: Your Smite spell inflicts an additional 20% damage against targets afflicted by Holy Fire.

Name: Glyph of Soulstone
Description: Increases the amount of health you gain from resurrecting via a Soulstone by 300%.

Name: Glyph of Spell Reflection
Description: Reduces the cooldown on Spell Reflection by 1 sec.

Name: Glyph of Spirit of Redemption
Description: Increases the duration of Spirit of Redemption by 6 sec.

Name: Glyph of Spiritual Attunement
Description: Increases the amount of mana gained from your Spiritual Attunement spell by an additional 2%.

Name: Glyph of Sprint
Description: Increases the movement speed of your Sprint ability by an additional 30%.

Name: Glyph of Starfall
Description: Reduces the cooldown of Starfall by 30 sec and causes it to only hit enemies in combat.

Name: Glyph of Starfire
Description: Your Starfire ability increases the duration of your Moonfire effect on the target by 3 sec, up to a maximum of 15 additional seconds.

Name: Glyph of Steady Shot
Description: Increases the damage dealt by Steady Shot by 10% when your target is afflicted with your Serpent Sting.

Name: Glyph of Stormstrike
Description: Increases the Nature damage bonus from your Stormstrike ability by an additional 8%.

Name: Glyph of Strangulate
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Strangulate by 20 sec.

Name: Glyph of Succubus
Description: Your Succubus's Seduction ability also removes all damage over time effects from the target.

Name: Glyph of Survival Instincts
Description: Your Survival Instincts ability grants an additional 15% of your maximum health.

Name: Glyph of Sweeping Strikes
Description: Reduces the rage cost of your Sweeping Strikes ability by 100%.

Name: Glyph of Swiftmend
Description: Your Swiftmend ability no longer consumes a Rejuvenation or Regrowth effect from the target.

Name: Glyph of the Beast
Description: Increases the attack power bonus of Aspect of the Beast for you and your pet by an additional 2%.

Name: Glyph of the Ghoul
Description: Your Ghoul receives an additional 40% of your Strength and 40% of your Stamina.

Name: Glyph of the Hawk
Description: Increases the haste bonus of the Improved Aspect of the Hawk effect by an additional 6%.

Name: Glyph of Thunder
Description: Reduces the cooldown on Thunderstorm by 10 seconds.

Name: Glyph of Thunderstorm
Description: Increases the mana you receive from your Thunderstorm spell by 10%.    No longer knocks creatures away.

Name: Glyph of Tricks of the Trade
Description: The bonus damage and threat redirection granted by your Tricks of the Trade ability lasts an additional 4 sec.

Name: Glyph of Trueshot Aura
Description: While you have Trueshot Aura learned, you have 10% increased critical strike chance on your Aimed Shot.

Name: Glyph of Turn Evil
Description: Reduces the casting time of your Turn Evil spell by 100%, but increases the cooldown by 8 sec.

Name: Glyph of Typhoon
Description: Reduces the cost of your Typhoon spell by 8% and increases its radius by 10 yards, but it no longer knocks enemies back.

Name: Glyph of Unbreakable Armor
Description: Increases the total armor granted by Unbreakable Armor to 30%.

Name: Glyph of Unholy Blight
Description: Increases the damage done by Unholy Blight by 40%.

Name: Glyph of Unstable Affliction
Description: Decreases the casting time of your Unstable Affliction by 0.2 sec.

Name: Glyph of Vampiric Blood
Description: Increases the duration of your Vampiric Blood by 5 sec.

Name: Glyph of Victory Rush
Description: Your Victory Rush ability has a 30% increased critical strike chance.

Name: Glyph of Vigilance
Description: Your Vigilance ability transfers an additional 5% of your target's threat to you.

Name: Glyph of Vigor
Description: Requires  Vigor (Rank 1)  Vigor grants an additional 10 maximum energy.

Name: Glyph of Voidwalker
Description: Increases your Voidwalker's total Stamina by 20%.

Name: Glyph of Volley
Description: Decreases the mana cost of Volley by 20%.

Name: Glyph of Water Elemental
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Summon Water Elemental spell by 30 sec.

Name: Glyph of Whirlwind
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Whirlwind by 2 sec.

Name: Glyph of Wild Growth
Description: Wild Growth can affect 1 additional target.

Name: Glyph of Windfury Weapon
Description: Increases the chance per swing for Windfury Weapon to trigger by 2%.

Name: Glyph of Wyvern Sting
Description: Decreases the cooldown of your Wyvern Sting by 6 sec.

Name: Goldrinn's Guile
Description: Your finishing moves now have a 5% chance per combo point to grant you Goldrinn's Guile, increased to 20% chance per combo point if you are in Worgen Form.      Goldrinn's Guile Your next Mind Blast or Vampiric Touch is instant, has 40% increased damage, and grants 2 combo points. Lasts for 8 sec.

Name: Good Fortune
Description: Consuming a fully-stacked Serendipity increases your Holy spell critical strike chance by 7% for 12 sec.

Name: Goremaw's Bite
Description: Damaging rogue finishing moves have a 3% chance per combo point consumed to trigger Goremaw's Bite.      Goremaw's Bite Your next damaging Rogue finishing move causes Goremaw to lash out, dealing 57 Shadow damage and generating 5 combo points.

Name: Graceful Stride
Description: Your Nature's Grace also increases your movement speed by 20%.

Name: Grasping Curse
Description: Your Shadow Bolt damage now applies Grasping Curse.    This effect can only occur once every 5 sec.    Grasping Curse Reduces the target's movement speed by 35% for 5 sec.    This uses Curse of Exhaustion modifiers.

Name: Grave Ammunition
Description: You have a 25% chance for your Frost Fever ticks to load Black-Ice Ammunition and Blood Plague ticks to load Plague-Tipped Ammunition.     Black-Ice Ammunition Next Auto shot triggers 50% ranged weapon damage as Shadowfrost damage to enemies within 8 yards of the target.    Plague-Tipped Vulnerability Next Auto shot increases damage taken from your Frost Fever and Blood Plague by 3% per stack. Stacks up to 10 times.

Name: Group Think
Description: Your Tamed Pet's damage is increased by 20% while Berserk is active.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.

Name: Grove Medicine
Description: When your Medicinal Sting or Grove Shot heals an ally, it also grants them Grove Medicine, healing for 9 every 2 sec. Lasts 6 sec.

Name: Grove Ranger
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Using Hunter Shots now grants you Grove Ranger.   Stacks up to 2 times.    Grove Ranger Consumes up to 2 stacks to empower your next Wild Growth, Healing Touch or Regrowth. Consuming 2 stacks doubles the effect.    - Wild Growth: Heals 2 additional targets and its heal radius is increased by 5 yards.    - Healing Touch and Regrowth: Cast time reduced by 50% and mana cost reduced by 30%.    - Healing Touch: Heals an additional target and healing increased by 30%.

Name: Grove Ranger's Agility
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Increases your attack power by 120% of your Agility and your Healing Power by 20% of your Agility.

Name: Growing Corruption
Description: Targets afflicted by your Seed of Corruption increase your chance to critically strike them by 20%.    Seed of Corruption's explosion applies Corruption to targets it hits.

Name: Growing Earth
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Healing with Lifebloom and Rejuvenation now has a chance to grant you Growing Earth.    Growing Earth Reduces the cast time of your next Healing Wave or Healing Touch by 15%. Stacks up to 3 and lasts for 12 sec.  While at max stacks, Healing Wave and Healing Touch heal your ally for an additional 2 every 1 sec and increase their healing received from your Lifebloom and Rejuvenation by 25% for 5 sec.

Name: Growing Light
Description: Healing your Beacon of Light target with Holy heals causes it to radiate outward, healing 3 nearby allies within 8 yards for 20% of the healing done.

Name: Guardians of the Grove
Description: Your Treants heal allies below 90% health using all of your known Druid healing spells, except Tranquility. Treants no longer deal damage and have 66% reduced health.  In battlegrounds or arenas, Treants only use instant-cast Druid healing spells.

Name: Guerilla Tactics
Description: Dealing damage with Mongoose Bite, Counterattack, or Wing Clip now grants you Guerilla Tactics.    Guerilla Tactics Damage done by your Savage Blade, Chimera Shot, Aimed Shot and Explosive Shot is increased by 10%. Lasts for 15 sec.

Name: Guile of Elune
Description: Your Shred, Mangle, Rake, Claw, Rip, and Ferocious Bite criticals have a chance to grant party members 2% Agility for 10 sec. Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Gul'dan's Chosen
Description: Shadow Bolt, Soul Fire and Incinerate have a 12% chance to grant Gul'dan's Chosen for 10 sec.    While active, Backdraft and Molten Core are not consumed.    This effect cannot trigger while Gul'dan's Chosen is active.

Name: Gurubashi Tactics
Description: Damaging abilities with a Rage cost other than Raging Blow grant a Raging Blow charge.  This effect can only occur once every 6 sec.

Name: Hammer of Storms
Description: Dealing damage with Thunder Clap or Hammer of the Righteous grants you Hammer of Storms.    Hammer of Storms Your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning and Stormstrike damage is increased by 25%.

Name: Hammerdin
Description: Damaging Paladin damaging abilities have a 20% chance to summon a Hammer from the Heavens and reduce the cooldown of Hour of Judgement by 4 seconds.    Hammer from the Heavens A Holy hammer falls from the heavens, dealing 17 to -19 Holy damage to nearby enemies.

Name: Harbinger of Plague
Description: Casting Wrath now grants you Harbinger of Plague.    While affected by Harbinger of Plague, Haunt deals 30% of its damage to 10 nearby targets.      Harbinger of Plague Increases the damage of your diseases and Haunt by 15%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts for 8 sec.

Name: Harmonized Zeal
Description: Healing with Holy spells reduces the cooldown of Nature's Swiftness by 4 seconds

Name: Harnessed Energy
Description: Arcane Blast now grants Harnessed Energy instead of applying its normal stacking debuff.    Harnessed Energy Increases the damage of your next Arcane spell by 25% and increases the mana cost of Arcane Blast by 400%.    Stores up to 5 charges and lasts for 10 sec. Arcane Blast does not consume charges.

Name: Harvest Essence
Description: Shadow spells with a cast time grant Harvested Essence.    Harvested Essence Next Drain Life or Drain Soul channels 10% faster and hits 10% faster. Stacks up to 5. Lasts 10 sec.    Reduces the heal onto the caster from the life leeched with Drain Life by 80%.

Name: Hastened Feint
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Feint ability by 4 seconds.

Name: Hastened Strikes
Description: Sweeping Strikes hits your primary target and increases your melee critical strike chance by 5%.  Successful melee attacks reduce the cooldown of Sweeping Strikes by 2 second.  This effect can only occur once every 1 sec.

Name: Healing Garden
Description: Your direct Nature heals now extend the durations of Lifebloom, Rejuvenation, and Regrowth on your allies by 1.5 second.

Name: Healing Seeds
Description: Healing Touch now applies Living Seed, if known, on non-critical heals.

Name: Heartchill
Description: This spell belongs to Necromancer    Chill an enemy's heart, interrupting their current spell cast.    Successfully interrupting a spell also reduces their movement speed and haste by 80% for 3 sec.

Name: Heat Burst
Description: Dealing Magic damage against enemies affected by your Conflagrate now deals an additional 66 Fire damage.  This effect can only occur once every 1 sec.

Name: Heating Up!
Description: Dealing direct damage with Conflagrate applies Heating Up!.    Heating Up! You deal 3% increased Fire damage to the target. Stacks up to 10 times and lasts for 15 sec.

Name: Heavy Arms
Description: Your Slam now deals 60% increased damage, has no rage cost and grants you Heavy Arms.      Heavy Arms Prevents you from casting Slam for 14 sec.    Dealing damage with Bloodthirst, Counterattack, Mongoose Bite or Whirlwind reduces the duration by 1 seconds.

Name: Heavyweight
Description: Using Overpower or Execute grants 2 stacks, and Slam grants 1 stack of Heavyweight stacking up to 6 times.    After reaching max stacks you gain Ready to Strike.    Ready to Strike Your next Mortal Strike deals 45% increased damage and has a 33% increased critical strike chance.     Your next Thunder Clap triggers a crushing blow, dealing 275% weapon damage to nearby enemies.

Name: Hellish Pursuit
Description: Dealing damage with Hellfire reduces the cooldown of Burning Rush by 1.5 seconds.

Name: Here Comes The Big One
Description: Every fourth use of Bloodthirst now deals 150% increased damage.

Name: Heretic of Gul'dan
Description: Dealing damage with spells reduces the cooldown of Hand of Gul'Dan by 0.5 sec.  This effect can only occur once every 1 sec.

Name: High Winds
Description: When your Cyclone ends, the target's damage and healing are reduced by 20% for 4 sec.

Name: Higher Power
Description: Increases the amount healed by Greater Heal by 20%, but increases its mana cost by 40%.

Name: Hippocratic Oath
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Increases your healing power by 20% of your attack power.

Name: Holy Ascension
Description: Periodic damage of your Holy Fire now has a 15% chance to trigger Surge of Light.    Instant Smites now grant Ascended.    Ascended Increases the holy critical strike chance by 1%. Stacks up to 10. Lasts 15 seconds.    Surge of Light Your next Smite or Flash Heal is instant and costs no mana. It cannot critically hit. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Holy Chains
Description: Your Holy Fire now shackles the target with heavy chains, reducing their movement speed by 70% for 3 sec.

Name: Holy Ground
Description: Allies within your Consecration receive 5% additional healing from you.    Your Direct Heals on allies within Consecration radiate to 5 nearby allies for 5% of the healing done.    Does not trigger from Purification by Light's or Consecrated Strikes's Consecration effect.

Name: Holy Guardian
Description: Increases your threat generated by Holy damage by 40%.  Reduces all damage taken by 2%.

Name: Holy Hammer Nova
Description: Casting Holy Nova now reduces the active cooldown of Light's Hammer by 2 seconds.

Name: Holy Radiance
Description: Your Greater Heal and Flash Heal now trigger Holy Radiance on all allies affected by your Renew.    Holy Radiance Heals for 30% of the healing done by your Greater Heal or 40% of the healing done by your Flash Heal.

Name: Holy Shatter
Description: Critical strikes with Frost spells and abilities mark your target.    Critical strikes with Holy spells and abilities shatter the mark, dealing 43 Holyfrost damage to 8 nearby enemies.    Marks stack up to 5 and increase the damage the target takes from Holy Shatter by 20%. Lasts 12 seconds.    Scales with Cone of Cold modifiers.

Name: Holy Spirit
Description: Healing or dealing damage with Penance grants you Holy Spirit.      Holy Spirit Increases the critical strike chance and healing of your next Holy Shock by 20%. Stacks 4 times and lasts 10 sec.

Name: Holy Surge
Description: Holy Shock deals 50% increased damage against monsters.    Dealing damage with Holy Shock grants you Surge of Light.    This effect can only occur once every 6 sec.    Surge of Light Your next Smite or Flash Heal is instant and costs no mana. It cannot critically hit. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Hot Hands
Description: Pyroblast and Arctis can now trigger Hot Streak.

Name: Howl of Winter
Description: Cone of Cold now grants you Howl of Winter.    Howl of Winter Increases the damage of your next Deep Freeze by 25%. Stacks up to 4 times and lasts 15 sec.

Name: Howling Blood
Description: Dealing damage with Frost Strike, Howling Blast or Icy Touch reduces the cooldown of Cold Blood by 8 seconds.  When Cold Blood is consumed, the cooldown of Deathchill is reduced by 40 sec.

Name: Hydra's Sting
Description: Dealing damage with Serpent Sting reduces the cooldown of Rapid Fire by 3 sec.

Name: Hydromancer
Description: Dealing damage with Frostbolt, Frostfire Bolt and Frost Nova applies Doused.  Water Nova summons a tidal pool for 6 sec, applying Doused to enemies that remain inside.    Doused Taking damage from Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning triggers Electrocute.   Electrocute Deals 6 Froststorm damage and incapacitates the target for 2 seconds.  The same enemy can only be incapacitated once every 30 sec.

Name: I Have The High Ground
Description: Deal an additional strike for 3% original damage when you have the high ground, being 5 yards above your target.

Name: I'm a Fan of Knives
Description: Dealing damage with Shuriken Toss and Deadly Throw has a 35% chance to increase the damage of your next Fan of Knives by 35% and its critical strike chance by 35%. Max 3 charges.

Name: Ice Barrage
Description: Dealing damage with Cone of Cold, Deep Freeze, Frostbolt, Frostfire Bolt and Ray of Frost grants you an Icicle that stacks up to 5 times and lasts for 20 sec.  Dealing damage with Ice Lance rapidly launches your stored Icicles at the target, dealing 407 Frost damage.  You cannot gain Icicles while they are launching.

Name: Ice Warden
Description: Increases your threat generated by Frost damage by 40%.  Reduces all damage taken by 2%.

Name: Icebound Ancestry
Description: Your attacks ignore Armor against Frozen targets.

Name: Icecrown Double-Tap
Description: Direct Frost spell damage has an 25% chance to grant Icecrown Double-Tap.      Icecrown Double-Tap Allows your next Kill Shot to be used regardless of the target's health. Lasts 20 sec.

Name: Icy Onslaught
Description: Icy Touch against a target affected by your Blood Plague empowers your next Rune Strike. Rune Strike deals 100% increased damage and reduces all damage you take by 8% for 6 sec.

Name: Illuminated Judgement
Description: Your Infusion of Light now grants Illuminated Judgement      Illuminated Judgement Your next Judgement spell deals 100% increased damage (30% against players) but has a 1.5 second cast time.

Name: Immolating Backdraft
Description: Casting Immolate can now trigger your Backdraft talent.

Name: Impeccable Timing
Description: Your mastery of time grants you Impeccable Timing every 10 seconds.    Impeccable Timing Your Arcane Blast, Starfire, Starsurge, Arcane Barrage, Fireball, Frostbolt, Slow, Frostfire Bolt, Moonfire, or Arcane Orb grants you Missile Barrage. Lasts 3 sec.    Missile Barrage Reduces the channeled duration of your next Arcane Missiles spell by 2.5 sec, reduces the mana cost by 100%, and the missiles fire every 0.4 sec. Lasts for 15 sec.

Name: Impending Doom
Description: Your Death and Decay, Mind Blast and Shadow Word: Death now apply Impending Doom.    Impending Doom Your next 5 periodic Shadow damage hits deal 25% increased damage.

Name: Imposing Combo
Description: Empowers these abilities to now consume combo points, increasing their threat and granting you a buff for 2 seconds plus an additional 2 seconds per combo point:    - Divine Storm increases your armor by 15%.  - Victory Rush increases your max health by 10%.  - Stormstrike reduces your damage taken by 6%.

Name: In For the Kill
Description: Increases the duration of Rend by 6 seconds, and your Mortal Strike refreshes the duration of your Rend.

Name: In Sword We Trust
Description: Casting Slam now grants you In Sword We Trust.    In Sword We Trust Increases your next Crusader Strike's damage and critical strike chance by 35%. Stacks up to 3 times and lasts 8 sec.

Name: In the Zone
Description: Dealing damage with Unfair Advantage now grants you a shield that absorbs magic damage.    This effect can only occur once every 4 sec.

Name: Incessant Screams
Description: Psychic Scream creates a shadowy image of you at your location. After 4 sec, the image will let out a Psychic Scream.

Name: Indomitable
Description: Unlocked by  Tactical Mastery (Rank 3)  While Stagger is active your healing taken is increased by 10%.    Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Inducing Trauma
Description: Your Backstab, Mutilate and Ambush extend the duration of your Rend by 2 sec.

Name: Inescapable Roots
Description: Your Entangling Roots become inescapable, preventing enemies from breaking free during the first half of their duration, but are now more susceptible to breaking from damage.

Name: Inevitable Decimation
Description: Casting 3 Incinerates within 5 sec reduces the cast time and global cooldown of your Soul Fire by 50%. Lasts 8 sec. Does not stack with Decimation.

Name: Inevitable Vengeance
Description: Your Seal of Vengeance damage over time now benefits from your haste and can now critically strike.  Your Seal of Vengeance damage over time effect also causes the target to take 1% more Physical and Holy damage per stack.

Name: Infecting Strikes
Description: Dealing damage with Maul now applies Infected Blood.      Infected Blood Disease the target, dealing 3 Plague damage every 2 seconds for 6 sec.

Name: Inferno
Description: Enemies hit by your Hellfire now have a chance to trigger an additional Hellfire explosion.

Name: Infinite Burn
Description: Dealing damage with Chaos Bolt, Incinerate, Searing Pain, and Scorch now grants you Infinite Burn.     Infinite Burn Your next Conflagrate does not consume Immolate. Lasts for 10 sec.

Name: Infused Gems
Description: Your Mana Gem also grants you 10% haste for 12 sec.    Your Mana Gem also triggers Replenishment.    Replenishment Replenishes 1% of maximum mana per 5 sec on up to 10 party members for 15 sec.

Name: Infused Shot
Description: Casting offensive Arcane Spells now grants you Infused Shot.    Infused Shot Next Arcane Shot consumes 5% of the base mana to deal 20% increased damage. Stacks 10 times. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Inner Hunt
Description: Non-hunter melee abilities grant Inner Hunt.    This effect can only occur once every 8 sec and only from abilities that trigger the global cooldown.    Inner Hunt Your next Mongoose Bite and Counterattack deals 60% increased damage, ignores 60% of the target's armor and does not trigger its cooldown. Lasts for 15 sec.    Mongoose Bite and Counterattacks damage is increased by 25% versus players.

Name: Insatiable
Description: Your Taste for Blood now stacks up to 3 times and increases your next Overpower's damage by an additional 15%.

Name: Instigator
Description: Your Ghostly Strike and Riposte abilities deal 20% increased damage when used on a target above 75% health.

Name: Jab Cross
Description: Dealing damage with Devastate increases the critical strike chance and damage of your next 2 spells or abilities by 10%.

Name: Jadefire Affliction
Description: Your Everlasting Affliction also triggers from Fireball, Incinerate or Soul Fire.

Name: Judge, Jury, Executioner
Description: Your Judgements now grant 30 rage and cause your next Execute to ignore 100% of the target's armor.

Name: Judged Infection
Description: Dealing damage with a Judgement increases the damage the target takes from your Blood Plague by 20% for 15 seconds.

Name: Judged Retaliation
Description: Your Judgements have a 50% chance to allow the use of Counterattack for 10 seconds and reset its cooldown.

Name: Judgement of Mercy
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Your Holy abilities and heals have a 25% chance to cause your next Judgement to heal 5 nearby allies within 40 yards of the target.    Judgement of Mercy's healing scales with Judgement damage modifiers.    Does not work while Seal of Fervor is active.

Name: Kindles for Holy Fire
Description: Dealing direct damage with Fire spells and abilities grants you Kindles for Holy Fire.      Kindles for Holy Fire Increases the direct damage of your next Holy Fire by 20%. Stacks up to 3 times and lasts for 15 sec.

Name: Knight of the Eclipse
Description: Dealing damage with Sinister Strike, Slam, or Whirlwind grants you Knight of the Eclipse.      Knight of the Eclipse Reduces the cast time of your next Wrath, Starfire or Starsurge by 50% and increases its damage by 15%. Against monsters, these spells deal an additional 20% damage per stack.  Stacks up to 2 times and lasts 12 sec.

Name: Lava Freeze
Description: Dealing damage with Lava Lash now grants you Solid Ice.     Solid Ice Increases the damage of Ice Lance, Cone of Cold, Frostbolt and Deep Freeze by 8%. Stacks up to 2 times and lasts 15 sec.

Name: Lava Rush
Description: Your Lava Lash ability has a 25% chance to grant your party 5% melee haste for 10 sec.

Name: Lava Surge
Description: Flame Shock damage over time has a 15% chance to reset the cooldown of Lava Burst.

Name: Leader of the Elements
Description: Dealing damage with Stormstrike or Lava Lash reduces the cooldown of your Greater Elemental Totems by 10 seconds.  Casting Shaman Shocks or Elemental Blast grants your Greater Elementals and Tether Elemental Leader of the Elements. This effect can only occur once every 20 sec from the same spell.   Leader of the Elements Increases the damage your Greater Elementals deal by 30% and your Tethered Elemental does by 15%. Stacks up to 4 times and lasts 10 sec.

Name: Legacy of the Arcanist
Description: Dealing direct damage with Arcane, Fire, Frost, and Nature empowers your next Meteor cast with its own element.  Casting Meteor unleashes the stored elements, causing 185 damage to the target and up to 2 additional targets.  |nWhen casting spells involving multiple elements, only the Meteor corresponding to the first element in the order of Fire, Nature, Frost, and Arcane will trigger.

Name: Lesser Frozen Light
Description: Your direct Holy heals now apply Lesser Frozen Light.    Lesser Frozen Light Increases the healing received from your Cryotherapist by 10%. Lasts for 16 sec.

Name: Lich's Calling
Description: Dealing damage with Cone of Cold, Deep Freeze or Howling Blast afflicts your target with Lich's Calling.      Lich's Calling Increase the effectiveness of your Frost periodic effects on the target by 30%. Has 8 charges. Lasts 15 sec.

Name: Light of Life
Description: Halo heals allies hit for 3 every 2 sec for 6 sec and extends the duration of Renew by 6 sec.    Direct Holy heals reduce the cooldown of Halo by 2 sec.    Renew cannot be extended past its maximum duration.

Name: Lightning Discharge
Description: While casting Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning, your Lightning Shield deals double damage and releases pure energy, stunning nearby enemies for 2.50 sec.    This effect can only occur once every 20 sec.

Name: Lightning Eclipses
Description: Solar Eclipse increases the damage of Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning by 25%.    Lunar Eclipse increases the critical strike chance of Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning by 25%.    Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning extend Solar Eclipse and Lunar Eclipse by 0.3 sec.

Name: Lightning Rod
Description: Requires  Path of Healing Dealing damage with Lightning Bolt now applies Lightning Rod and your Living Lightning critical strikes and healing grant you charges of Living Lightning Rod.    Lightning Rod Critically healing an ally with a direct Nature heal strikes your Lightning Rod with a Lightning Bolt.    Only one target can be affected by Lightning Rod at a time. This effect cannot trigger from periodic, or channeled spells.   Living Lightning Rod Increases the damage of your next Lightning Bolt or Lightning Rod strike by 100%. Stores up to 5 charges and lasts for 12 sec.    Living Lightning can grant multiple charges per cast.

Name: Lightning Strikes Twice
Description: Removes the cooldown on Chain Lightning, but reduces its damage dealt by 10%.

Name: Locust Ranger
Description: When Steady Shot hits a target stung by your Serpent Sting it triggers your Wild Quiver talent.

Name: Locust Resurgence
Description: Casting Steady Shot now reduces the cooldown of Chimera Shot by 1 seconds.

Name: Low Tide
Description: Increases your chance to critically heal your Riptide target with Nature spells by 20%.

Name: Lunar Explosion
Description: Periodic Moonfire damage has a 10% chance to grant you Lunar Explosion.    Lunar Explosion Your next Arcane Explosion has 100% increased critical strike chance.

Name: Lunar Fire
Description: Dealing direct Fire damage can now trigger Eclipse (Lunar).

Name: Lunar Frenzy
Description: Entering Lunar or Solar Eclipse now grants you Owlkin Frenzy.    Owlkin Frenzy While in Moonkin Form, attacks against you have an 8% chance to trigger a Frenzy, increasing your damage done by 5%.     This also grants immunity to casting pushback for Balance spells and restores 2% base mana every 2 sec. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Lunar Marksmanship
Description: During Eclipse (Lunar), Arcane Shot has 50% reduced cooldown and has 30% increased critical strike chance.

Name: Lunar Spirits
Description: Your Arcane Missile strikes against enemies affected by your Moonfire unleash Lunar Spirits on 5 nearby enemies within 10 yards.      Lunar Spirits Burns the enemy for 9 Arcane damage every 3 for 9 sec.

Name: Lunar Synergy
Description: Dealing damage with Arcane Missiles can now trigger Lunar Eclipse or extend its duration by 0.5 and duration of Owlkin Frenzy by 0.3 seconds.

Name: Lurking Shadow
Description: Increases your threat generated by Shadow damage by 40%.  Reduces all damage taken by 2%.

Name: Lycan Claws
Description: Dealing damage with Rake, Rip, Pounce or Arugal's Gift now has a 100% chance to deal an additional 2 Shadow damage and grants you Mind Shock.    Lycan Claws deal 100% increased damage while in Worgen Form.    Mind Shock Resets the cooldown of Mind Blast and your next Mind Blast costs no mana and has no cooldown.

Name: Madness of the Old Gods
Description: Summoning Tentacle of the Old Gods grants you Madness of the Old Gods.    Madness of the Old Gods Whispers of madness increase all damage done by 5%. Lasts 15 sec.

Name: Maelstrom
Description: Dealing damage with Lightning Overload from Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning grants one stack of Maelstrom. Dealing damage with Stormstrike and Lava Burst grants two.      Maelstrom Upon reaching 40 stacks, casting Earth Shock grants Unleashed Maelstrom.    Unleashed Maelstrom Your critical strikes from Lava Burst, direct Shaman Nature damage spells and abilities shock the target for an additional 70% of your spell's damage.

Name: Magical Ammunition
Description: Damaging spells grant you Magical Ammunition.      Magical Ammunition Increases the amount of your next Multi-Shot projectiles by 1. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 15 sec.

Name: Maledictive Assault
Description: Requires  Bear Form (Shapeshift) While Nightfall or Backlash is active, your Shadow Bolt can be cast while in Bear Form and hits two additional targets for reduced damage.

Name: Mana Leech
Description: Your Mana Burn eliminates 30% more mana, but deals 30% less damage, with a 30% higher mana cost and an additional 8 second cooldown.

Name: Martial Crescendo
Description: Each unique direct damage Physical ability now grants you Martial Crescendo.      Martial Crescendo Increases your Attack Speed by 6%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts for 8 sec. Dealing magic damage resets all stacks. The duration cannot be refreshed.

Name: Mass Killing Spree
Description: Killing Spree hits also deal weapon damage to 5 nearby enemies.

Name: Massacre
Description: Killing Spree applies Massacre to all targets hit.  Killing an enemy that grants experience or honor decreases the cooldown of Killing Spree by 10 seconds.    Massacre Increases your damage dealt to the target by 3%, stacks up to 5 times and lasts 15 sec.    Deals 1% increased damage against players

Name: Master Assassin
Description: While Shadow Dance is active your Garrote hits 4 nearby targets. Activating Shadow Dance increases the damage of your Rogue bleed effects by 20% for 12 seconds.

Name: Master of Arms
Description: After using Overpower, Slam or Execute you gain Mortal Arms.      Mortal Arms Your next Mortal Strike increases your Armor Penetration rating by 7% of your Strength per stack for 12 sec. Stacks up to 2.

Name: Master of Kunai
Description: Using Adrenaline Rush grants Master of Kunai.    Using Shuriken Toss reduces the cooldown of Adrenaline Rush by 3 sec.      Master of Kunai Your Shuriken Toss and Glaive Toss hit an additional 2 targets. Lasts 20 sec.    Hitting an enemy with Shuriken Toss increases the damage of your next Deadly Throw or Glaive Toss by 70%, stacking up to 3 times.    Increases damage against players by 5% per stack.

Name: Master of Shadows
Description: Direct critical strikes with Sinister Strike, Gloomblade and Ambush now grant you Apprentice of Shadows.    Apprentice of Shadows Using Rupture and Eviscerate consume 3 stacks to grant you Master of Shadows. Stacks up to 3 times and lasts for 8 sec.    Master of Shadows Increases Shadow damage dealt by 18% and Shadow spell critical strike chance by 10%. Lasts 12 sec.

Name: Master's Meatshield
Description: Your Drain Life also heals your Tamed Pet.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin or Tether Elemental, and Tame Beast.

Name: Mastery of the Tide
Description: Your Riptide no longer gets consumed.

Name: Melting Core
Description: Dealing periodic Fire damage now has a 3% chance to grant you Molten Core.    Molten Core Increases the duration of your Immolate by 9 sec, and you have a 12% chance to gain the Molten Core effect when your Corruption deals damage. The Molten Core effect empowers your next 3 Incinerate or Soul Fire spells cast within 15 sec.    Incinerate - Increases damage done by 18% and reduces cast time by 30%.    Soul Fire - Increases damage done by 18% and increases critical strike chance by 15%.

Name: Mending Hands
Description: Lay on Hands now affects all allies within an 8-yard radius but has a 2 second cast time.

Name: Mending Tide
Description: Requires  Path of Healing Riptide now applies Mending Tides.  Healing with Mending Tides applies Mending Chains.  Only one target can be affected by Mending Tides at a time.   Mending Tide Heals the target and 5 nearby allies within 8 yards for 7 every two seconds for 6 sec.   Mending Chains Your Chain Heal deals 15% increased healing to the target. Lasts 3 sec.

Name: Methodical Approach
Description: Backstab, Ambush and Hemorrhage now ignores up to 30% of the target's armor.

Name: Midnight Flames
Description: Dealing direct damage with Fireball, Fire Blast and Pyroblast now applies Midnight Flames.    Midnight Flames Your Immolate and Shadowflame deal 15% increased damage. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts for 12 sec. Conflagrate consumes this effect.

Name: Mind Core
Description: When you gain Molten Core you also gain Mind Core.    Mind Core Your next Mind Blast deals 40% increased damage and reduces the cooldown of Void Eruption by 6 seconds. Lasts for 30 sec.

Name: Molten Ammo
Description: Explosive Shot empowers Steady Shot, Multi-Shot, and Aimed Shot causing them to deal extra Fire damage for 5 sec.

Name: Molten Earth
Description: Your Lava Lash releases Molten Earth on the ground.    Molten Earth Burns enemies in the area, dealing 61 Fire damage every second for 8 sec.    This uses Fire Nova modifiers.

Name: Molten Outburst
Description: Dealing damage to an enemy standing in your Earthquake with a non-instant Fire spell causes an eruption, dealing 6 Fire damage to nearby enemies and knocking players into the air.    This effect can only occur once every 10 sec.

Name: Momentum
Description: Grappling Hook now grants you Momentum.    Momentum Your movement speed is increased by 40% and the damage of your Rogue abilities is increased by 10% for 6 sec.

Name: Mongoose Fury
Description: Dealing damage with Mongoose Bite grants you Mongoose Fury.    Mongoose Fury Your next Execute deals 35% more damage and can be cast regardless of the target's health. Lasts 8 sec.

Name: Mortal Wounds
Description: Your Mortal Strike now slows targets by 35% for 6 sec if they have above 50% health.

Name: Multi-Multi-Shot
Description: Your Multi-Shot and Focused Burst fire 3 additional projectiles.

Name: Mystic Companion
Description: Your Tamed Pet's auto attacks now deal Arcane damage.    Your Tamed Pet's auto attacks can only be transformed to one damage type at once.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.

Name: Mystical Pursuit
Description: Dealing damage with Arcane Missiles grants 2 charges of Mystical Pursuit, up to 5 charges. Your next Seal of Arcane Wrath also triggers from your off-hand weapon.

Name: Natural Destruction
Description: Nature's Grace also grants you Natural Destruction.      Natural Destruction Critically striking with Fire spells consumes a stack to grant 20% spell haste for 4 sec. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 30 sec.    Does not stack with Nature's Grace.

Name: Natural Disaster
Description: Increases your threat generated by Nature damage by 40%.  Reduces all damage taken by 2%.

Name: Natural Energy
Description: Your Mutilate critical strikes restore 5 energy and an additional 10 energy over 3 sec.

Name: Natural Penance
Description: Critical heals with direct Nature spells reduce the active cooldown of Penance by 1 second.

Name: Natural Selection
Description: Casting Sinister Strike, Wrath, Starfire and Starsurge extends the duration of Insect Swarm on your target by 1.5 seconds.    This can occur up to 15 times before this effect goes on 15 sec cooldown.    Additionally, Insect Swarm now benefits from spell haste.

Name: Natural Synergy
Description: Your direct Shaman heals now increase your next Regrowth's direct healing and critical chance by 15%. Stacks up to 4 times and lasts 15 sec.    Can trigger only once per cast.

Name: Natural Zeal
Description: Your Nature heals reduce Divine Favor's cooldown by 2 seconds.

Name: Nature's Fervor
Description: When you fully apply Lacerate to an enemy, you gain Nature's Fervor.    Nature's Fervor Empowers your next ability:  Mangle (Bear): Reduces the target's armor by 20% for 20 sec.    Faerie Fire (Feral): Reduces your physical damage taken by 10% for 8 sec.    Lacerate: Next application deals 100% increased direct damage and increases the threat generated from Physical sources by 8% for 10 sec.

Name: Nature's Flow
Description: Critically healing with a direct Shaman spell reduces the cooldown of your Nature's Swiftness by 3 seconds.

Name: Necromancer's Touch
Description: Your Dominate Undead, Enslave Demon or Summoned Ghoul pet's attacks now afflicts targets with Necromancer's Touch.    Necromancer's Touch Increases damage dealt to the target with your next Drain Life and Drain Soul by 5%  and your Grave Coil by 5%. Stacks up to 10 times and lasts 8 sec.

Name: New Moon
Description: Damaging non-instant spell casts increase the duration of your Moonfire by 1 sec.

Name: Nightmare Mauling
Description: Dealing damage with Maul and Mangle (Bear) now applies Corruption.    Dealing damage with Swipe (Bear) drains life from targets afflicted by your Corruption.

Name: Northern Winds
Description: Frost Shock increases your movement speed by 30% for 3 sec, but no longer slows your target.

Name: Nurtured Embers
Description: Increases the duration of your Flamestrike ability by 2 seconds.

Name: On the Hunt
Description: Increases the duration of Mend Pet by 6 sec. Mend Pet increases the damage of your Tamed Pet by 15%.  Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.

Name: One with the Forest
Description: Your melee critical strikes while in Bear Form extend Barkskin's duration by 1 second.  This effect can only occur once every 1 sec.

Name: One With The Light
Description: Sacrifice your physical self, reducing Physical damage dealt by 35% to empower your Crusader Strike and Divine Storm, causing them to deal additional Holy damage and gain additional Holy power scaling.    This effect can be toggled on and off.    Reduces physical damage versus players by 30%.

Name: Onslaught
Description: Using Colossus Smash now grants you Onslaught.    Onslaught Your next Execute can be used regardless of the target's health, and its damage is increased by 40%.

Name: Overflow
Description: Your direct Nature heals with a cast time also heal an additional party or raid member within 8 yards for 30% of the healing done.

Name: Overflowing Cultivation
Description: Your Overflowing also causes Chain Heal to apply Living Seed.

Name: Overflowing Grace
Description: Your Overflowing also causes your next Chain Heal to grant Nature's Grace.    Nature's Grace Increases your haste by 20% for 4 sec.

Name: Overload Mastery
Description: Your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning have a 22% chance to instantly cast a second time on the target for half damage. This can also trigger from Lightning Overload and similar effects.

Name: Overwhelming Rage
Description: Your maximum rage is increased by 100.

Name: Pack Alpha
Description: Summoning Feral Spirits grants you Pack Alpha.    Dealing damage with Stormstrike or Lava Lash extends Pack Alpha's duration by 1 seconds and reduces Feral Spirit's cooldown by 3 seconds.      Pack Alpha Haste increased by 20%. Lasts for 8 sec.

Name: Pack Enhancement
Description: Dealing damage with Shaman Weapon Enhancements grants you Commands. These stack up to 5 times and last 30 sec. Casting Feral Spirits consumes your Commands, empowering your Feral Spirits based on the Command stacks consumed.    Command of Precision Granted from dealing damage with Flametongue Weapon.   Consuming this increases critical strike chance of your Feral Spirits by 10% per stack for 30 sec.   Command of Might Granted from dealing damage with Frostbrand Weapon.   Consuming this increases damage of your Feral Spirits by 10% per stack for 30 sec   Command of Fury Granted from dealing damage with Windfury Weapon.   Consuming this increases haste of your Feral Spirits by 10% per stack for 30 sec.

Name: Pack Leader
Description: When Maelstrom Weapon is consumed at max stacks, you gain Pack Leader.  Pack Leader reduces the healing from Spirit Wolves by 70%.    Pack Leader Increases the duration of your next Feral Spirits by 2 sec.   Increases the amount of Feral Spirits spawned by 1. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 25 sec.

Name: Pack Tactics
Description: Dealing damage with combo point generating abilities now grants your Tamed Pet Pack Tactics.      Pack Tactics Increases your Tamed Pet's damage by 5% and reduces their damage taken by 8%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 10 sec.    Deals 15% additional damage against players.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin or Tether Elemental, and Tame Beast.

Name: Paragon of Light
Description: Dealing direct damage with Holy spells increases your spell critical strike chance by 1%. Stacks up to 10 times. Lasts 15 sec.   At max stacks, the duration cannot be refreshed.

Name: Pendulum
Description: Receive 3% spell haste while above 50% mana and 3% spell critical strike chance while below 50% mana.

Name: Penitent Reload
Description: Dealing damage with Penance makes your next Steady Shot instant. Holds up to 3 charges.

Name: Perforation
Description: When your Rend deals damage, it increases the duration of your Garrote by 1 second.

Name: Permafrost Wound
Description: Deep Freeze also causes the target to bleed for 270 Froststrike damage over 9 seconds.     Dealing damage with Mongoose Bite or Raptor Strike extends the bleed by 1 sec.

Name: Pestilent Reprisal
Description: Using Obliterate causes your next Counterattack within 15 sec to deal 20% increased damage for each of your diseases on the target.

Name: Phalanx Strike
Description: Damaging Rogue combo point generators grant you Phalanx Strike.    Phalanx Strike Increases the damage of Shield Strike by 15% and Javelin by 15%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 15 sec.    The duration is not refreshed when gaining stacks.

Name: Photosynthesis
Description: While your Lifebloom is on an ally, your nature periodic heals on them have a 10% chance to cause it to bloom. Lifeblooms bloomed this way do not get consumed.    This effect does not trigger when Lifebloom is on yourself

Name: Physics in Practice
Description: Your Deadly Throw and Shuriken Toss deal increased damage based on the movement speed bonus of your active Sprint.    The damage increase is 15% as effective versus players.

Name: Pious Strikes
Description: Your Hammer of the Righteous and Avenger's Shield unleash Pious Strikes on the first target hit.    Pious Strikes Light explodes from the target, dealing -94 Holy damage to enemies and -7 Holy healing to allies within 10 yards.    This uses Holy Nova modifiers and causes no threat.

Name: Plague Bearer
Description: Dealing damage with Mangle (Bear) now applies Rabies.      Rabies The target takes 1 increased Physical damage from all sources, 5% increased damage from you. Lasts for 15 sec.

Name: Plagueblade Technique
Description: Plague Strike afflicts the target with Plagueblade.      Plagueblade Increases poison and disease damage you deal to this target by 5% per stack. Stacks up to 3 times. Lasts 15 sec.

Name: Poison Bomb Combo
Description: Casting Eviscerate, Envenom, Poison Nova, or Crimson Tempest reduces the remaining cooldown of Poison Bomb by 4 seconds and grants you a stack of Poison Bomb Counter.      Poison Bomb Combo Causes your Poison Bomb to deal 19 Nature damage   This damaged is increased by each Poison Bomb Combo stacks stacking up to 3 times.

Name: Power of Generosity
Description: Casting Power Infusion on an ally grants you Power of Generosity.    Power of Generosity Infuses yourself with power, increasing spell casting speed by 10% and reducing the mana cost of all spells by 10%.  Lasts 15 sec.

Name: Power Overwhelming
Description: Dealing direct damage with spells and abilities now reduces the cooldown of your Arcane Power and Presence of Mind by 1.5 seconds.    This can only occur from abilities that trigger the global cooldown.

Name: Prayers of the Penitent
Description: Casting Prayer of Healing immediately after Penance will now unleash a Penance missile that bounces 4 nearby enemies.    This effect can only occur once every 6 sec.

Name: Precision Impact
Description: Casting Meteor, Fireball and Pyroblast has a 20% chance to reset the cooldown of your Meteor.

Name: Predator's Focus
Description: Casting Wrath in Cat Form now restores 20 energy and additional 10 energy every 2 sec over 4 seconds.

Name: Predator's Wrath
Description: Casting Wrath now grants you Predator's Wrath.    Predator's Wrath Your Cat Form abilities deal an additional 4 Nature damage. Lasts 6 sec.    Deals increased damage for single target abilities.

Name: Preservation
Description: Prayer of Preservation now grants Preservation to injured allies.    Preservation Your next direct heal on this ally consumes Preservation, healing 3 nearby additional allies for 14 each, granting Shield of Preservation and reducing the cooldown of Prayer of Preservation by 3 sec. Lasts for 10 sec.   Shield of Preservation Reduces the damage taken from area of effect attacks by 30%. Lasts for 3 sec.

Name: Primal Frenzy
Description: Dealing damage with Rip and Rake now has a 15% chance to increase your damage done by 8%. Lasts for 10 sec.

Name: Primal Tide
Description: Every fourth cast of Riptide grants you Primal Tide.    Primal Tide Your next Riptide applies to 2 additional nearby allies and its duration is increased by 12 seconds.

Name: Primordial Aftershocks
Description: Your Elemental Blast and Lava Burst critical strikes now reduce the cooldown of your Shaman Shocks by 6 seconds.

Name: Primordial Fury
Description: When Maelstrom Weapon is consumed at max stacks, you gain Primordial Fury.    Primordial Fury Your critical strikes with direct damage abilities and spells now consume 50 rage to deal 50% weapon damage plus 3 as Elemental damage.

Name: Prison Tactics
Description: Dealing damage with Shiv grants you Prison Tactics.    Prison Tactics Your next two combo point generating Rogue abilities have 35% increased armor penetration, and cost 10% less energy, except for Shiv. Lasts for 10 sec.

Name: Prophet of Wrath
Description: Dealing direct damage with Arcane spells extends the duration of Divine Illumination by 0.5 seconds.    Crusader Strike, Divine Storm and Judgement casts extend it by 1 seconds.    Casting Smite, Holy Fire and Holy Shock now reduces the cooldown of Divine Illumination by 3 seconds.

Name: Prophetic Focus
Description: Damaging hits with Smite, Holy Fire and Penance reduce the cooldown of Inner Focus by 3 seconds.  Inner Focus grants 10 stacks of Dominant Shield, but has a base 3 minute cooldown.  The cooldown can only be reduced by Penance every 2 sec.   Dominant Shield Increases the amount absorbed by your next Power Word: Shield by 15%, but reduces its duration by 1 sec. Stacks up to 10 times. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Providing for Nature
Description: Casting Entangling Roots, Mass Entanglement, Nature's Grasp, or Hypnosis now grants you Nature's Grace.    Nature's Grace Increases your haste by 20% for 4 sec.

Name: Psychic Influence
Description: Channeling Mind Flay now causes your target to take 30% increased damage from your Shadow Word: Pain, Devouring Plague and Vampiric Touch.

Name: Punisher
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of Riposte by 15%.     Riposte now afflicts players with Unrelenting Assault and interrupts creature spellcasting.    This effect can only occur once every 20 sec.    Unrelenting Assault Healing and magical damage done reduced by 50%. Lasts for 6 sec.

Name: Pure Shadow
Description: Casting Shadow Bolt, Shadowburn and Shadow Word: Death draws power from your enemies, granting you Pure Shadow.     Pure Shadow Increases your Shadow critical strike chance and Shadow damage done by 1%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 18 sec.

Name: Purification By Light
Description: Your direct weapon damage based spells and abilities now have a chance to exorcise the target, dealing 31 Holy damage and consecrating the ground beneath them, dealing 5 Holy damage to enemies in the area every second for 8 sec.    This uses Exorcism and Consecration modifiers

Name: Pyroclasmic Ignition
Description: Increases the damage of your Explosive Shot by 20% against targets afflicted by your Living Bomb.

Name: Pyroclasmic Shadows
Description: While Pyroclasm is active, your Shadow Bolt now deals 25% increased damage.    Shadow Bolt deals 15% increased damage against players.

Name: Pyrolysis
Description: Dealing damage with Pyroblast refreshes the duration of your Corruption.

Name: Pyroshot
Description: Pyroblast now grants you Fiery Shrapnel.    Fiery Shrapnel Your next 4 Aimed Shots, Chimera Shots, or Kill Shots unleash fiery shrapnel triggering your Living Bomb's explosion without consuming it. This effect lasts for 20 sec.

Name: Quick Burn
Description: Your melee strikes have a chance to grant you Quick Burn.    Quick Burn The cast time of your next Mana Burn is reduced by 75%. Lasts 8 sec.

Name: Quick on Your Feet
Description: Using Heroic Leap, Colossus Smash or Warbreaker grants you Quick on Your Feet.    Quick on Your Feet Increases your movement speed by 60% for 3 sec.

Name: Radiant Renewal
Description: Reduces the mana cost of Renew by 50% and increases its periodic healing by 20%.

Name: Ragefire Cleave
Description: When you Cleave an enemy affected by your Fireball or Ignite you gain Ragefire.    Ragefire Your Attack speed is increased by 2%, stacks up to 6 times and lasts 12 sec.     While at max stacks, your next Cleave is infused with ragefire, dealing additional weapon damage plus 15 as Fire.

Name: Raging Momentum
Description: Using Death Wish, Hunger for Blood, Bloodrage, Recklessness, Berserker Rage or Bestial Wrath will now randomly reduce the cooldown of one of the other abilities by 3 seconds.    Abilities can be chosen even if they're not on cooldown or known.

Name: Raging Onslaught
Description: Raging Blow deals 40% increased damage, and has a 20% chance to refund a charge.

Name: Raging Riptide
Description: Casting Healing Rain will trigger 139 Nature healing on all targets affected by your Riptide.

Name: Raging Thunder
Description: Reduces the cost of your Thunder Clap ability by 2 rage points and increases its radius by 10%.

Name: Raincaller
Description: Your nature periodic healing over time has a 25% chance to reduce the cooldown of Healing Rain by 1 second.

Name: Raising Hell
Description: When you cast Hellfire, your summoned demon unleashes its own Hellfire.

Name: Rapid Bloodthirst
Description: Reduces the global cooldown of Bloodthirst by 33%.

Name: Rapid Shatter
Description: You can now immediately follow-up Frostbolt while it is still in the air with another Mage spell, increasing its damage done by 45%.

Name: Raptor's Fury
Description: Dealing damage with Colossus Smash, Counterattack, Execute, and Savage Blade resets the cooldown of Raptor Strike.

Name: Raptured Essence
Description: The mana returned to you from your Rapture is increased by 100%.

Name: Razor-sharp Claws
Description: Your Maul ability now refreshes the duration of Rake on your target.

Name: Ready for Mayhem
Description: Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per combo point to grant Ready for Mayhem.      Ready for Mayhem Reduces the cast time of your next Soul Fire by 2 second. Stacks up to 2. Lasts 12 seconds.

Name: Ready to Demolish!
Description: Consuming max stacks of Demolish empowers your next ability:    - Expose Armor: Increases your armor penetration by 20% for 15 sec.    - Counterattack: Hits 4 additional targets and ignores 100% armor.    - Mongoose Bite: Triggers no cooldown, deals 125% increased damage against monsters, and is guaranteed to critically strike.

Name: Reaping Gallows
Description: Execute deals 40% more damage against targets below 35% health and 80% more damage against targets below 10% health.

Name: Redeeming Verdict
Description: Paladin heals have 25% increased healing and critical effect chance on allies affected by your Execution Sentence.

Name: Refilling the Well
Description: Your direct Holy healing spells reduce the cooldown of Lightwell by 3 seconds.

Name: Rejuvenating Swiftness
Description: Your Swiftmend casts now increase the healing of your Rejuvenations by 40% for 10 sec.    Your Swiftmend now reduces the cooldown of your Spirit of the Forest by 5 sec.

Name: Relentless Laceration
Description: Your Lacerate can stack 3 additional times, and its damage over time effect now benefits from melee haste.

Name: Relentless Reflexes

Description: Increases the duration of your Force of Nature ability by 5 seconds.

Name: TIMBERRR
Description: Increases treants summoned by your Force of Nature by 3.    When used with Guardians of the Grove, reduces their healing done by 20%.

Name: Timed Charge
Description: Returning with Alter Time causes energy from the time rift to explode, dealing 456 Arcane damage and stunning nearby enemies for 3 sec.

Name: Titan's Fury
Description: Using Titanic Strike grants Titan's Fury.      Titan's Fury Increases your melee attack speed by 150% but burns all your rage, energy and runes for 4 seconds.    This can not occur more than once every 12 seconds

Name: Tools of War
Description: Each unique direct damage Physical ability now grants you Tools of War.      Tools of War Increases Physical damage dealt by 3%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts for 8 sec. Dealing magic damage resets all stacks. The duration cannot be refreshed.

Name: Torrential Riptide
Description: Effective direct heals with Downpour grant you Torrential Riptide.   Torrential Riptide Increases the direct heal of your next Riptide by 25%, its critical heal chance by 8%, and causes it to reduce the cooldown of your Downpour by 1 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 10 sec.

Name: Toss and Throw
Description: Using Deadly Throw causes your next three casts of Shuriken Toss or Glaive Toss to generate an additional combo point, cost 20% fewer resources and deal 70% more damage against monsters. Lasts 8 sec.

Name: Total Lunar Eclipse
Description: Lunar Eclipse now increases your Arcane damage by 20%.

Name: Total Solar Eclipse
Description: Solar Eclipse also increases your critical chance with Nature spells by 20%.

Name: Totem Master: Fire
Description: Your Fire Totems now gain 15% of your health, but their mana cost is increased by 200%.    Your Magma totem lasts 30% longer.

Name: Totemic Avatar
Description: Reduces the cooldown of Greater Elemental Totems by 50%.

Name: Touchy Topic
Description: Dealing damage with your Water Elemental's Freeze now grants you Fingers of Frost.    Fingers of Frost Your spells and abilities treat the target as if it were Frozen. Holds 2 charges. Lasts for 15 seconds.

Name: Toxic Strikes
Description: Dealing damage with Instant Poison grants you Toxic Strikes.    Critical strikes with Instant Poison grant you Hydra's Fang.      Toxic Strikes Slam, Overpower and Mortal Strike consume your Toxic Strikes stacks to deal 10% increased damage per stack. Stacks up to 10 times. Lasts 12 sec.    Hydra's Fang Slam, Overpower and Mortal Strike consume 3 stacks to deal 4 additional Nature damage. Stacks up to 12 times and lasts 12 sec.

Name: Transcendental Embrace
Description: Critical healing with Lesser Healing Wave, Healing Wave, Regrowth, and Healing Touch now grant you Transcendental Embrace.      Transcendental Embrace Your next Chain Heal has 10% increased critical strike chance, 15% reduced cast time, and jumps to an additional ally. Stacks up to 2 times and lasts 20 sec.

Name: Transference of Guilt
Description: Your Righteous Defense ability now transfers 10% more of your allies threat to you.

Name: Trauma Care
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per combo point to grant you Trauma Care.    Trauma Care Makes your next Greater Heal instant. Can hold up to 2 charges and lasts for 16 sec.

Name: Traumatic Wounds
Description: Dealing damage with Claw, Shred, Ravage, Mangle (Cat) and Bloodthirst extends the duration of Rip and Rake by 2 seconds.

Name: Treant Cultivation
Description: Casting Swiftmend reduces the cooldown of Force of Nature by 6 seconds.

Name: Tribal Rage
Description: Your melee criticals reduce the cooldown of Shamanistic Rage by 1 seconds.    Your direct damaging spell criticals extend the duration of Shamanistic Rage by 1 seconds.

Name: Trick Shots
Description: Multi-Shot now grants you Trick Shot when hitting 3 or more targets.      Trick Shot Your next Aimed Shot, Kill Shot or Arcane Shot ricochets to 5 nearby enemies, losing momentum with every target hit. Lasts for 6 sec.

Name: Trisolaris
Description: Fireball and Pyroblast tick one additional time and their damage over time effect can now stack up to 4 times.

Name: Troll Sweat
Description: Killing a player gives you a permanent stack of troll sweat. This tells heroes how sweaty you are. All sweat is lost on death. Accumulate enough sweat and reap the rewards.   If it Troll Sweats it Troll Sweats.

Name: Tundra Tracker
Description: Hunter shots now grant a stack of Tundra Tracker. Steady Shot grants 3 stacks.     Reaching 9 stacks consumes Tundra Tracker, granting Fingers of Frost if known. Lasts for 12 sec.    The duration of Tundra Tracker cannot be refreshed.

Name: Turning Tides
Description: For each enemy hit by your Typhoon the duration of your Riptide is increased by 4 seconds.

Name: Twilight Eruption
Description: Dealing damage with Mind Blast or Haunt reduces the remaining cooldown of Lava Burst by 1 sec. Dealing damage with Lava Burst extends your Unstable Affliction and Vampiric Touch on the target by 1 sec.

Name: Twilight Paragon
Description: Exorcism now consumes Paragon of Light to trigger Twilight Treason, increasing its damage by 15% per stack and transforms you into a Paragon of Darkness for 1 second per stack.      Twilight Treason Deals 62 Twilight damage to the target.    Paragon of Darkness Your Mind Flay, Mind Sear and Penance torment the target, dealing 43 additional Twilight damage. In addition, you gain 10% spell critical strike chance.

Name: Twin Fangs
Description: Raptor Strike, Mongoose Bite and Counterattack have a 50% chance to trigger Twin Fang, dealing 100% of the damage dealt as Physical damage.    Requires one-handed weapons and a weapon equipped in your off hand.

Name: Twist of Faith
Description: Using Seal of Righteousness, Seal of Command, Seal of Vengeance, Seal of Fervor, or Seal of Arcane Wrath while a different one of these seals is already active grants you the previously active seal for 10 sec.  These seals cost no mana but have a 10 second cooldown.

Name: Umbral Wounds
Description: While in Shadowform, your Deep Wounds deal Shadowstrike damage but no longer a bleed.

Name: Unchained
Description: Your Blink now slows nearby enemies by 50% for 2 sec.

Name: Undaunted
Description: Your Last Stand now sacrifices 5% of its maximum health granted to remove your Stagger debuff, clearing all stored damage.

Name: Unholy Commander
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Summon Gargoyle by 60 sec.    While your Gargoyle is active, Grave Coil commands it to fire Gargoyle's Wrath at your target.      Gargoyle's Wrath Deals 120 Plague damage and chains to nearby enemies.

Name: Unseen Assassin
Description: For 3 sec after leaving Stealth or activating Shadow Dance, your Glaive Toss, Deadly Throw and Shuriken Toss only triggers a 0.5 sec global cooldown and deal 40% increased damage against monsters.    Deadly Throw and Shuriken Toss deal 30% reduced damage against players whilst affected by Unseen Assassin

Name: Unstoppable Force
Description: Your Slam is now guaranteed to critically hit when used on an Incapacitated or Immobilized target.

Name: Upper Hand
Description: When one of your Hunter traps triggers, your next Rogue ability critically strikes.

Name: Ursine Frenzy
Description: Dealing damage with Thrash and Lacerate has a 10% chance to grant you Ursine Frenzy.    This effect can only occur once every 10 sec.      Ursine Frenzy Increases the damage of Mangle (Bear) by 15%. Stacks up to 3 times. Lasts 5 sec.    While Ursine Frenzy is active Mangle (Bear) has no cooldown and generates more stacks, but will not extend the duration.

Name: Ursoc's Blessing
Description: Bear Form's bonus Stamina and Armor persists for 3 seconds after leaving Bear Form.

Name: Ursoc's Rage
Description: Using Maul, Mangle or Lacerate reduces the cooldown of Enrage by 2 seconds. Enrage also reduces the rage cost of Ironfur by 50%.

Name: Vampire Lord
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Dealing damage with your Shadow Priest damage over time spells or healing with Shadow Mend generates a stack of Vampiric Essence.     Mind Flay generates 2 stacks per tick.    Each tick of Mind Sear can consume 3 Vampiric Essence to heal up to 5 allies for 199 health.    Vampiric Essence can stack up to 30 times.

Name: Vampiric Death
Description: Shadow Word: Death consumes your Vampiric Touch on the target, dealing Shadow damage equal to 100% of its total damage. This is increased to 220% if Shadow Word: Death critically strikes.    Shadow Word: Death's self-inflicted damage is reduced by 60%.

Name: Vampirism
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Your Vampiric Embrace healing now scales with Healing Power and heals the lowest-health ally in your party or raid. It no longer provides additional healing to you.    Targets do not need to be in your party or raid. Each heal cannot exceed 5% of your maximum health.

Name: Vengeful Plague
Description: While Seal of Vengeance is active, your Blood Plague now deals 50% more damage.

Name: Venomous Wound
Description: Critical strikes with Slam, Overpower or Mortal Strike against a bleeding target afflict them with Venomous Wound.    Venomous Wound Target takes 75% more damage from your Instant Poison. Holds 3 charges. Lasts 15 sec.

Name: Versatile Power
Description: Your Expose Weakness also grants 2% increased Spell Critical Chance.

Name: Victorious Charge
Description: Casting Charge now grants you Victorious, allowing you to cast Victory Rush once.    This effect can only occur once every 6 sec.    Victorious Allows the use of Victory Rush!

Name: Victorious Stand
Description: Dealing damage with Victory Rush reduces Last Stands cooldown by 10 sec.     Using Last Stand grants one use of Victory Rush, which will further reduce its cooldown by 35 sec.

Name: Violent Combo
Description: Finishing moves have a 20% chance to grant 2 combo points.

Name: Viscera
Description: The periodic damage of Lacerate, Thrash, and auto attacks have a 15% chance of resetting the cooldown of Pulverize, and makes your next Pulverize hit up to 3 targets.

Name: Void Teleportation
Description: Using Void Shift also swaps the position of the caster and the target.

Name: Voidblade
Description: Shadow spells increase the damage of your combo point generating Rogue abilities by 3% and Dark Intent by additional 3%. Stacks up to 3.   Rogue combo point generating abilities have a chance to increase the damage taken from your Shadow Word: Pain by 80% for 8 sec.  The duration of Voidblade is not refreshable at max stacks.

Name: Volcanic Shamanism
Description: Lava Burst reduces the active cooldown of Flame Ascendance by 8 seconds.

Name: Voltaic Companion
Description: Your Tamed Pet's auto attacks now deal Nature damage.    Your Tamed Pet's auto attacks can only be transformed to one damage type at once.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.

Name: Wacky Wizardry
Description: Your offensive Mage spell casts have a 15% chance to cast an additional random Mage spell for free.

Name: Waking Nightmare
Description: Your Haunt applies Waking Nightmare to the target. When that target is healed, the healer is afflicted with Phantom Nightmare.    Phantom Nightmare You deal 10% increased Shadow damage to the target. Fear effects last 50% longer against them.

Name: Wanding
Description: Wand attacks grant you stacks that increase the cast speed of your next spell by 5%, stacks up to 5 times and lasts 6 sec.

Name: Waning Moon
Description: Dealing periodic damage with Moonfire grants you Waning Moon. This effect can only occur once every 1 sec.    Waning Moon Reduces the cast time of your next Arcane Blast or Starfire by 10%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 10 sec.

Name: War Mage
Description: Casting Blink causes an Arcane Explosion at your arrival point, reducing Blink's cooldown by 1.5 sec for each target hit up to a max of 9 seconds.    If you know Arcane Explosion or Arcanist's Explosion you will cast your highest rank known.

Name: Ward of Light
Description: Using Divine Storm now reduces your periodic magic damage taken by 10% for 5 sec. Taking spell damage has a chance to reset the cooldown of Divine Storm.

Name: Weapon Command
Description: Wielding a single Two-Handed weapon now increases your melee attack speed by 10% and melee critical strike chance by 4%.    This effect does not work while in Cat, Bear Form, or with Titan's Grip talent.

Name: Whirl of Rage
Description: Dealing damage with Whirlwind now grants you Bloodrage.    Bloodrage Generates 20 rage at the cost of health, and then generates an additional 10 rage over 10 sec.    This ability is usable while shapeshifted.    It also grants you Enrage if known.    Enrage Physical damage increased by 10%. Haste increased by 10%.

Name: Whirling Bladestorm
Description: Bladestorm now increases your movement speed by 35% while active. Players hit by Bladestorm are knocked into the air.    Each player can only be knocked up once.

Name: Whispers of the Old Gods
Description: Dealing damage with Shadow Word: Pain now has a 35% chance to summon a Tentacle of the Old Gods to wreak havoc on your enemies.     Each Tentacle summoned increases the damage of your Grasp of Darkness by 15% and its critical strike damage bonus by 15%.    Can only trigger from the same target once every 7 sec seconds.

Name: Wild Aggression
Description: Dealing damage with Mongoose Bite or Savage Blade now restores 40 energy and grants you Wild Aggression.    Wild Aggression Increases the damage of your Rogue abilities by 15%. Lasts 8 sec.

Name: Wild Wrath
Description: Dealing damage with Steady Shot or Chimera Shot grants you Wild Wrath.    Wild Wrath Your next Wrath has a 34% reduced cast time and 10% increased damage. Stacks up to 3 times and lasts 12 sec.    If cast at 3 stacks, Wrath refreshes Insect Swarm and resets the cooldown of Chimera Shot.

Name: Wildclaw
Description: Maul has a 12% chance to grant you Wildclaw.      Wildclaw Your next Bloodthirst deals 125% increased damage, hits 3 additional targets, and generates 100% increased threat.

Name: Will of Elune
Description: Your Healing Touch and Regrowth direct heals have a chance to grant party members 2% Spirit for 10 sec. Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Wind Rager
Description: Dealing damage with Stormstrike reduces the cooldown of Whirlwind by 2 seconds.    Dealing damage with Whirlwind reduces the cooldown of Stormstrike by 2 seconds.

Name: Wind Slam
Description: Dealing damage with Windfury grants you Wind Slam    Wind Slam Your next Shield Slam or Shield of Righteousness slams nearby targets with wind, dealing 17 Physical damage and slowing their attack speed by 20% for 30 sec.

Name: Wingman
Description: Challenging Shout now decreases the damage taken by your allies by 10% for 8 sec.

Name: Winter's Lock
Description: Chains of Ice brands the target with Winter's Lock.      Winter's Lock Increases Frost damage you deal to this target by 5%. Lasts 15 sec.

Name: Wisdom of Elune
Description: Your Moonfire damage over time effect has a chance to grant party members 2% Intellect for 10 sec. Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Words of Healing
Description: While Borrowed Time is active, your critical effect chance with direct heals is increased by 20%.

Name: Words of Time
Description: Your Borrowed Time is no longer consumed when casting.

Name: Wrath of the Plague
Description: Your Wrath now afflicts enemies affected by your Haunt or Blood Plague with Wrath of the Plague.      Wrath of the Plague Disease the enemy, dealing 2 Shadow damage every 0.5 sec for 2.50 sec.    This damage can critically strike.

Name: Wrath of the Sun
Description: While Solar Eclipse is active your Wrath deals 100% increased damage but has 66% increased cast time.

Name: Wrathful Strikes
Description: Feral finishing moves now have a 20% chance per combo point spent to grant you Wrathful Strikes.    Wrathful Strikes Your next Wrath can be cast in Cat Form, is instant, and deals 25% increased damage.

Name: Zany Zealot
Description: Your offensive Priest spell casts have a 15% chance to cast an additional random Priest spell for free.

Name: Zephyr
Description: Dealing damage with Windfury grants you Wrath of Al'Akir.    Wrath of Al'Akir Increases your chance to trigger Windfury by 2% and your melee attack speed by 1%.    While at max stacks, your next Windfury hits 2 additional times and consumes all stacks. Stacks up to 10 times and lasts 15 sec.

Name: Aspect of the Beast
Description: Take on the Aspects of a Beast, becoming untrackable and increasing melee attack power by 10% for you and your pet.      Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

Name: Aspect of the Cheetah
Description: You take on the aspects of a cheetah, increasing movement speed by 30%.  If struck, you will be dazed for 4 sec.      Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

Name: Aspect of the Dragonhawk
Description: The hunter takes on the aspects of a dragonhawk, increasing ranged attack power by 120 and chance to dodge by 10%.    Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

Name: Aspect of the Hawk
