Description: The hunter takes on the aspects of a hawk, increasing ranged attack power by 11.      Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

Name: Aspect of the Monkey
Description: The hunter takes on the aspects of a monkey, increasing chance to dodge by 10%.      Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

Name: Aspect of the Pack
Description: The hunter and raid members within 40 yards take on the aspects of a pack of cheetahs, increasing movement speed by 30%.      If you are struck under the effect of this aspect, you will be dazed for 4 sec.    Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

Name: Aspect of the Viper
Description: The hunter takes on the aspect of the viper, causing ranged and melee attacks a chance to regenerate mana.    Damage and healing done reduced by 40%.     You gain 4% of maximum mana every 3 sec.   Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

Name: Aspect of the Wild
Description: The hunter, group and raid members within 30 yards take on the aspect of the wild, increasing Nature resistance by 45.      Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

Name: Barbed Shot
Description: Fire a shot that tears through your enemy, causing them to bleed over 8 sec.    Sends your pet into a bloodrush, increasing attack speed by 20% for 8 sec, stacking up to 3 times.    Max 2 charges. 12 second recharge timer.

Name: Beast Mastery
Description: Requires  Tame Beast Abilities  You master the art of Beast training, teaching you the ability to tame Exotic pets and increasing your total amount of Pet Skill Points by 6.

Name: Bestial Wrath
Description: Send your tamed beast or tamed dragonkin into a rage causing 50% additional damage for 10 sec.  While enraged, the beast does not feel pity or remorse or fear and it cannot be stopped unless killed.  Does not stack with other similar effects.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Call Stabled Pet
Description: Choose one of your stabled pets to replace your current pet. The selected pet busts out of its stable to join you no matter where you are.  Cannot be used in combat.

Name: Eyes of the Beast
Description: Take direct control of your pet and see through its eyes for 1 min.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Frenzy Shot
Description: Fires a shot, dealing 150% weapon damage. This sends your pet into a frenzy, causing its auto attacks to trigger an additional attack that strikes up to 5 nearby enemies for 8 sec.

Name: Intimidation
Description: Command your tamed beast to intimidate the target, causing a high amount of threat and stunning the target for 3 sec. Lasts 15 sec.

Name: Kill Command
Description: Give the command to kill, increasing your tamed beast's damage done from special attacks by 40% for 30 sec. Each special attack done by the tamed beast reduces the damage bonus by 10%.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Master's Call
Description: Your pet attempts to remove all root and movement impairing effects from itself and its owner, and causes your pet and its target to be immune to all such effects for 4 sec.

Name: Mend Pet
Description: Heals your Tamed Pet for 125 health over 15 sec.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.  Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.

Name: Scare Beast
Description: Scares a beast, causing it to run in fear for up to 10 sec.  Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only one beast can be feared at a time.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Tame Beast Abilities
Description: Teaches you the necessary abilities to tame a pet companion.  Teaches you Tame Beast, Call Pet, Dismiss Pet, Feed Pet, Revive Pet and Beast Lore.

Name: Animal Handler
Description: Increases your tamed beast's attack power by 12% and increases the duration of your Master's Call effect by 6 sec.

Name: Aspect Mastery
Description: Aspect of the Viper - Reduces the damage and healing penalty by 10%.  Aspect of the Monkey - Reduces the damage done to you while active by 5%.  Aspect of the Hawk - Increases the attack power bonus by 30%.    Aspect of the Dragonhawk - Combines the bonuses from Aspect of the Monkey and Hawk.

Name: Bestial Discipline
Description: Increases the Focus regeneration of your tamed pets by 100%.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.

Name: Catlike Reflexes
Description: Increases your chance to dodge by 3% and your tamed beast's chance to dodge by an additional 12%.     Reduces the cooldown of your Kill Command ability by 30 sec.

Name: Cobra Strikes
Description: You have a 60% chance when you critically hit with a Ranged or Melee ability to cause your tamed beast's next 2 special attacks to critically hit.

Name: Endurance Training
Description: Increases your total health by 5%.    Increases the health of your tamed beast, enslaved demon, dominated undead, tamed dragonkin, and tethered elemental by 15%.

Name: Ferocious Inspiration
Description: Increases the damage of all party and raid members by 3%.   Does not stack with other similar effects.    Increases the damage dealt by Arcane Shot and Steady Shot by 9%.

Name: Ferocity
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your tamed pet by 15%.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.

Name: Focused Fire
Description: All damage caused by you and your pet is increased by 2% while your pet is active and the critical strike chance of your tamed beast's special abilities is increased by 20% while Kill Command is active.

Name: Frenzy
Description: Gives your pet a 100% chance to gain a 30% attack speed increase for 8 sec after dealing a critical strike.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.

Name: Improved Aspect of the Hawk
Description: While Aspect of the Hawk is active, all Ranged or Melee abilities have a 10% chance of increasing ranged attack speed by 15% for 12 sec.

Name: Improved Aspect of the Monkey
Description: Increases the dodge bonus of your Aspect of the Monkey and Aspect of the Dragonhawk by 6%.

Name: Improved Mend Pet
Description: Reduces the mana cost of your Mend Pet spell by 20%.    Mend Pet has a 50% chance of cleansing 1 Curse, Disease, Magic or Poison effect from the pet each tick.

Name: Improved Revive Pet
Description: All pet revival spells have their cast times reduced by 6 seconds, mana costs reduced by 40%, and the health your pet returns with is increased by an additional 30%.    Revive Pet includes; Revive Elemental, Revive Dragonkin, Revive Undead, Revive Demon.

Name: Invigoration
Description: When your tamed beast scores a critical hit with a special ability, you have a 100% chance to instantly regenerate 1% mana.

Name: Kindred Spirits
Description: Increases your Tamed Pet's damage and healing by 35% and your Tamed Pet's movement speed by 10%.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.

Name: Longevity
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Bestial Wrath, Intimidation and Tamed Beast Pet Special Abilities by 30%.

Name: Pathfinding
Description: Increases the speed bonus of your Aspect of the Cheetah and Aspect of the Pack by 8%.    Increases your speed while mounted by 10%. The mounted movement speed increase does not stack with similar effects.

Name: Primal Reflexes
Description: Increases the dodge bonus of your Aspect of the Monkey and Aspect of the Dragonhawk by 8%.

Name: Serpent's Swiftness
Description: Increases ranged combat attack speed by 20% and your tamed beast's melee attack speed by 20%.

Name: Spirit Bond
Description: While your pet is active, you and your pet will regenerate 2% of total health every 10 sec.    Increases healing done to you and your pet by 10%. This effect does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: The Beast Within
Description: While your tamed beast or tamed dragonkin is under the effects of Bestial Wrath, you also go into a rage causing 15% additional damage and reducing mana costs of all spells and ranged abilities by 50% for 10 sec. While enraged, you do not feel pity or remorse or fear and you cannot be stopped unless killed.  Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Thick Hide
Description: Increases the armor rating of your tamed beast by 20% and your armor contribution from items by 10%.

Name: Unleashed Fury
Description: Increases the damage done by your Tamed Pet by 25%, and Tamed Beast special attacks by an additional 25%.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.

Name: Aimed Shot
Description: An aimed shot that deals 150% weapon damage plus 5 and reduces healing done to that target by 50%. Lasts 10 sec.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Arcane Shot
Description: An instant shot that causes 15 Arcane damage.

Name: Auto shot
Description: Automatically shoots the target until cancelled. Increases your ranged Attack Speed by 33% and scales with Ranged Attack Power.

Name: Chimera Shot
Description: Deals 230% ranged weapon damage, refreshing the current Stings on your target and triggering extra effects if the Stings are active:  Serpent Sting - Instantly deals 90% of the damage done by your Serpent Sting.  Viper Sting - Instantly restores mana to you equal to 60% of the total amount drained by your Viper Sting.   Scorpid Sting - Disarms the target for 10 sec. This effect cannot occur more than once per 1 minute.

Name: Concussive Shot
Description: A shot that deals 90% weapon damage and dazes the target, slowing movement speed by 50% for 4 sec.

Name: Distracting Shot
Description: Distracts the target to attack you, but has no effect if the target is already attacking you. Lasts 6 sec.

Name: Flare
Description: Exposes all hidden and invisible enemies within 10 yards of the targeted area for 20 sec.

Name: Hunter's Mark
Description: Places the Hunter's Mark on the target, increasing the ranged attack power of all attackers against that target by 20.    The marked target can always be seen by the hunter whether it stealths or turns invisible, and appears on the mini-map. Lasts for 5 min.

Name: Kill Shot
Description: You attempt to finish the wounded target off, firing a ranged attack dealing 200% weapon damage plus 26. Kill Shot can only be used on enemies that have 20% or less health.

Name: Multi-Shot
Description: Fires several missiles, hitting 3 targets for 100% weapon damage.

Name: Rapid Fire
Description: Increases ranged attack speed by 40% for 15 sec.

Name: Readiness
Description: When activated, this ability immediately resets the cooldown on your other Hunter abilities except Bestial Wrath.

Name: Scorpid Sting
Description: Stings the target, reducing chance to hit with melee and ranged attacks by 3% for 20 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.    Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Serpent Sting
Description: Stings the target, causing 25 Nature damage over 15 sec.

Name: Silencing Shot
Description: A shot that deals 75% weapon damage and silences the target for 2 sec. Non-player victim spellcasting is also interrupted for 3 sec.     Silencing Shot cannot trigger any procs.    This ability shares a cooldown with other interrupts.

Name: Steady Shot
Description: A steady shot that causes 75% weapon damage plus 9. Causes an additional 10 to slowed targets.

Name: Tranquilizing Shot
Description: Attempts to remove 1 Enrage and 1 Magic effect from an enemy target.

Name: Trueshot Aura
Description: Increases the attack power of all party and raid members by 10% within 100 yards.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Viper Sting
Description: Stings the target, draining 4% mana over 8 sec (up to a maximum of 8% of the caster's maximum mana), and energizing you equal to the amount drained. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.

Name: Volley
Description: Continuously fires a volley of ammo at the target area, causing 55 Arcane damage to enemy targets within 8 yards every 1.00 second for 6 sec.

Name: Barrage
Description: Increases the damage done by your Multi-Shot, Aimed Shot and Volley spells by 12%.

Name: Careful Aim
Description: Requires  Primary Stat: Agility    Increases your hit chance by 3%.   Increases your ranged attack power by an amount equal to 60% of your total Intellect

Name: Combat Experience
Description: Increases your total Agility by 4%.    Increases your melee and ranged critical strike chance by 4%.

Name: Concussive Barrage
Description: Your successful Chimera Shot and Multi-Shot attacks have a 100% chance to Daze the target for 4 seconds.

Name: Efficiency
Description: Increases your Ranged attack speed by 10%.    Reduces the mana cost of your Shots and Stings by 30%.

Name: Focused Aim
Description: Increases your hit chance by 2%.    Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting Steady Shot by 70%.

Name: Go for the Throat
Description: Your ranged and melee critical strikes cause your tamed beast to generate 50 Focus.    Dominate undead, enslaved demon or tamed dragonkin generate 50 Energy.     This effect cannot occur more than once every 2 seconds.

Name: Improved Arcane Shot
Description: Increases the damage done by your Arcane Shot by 15%.

Name: Improved Barrage
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Quick Shot, Multi-Shot and Aimed Shot abilities by 12%.    Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while channeling Volley by 100%.

Name: Improved Concussive Shot
Description: Increases the duration of your Concussive Shot's daze effect by 2 sec.

Name: Improved Hunter's Mark
Description: Increases the bonus attack power granted by your Hunter's Mark ability by 30%.    Reduces the mana cost of your Hunter's Mark ability by 100%.

Name: Improved Steady Shot
Description: Your Steady Shot has a 50% chance to empower your next Aimed Shot, Arcane Shot, Chimera Shot, or Multi-Shots, increasing its damage by 20% and reducing its mana cost by 25%.

Name: Improved Stings
Description: Increases the damage done by your Serpent Sting by 20%, and the effectiveness of Viper Sting by 30%.  Capstone Bonus: If your Serpent Sting is dispelled, the target is afflicted by Serpent's Kiss for 5 sec. Using Chimera Shot on a target afflicted by your Serpent's Kiss deals bonus Nature damage and applies Serpent Sting.

Name: Lethal Shots
Description: Increases your critical strike chance with ranged weapons by 5%.

Name: Marked for Death
Description: Increases the damage done by 6% on targets affected by Hunter's Mark.    Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Hunter Abilities by 12%.

Name: Master Marksman
Description: Increases your critical strike chance by 6%.     Reduces the mana cost of your Steady Shot, Aimed Shot, Chimera Shot and Kill Shot by 25%.

Name: Mortal Shots
Description: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your ranged abilities by 30%.

Name: Perforating Shots
Description: Requires  Primary Stat: Strength Piercing Shots also causes your attacks to pierce 20% of the target's armor.

Name: Piercing Shots
Description: Your critical Aimed Shot, Steady Shot, Arcane Shot, Chimera Shot, Multi-Shot and Kill Shot cause the target to take 40% of the damage dealt over 8 seconds.

Name: Ranged Weapon Specialization
Description: Increases the damage dealt by your Auto Shot and Hunter Shots by 6%.

Name: Rapid Killing
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Rapid Fire ability by 180 seconds.     Killing an opponent that yields experience or honor makes your next two Aimed Shot, Arcane Shot or Chimera Shots cause 20% additional damage.

Name: Rapid Recuperation
Description: Regenerate 6% of your base mana every 3 sec while under the effect of Rapid Fire.    Regenerate 2% of your base mana every 2 sec when you gain Rapid Killing.

Name: Wild Quiver
Description: You have a 30% chance to shoot an additional shot when dealing damage with your Auto Shot or Steady Shot, dealing 60% weapon Nature damage.

Name: Black Arrow
Description: Fires a Black Arrow at the target, increasing all damage done by you to the target by 6% and dealing 94 Shadow damage every 3 over 15 sec.

Name: Counterattack
Description: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 48 damage and immobilizes the target for 5 sec.     Counterattack cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.

Name: Deterrence
Description: When activated, increases parry chance by 100%, reduces the chance ranged attacks will hit you by 100% and grants a 100% chance to deflect spells.  While Deterrence is active, you cannot attack.  Lasts 5 sec.

Name: Disengage
Description: You attempt to disengage from combat, leaping backwards.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Explosive Shot
Description: You fire an explosive charge into the enemy target, dealing 34 Fire damage to the target.    Nearby enemies are also hit, for 40% of damage dealt.     The charge will blast the target every second for an additional 2 sec.

Name: Explosive Trap
Description: Place a fire trap that explodes when an enemy approaches, causing 109 to 139 Fire damage and burning all enemies for 181 additional Fire damage over 20 sec to all within 10 yards. Trap will exist for 30 sec. Only one trap can be active at a time.

Name: Feign Death
Description: Feign death which may trick enemies into ignoring you. Raid Bosses will see through this trick, but staying feigned will deceive them. Lasts up to 6 min.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Freezing Arrow
Description: Fire a freezing arrow that places a Freezing Trap at the target location, freezing the first enemy that approaches, preventing all action for up to 20 sec.  Any damage caused will break the ice.  Trap will exist for 30 sec. Only one trap can be active at a time.

Name: Freezing Trap
Description: Place a frost trap that freezes the first enemy that approaches, preventing all action for up to 10 sec.(8 seconds against players).    Any damage caused will break the ice.   Trap will exist for 30 sec.   Only one trap can be active at a time.

Name: Frost Trap
Description: Place a frost trap that creates an ice slick around itself for 30 sec when the first enemy approaches it. All enemies within 10 yards will be slowed by 50% while in the area of effect. Trap will exist for 30 sec. Only one trap can be active at a time.

Name: Glaive Toss
Description: You hurl two glaives toward the target, each dealing 75% weapon damage.

Name: Immolation Trap
Description: Place a fire trap that will burn the first enemy to approach for 139 Fire damage over 15 sec. Trap will exist for 30 sec. Only one trap can be active at a time.

Name: Misdirection
Description: The current party or raid member targeted will receive the threat caused by your spells and attacks for 6 sec afterwards.

Name: Mongoose Bite
Description: Attack the enemy for 16 damage.

Name: Raptor Strike
Description: A strong attack that increases melee damage by 5.

Name: Scatter Shot
Description: A short-range shot that deals 50% weapon damage and disorients the target for 4 sec.  Any damage caused except for Piercing Shots and Serpent Sting will remove the effect. Turns off your attack when used.

Name: Snake Trap
Description: Place a trap that will release several venomous snakes to attack the first enemy to approach. The snakes will die after 15 sec. Trap will exist for 30 sec. Only one trap can be active at a time.

Name: Track Beasts
Description: Shows the location of all nearby beasts on the minimap and increases damage dealt to beasts by 1%.  Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

Name: Track Demons
Description: Shows the location of all nearby demons on the minimap and increases damage dealt to demons by 1%. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

Name: Track Dragonkin
Description: Shows the location of all nearby dragonkin on the minimap and increases damage dealt to dragonkin by 1%. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

Name: Track Elementals
Description: Shows the location of all nearby elementals on the minimap and increases damage dealt to elementals by 1%. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

Name: Track Giants
Description: Shows the location of all nearby giants on the minimap and increases damage dealt to giants by 1%. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

Name: Track Hidden
Description: Greatly increases stealth detection and shows hidden units within detection range on the minimap.     Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

Name: Track Humanoids
Description: Shows the location of all nearby humanoids on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

Name: Track Undead
Description: Shows the location of all nearby undead on the minimap and increases damage dealts to undead by 1%. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

Name: Tracking Mastery
Description: You gain Tracking Mastery when learning any Tracking Ability.     This Mastery automatically unlocks additional Tracking Abilities when you reach their Class Point requirements at no additional ability essence cost.    Track Beasts Shows the location of all nearby beasts on the minimap and increases damage dealt to beasts by 1%.    Track Humanoids Shows the location of all nearby humanoids on the minimap.    Track Undead Shows the location of all nearby undead on the minimap and increases damage dealts to undead by 1%.    Track Elementals Shows the location of all nearby elementals on the minimap and increases damage dealt to elementals by 1%.    Track Demons Shows the location of all nearby demons on the minimap and increases damage dealt to demons by 1%.    Track Giants Shows the location of all nearby giants on the minimap and increases damage dealt to giants by 1%.    Track Dragonkin Shows the location of all nearby dragonkin on the minimap and increases damage dealt to dragonkin by 1%.    Track Hidden Greatly increases stealth detection and shows hidden units within detection range on the minimap.     Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

Name: Wing Clip
Description: Maims the enemy, dealing 16 damage and reducing the target's movement speed by 50% for 10 sec.

Name: Wyvern Sting
Description: A stinging shot that puts the target to sleep for 30 sec. (6 seconds against players) Any damage will cancel the effect.  When the target wakes up, the Sting causes 300 Nature damage over 6 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on the target at a time.

Name: Entrapment
Description: When your Frost Trap or Snake Trap is triggered you entrap all afflicted targets, preventing them from moving for 4 sec.

Name: Expose Weakness
Description: Critical strikes have a 100% chance to grant you Expose Weakness. Expose Weakness increases your attack power by 25% of your Agility for 7 sec.

Name: Hawk Eye
Description: Increases the range of your ranged weapons by 6 yards.

Name: Hunter vs. Wild
Description: Increases your attack power and ranged attack power equal to 30% of your total Stamina.

Name: Hunting for Sport
Description: Increases damage done by 12% to targets under 35% health.    Increases Expertise by 6.

Name: Hunting Party
Description: Increases your Agility by 3%.  Your Arcane Shot, Explosive Shot and Steady Shot critical strikes have a 100% chance to grant Replenishment.    Replenishment Replenishes 1% of maximum mana per 5 sec on up to 10 party members for 15 sec.

Name: Improved Glaive Toss
Description: Increases the damage of your Glaive Toss by 15%.  Capstone Bonus: Your Glaive Toss jumps to 2 additional nearby targets, and if you are further than 15 yards away targets hit are slowed by 30% for 3 sec.

Name: Killer Instinct
Description: Increases your critical strike chance by 3%.     You have a 100% chance to allow the use of your Counterattack ability after using Mongoose Bite, Explosive Shot or Glaive Toss for 8 sec.     This effect can only occur once every 8 seconds.

Name: Lightning Reflexes
Description: Increases your Agility by 15%.

Name: Lock and Load
Description: Trapping a target with Freezing Trap, Freezing Arrow or Frost Trap has a 100% chance to cause your next 2 Arcane Shot or Explosive Shot spells to trigger no cooldown, and cost no mana.      Periodic damage from Immolation Trap, Explosive Trap and Black Arrow has a 30% to trigger this effect.     This effect has a 15 sec cooldown.

Name: Lone Wolf
Description: Increases the damage of your Auto Shot and Hunter abilities by 8% while you do not have a pet active.

Name: Master Tactician
Description: Your successful offensive ranged shots have a 15% chance to increase your critical strike chance by 9% for 8 sec.

Name: Noxious Stings
Description: You deal 3% more damage to targets afflicted by your Serpent Sting.     If Wyvern Sting is dispelled, the dispeller is also afflicted by Wyvern Sting lasting 50% of the duration remaining.

Name: Point of No Escape
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of all of your attacks on targets affected by your Frost Trap, Freezing Trap and Freezing Arrow by 6%.

Name: Relentless
Description: Damage from Mongoose Bite, Raptor Strike and Counterattack pierce through 20% of the target's armor.

Name: Resourcefulness
Description: Reduces the mana cost of all traps, Hunter melee abilities and Black Arrow by 60%.     Reduces the cooldown of all traps and Black Arrow by 10 sec.  Capstone Bonus: Dealing damage with Immolation Trap, Explosive Trap or Black Arrow reduces the cooldown of your Mongoose Bite, Raptor Strike and Glaive Toss by 1 second.  This effect cannot occur more than once every second.

Name: Savage Retaliation
Description: Increases the damage dealt by your Counterattack by 15%.   Capstone Bonus: Your Mongoose Bite and Raptor Strike critical hits now lower the internal cooldown of Killer Instinct. This effect has a 4 seconds cooldown.

Name: Savage Strikes
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of Counterattack, Mongoose Bite, Raptor Strike and Wing Clip by 24%.

Name: Shredding Strikes
Description: Increases the damage of Counterattack, Mongoose Bite and Raptor Strike by 15%.

Name: Sniper Training
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Kill Shot ability by 15%.    While standing still for 6 sec, you gain Sniper Training increasing the damage of your Steady Shot, Aimed Shot, Black Arrow and Explosive Shot by 6% for 15 sec.

Name: Surefooted
Description: Reduces the duration of movement impairing effects by 30%.

Name: Survival Instincts
Description: Reduces all damage taken by 3%.    Increases the critical strike chance of your Arcane Shot, Steady Shot, Explosive Shot and Glaive Toss by 6%.

Name: Survival Tactics
Description: Reduces the chance your Feign Death ability and all trap spells will be resisted by 4%, and reduces the cooldown of your Disengage ability by 4 sec.

Name: Survivalist
Description: Increases your Agility and Stamina by 3%.     Reduces the duration of all Disarm effects used against you by 30%.    This does not stack with other Disarm duration reducing effects.

Name: T.N.T.
Description: Increases the damage done by your Explosive Shot,  Explosive Trap, Black Arrow and Immolation Trap by 6%.

Name: Thrill of the Hunt
Description: Direct damage Hunter Shots refund 40% of their mana cost when they critically hit.    Arcane Shot and Explosive Shot criticals refund 1 sec of their cooldown, and 2 sec of your Chimera Shot, Multi-Shot, and Aimed Shot. This effect cannot trigger multiple times from the same shot.

Name: Trap Mastery
Description: Frost Trap - Increases the duration by 30%.  Immolation Trap, Explosive Trap and Black Arrow - Increases the periodic damage done by 30%.  Snake Trap - Increases the number of snakes summoned by 6.

Name: Alter Time
Description: Alter the fabric of time, causing the caster to return to their current location, their health and mana, when cast a second time, or after 4 sec. Any self-applied, magic dispellable effects are also returned to their previous state.  Effect negated if the caster dies within the 4 sec or before the effect occurs, or moves too far away.

Name: Amplify Magic
Description: Amplifies magic used against the targeted party member, increasing magic damage taken by 5% and healing spells by 5%.  Lasts 10 min.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Arcane Barrage
Description: Launches several missiles at the enemy target, causing 251 to 306 Arcane damage.

Name: Arcane Blast
Description: Blasts the target with energy, dealing 155 to 179 Arcane damage.      Casting this increases all Arcane damage by 15% and its mana cost by 150%. Stacks up to 4 and lasts 6 sec, removed if you cast another Arcane ability that deals damage.

Name: Arcane Explosion
Description: Causes an explosion of arcane magic around the caster, causing 28 to 32 Arcane damage to all targets within 10 yards.

Name: Arcane Intellect
Description: Increases the target's Intellect by 2 and spell power by 2 for 30 min.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Arcane Missiles
Description: Launches Arcane Missiles at the enemy, causing 17 Arcane damage every 1 sec for 3 sec.

Name: Arcane Orb
Description: Launches an Arcane Orb forward from your position, traveling up to 35 yards, dealing 336 Arcane damage every 0.5 sec to enemies it passes through and increasing their Arcane damage taken from you by 10%.     Subsequent hits on the same target deals 50% less damage.

Name: Arcane Power
Description: When activated, your spells and abilities deal 20% more magic damage while costing 20% more mana to cast.  This effect lasts 15 sec.   Does not stack with other similar effects.  This ability can be used while in Cat, Bear, Moonkin or Tree of Life Shapeshifts.

Name: Arcane Ward
Description: Absorbs 165 Arcane damage. Lasts 30 sec.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Blink
Description: Teleports the caster 20 yards forward, unless something is in the way.  Also frees the caster from stuns and bonds.

Name: Brilliance Aura
Description: Restores 2% missing mana every 1 second to all party members within 35 yards for 15 sec.

Name: Conjure Food
Description: Conjures 10 muffins, providing the mage and her allies with something to eat.  Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

Name: Conjure Mana Gem
Description: Conjures a mana agate that can be used to instantly restore 314 to 337 mana. 3 charges.

Name: Conjure Refreshment
Description: Conjures 20 Mana Berries providing the mage and her allies with something to eat.  Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

Name: Conjure Water
Description: Conjures 10 bottles of water, providing the mage and her allies with something to drink.  Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

Name: Counterspell
Description: Counters the enemy's spell cast, preventing any spell from that school of magic from being cast for 8 sec. Generates a high amount of threat.     This ability shares a cooldown with other interrupts.

Name: Dampen Magic
Description: Dampens magic used against the targeted party member, decreasing magic damage taken by 5% and healing spells by 5%.  Lasts 10 min.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Dispel Curse
Description: Removes 1 Curse from a friendly target.

Name: Evocation
Description: While channeling this spell, you gain 60% of your total mana over 8 sec.

Name: Focus Magic
Description: Increases the target's chance to critically hit with spells by 3%.      When the target critically hits the caster's chance to critically hit with spells is increased by 3% for 10 sec.     Cannot be cast on self.

Name: Invisibility
Description: Fades the caster to invisibility over 3 sec, reducing threat each second. While invisible, you can only see other invisible targets and those who can see invisible. Lasts 20 sec.

Name: Invocation
Description: Channel potent energies, reducing damage taken by 35% and periodically discharge projectiles of raw mana, dealing high-threat Magic damage to nearby enemies. Lasts 4 seconds.    While channeling you are immune to Stun effects.

Name: Mage Armor
Description: Increases your resistance to all magic by 5 and allows 50% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting. Lasts until cancelled.    Only one type of Mage Armor spell can be active at any time.

Name: Mana Shield
Description: Absorbs 120 damage, draining mana instead. Drains 1.5 mana per damage absorbed. Lasts 1 min.

Name: Mana-forged Barrier
Description: Your threat generated is significantly increased.    Teaches you Channeled Mana.      Channeled Mana 2 Mana Taunts the target to attack you, but has no effect if the target is already attacking you.    This spell is learned when you have a Tank Stance and cannot be unlearned.

Name: Mass Invisibility
Description: You and your allies within 40 yards instantly become invisible for 5 sec. The effect is cancelled if you perform any actions. While invisible, you can only see other invisible targets and those who can see invisible. Removes invulnerabilities when used.

Name: Mirror Image
Description: Creates 3 copies of the caster nearby, which cast spells and attack the mage's enemies.  Lasts 30 sec.

Name: Polymorph
Description: Transforms the enemy into a sheep, forcing it to wander around for up to 20 sec. While wandering, the sheep cannot attack or cast spells but will regenerate very quickly.      Any damage will transform the target back into its normal form.     Only one target can be polymorphed at a time. Only works on Beasts, Humanoids and Critters.    8 second duration on players

Name: Portal Mastery
Description: Gives the ability to learn Portal and Teleport spells.  You can learn the various Teleports and Portals in many towns and cities!

Name: Presence of Mind
Description: When activated, your next damaging spell within 10 sec with a casting time less than 10 sec becomes instant.

Name: Ritual of Refreshment
Description: Begins a ritual to create a refreshment table. Raid members can click to receive Conjured Mana Berries.     Requires the caster and 2 others to complete. Participants must right-click the portal and remain still.    Lasts 3 min or 50 charges.

Name: Slow Fall
Description: Slows friendly party or raid target's falling speed for 30 sec.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Slow
Description: Reduces target's movement speed by 60%, increases the time between ranged attacks by 60% and increases casting time by 30%.  Lasts 15 sec(10 versus players) Slow can only affect one target at a time.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Spellsteal
Description: Steals a beneficial magic effect from the target.  This effect lasts a maximum of 2 min.

Name: Arcane Concentration
Description: Gives you a 15% chance of entering a Clearcasting state after using a magic damaging spell or ability.    The Clearcasting state reduces the mana, energy or rage cost of your next spell by 100%.

Name: Arcane Empowerment
Description: Increases the damage of all party and raid members by 3%.   Does not stack with other similar effects.    Increases the spell damage scaling of your Arcane Missiles by 30%.    Increases the spell damage scaling of your Arcane Blast by 15%.

Name: Arcane Flows
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Presence of Mind, Arcane Power, Arcane Orb, Alter Time and Invisibility spells by 30%.    Reduces the cooldown of Evocation by 30 seconds.

Name: Arcane Focus
Description: Increases your Spell penetration by 0, scaling with your level.    Reduces the mana cost of your Arcane spells and abilities by 3%.

Name: Arcane Fortitude
Description: Increases your armor by an amount equal to 150% of your Intellect.     This effect is doubled while Mana-forged Barrier is active.   Capstone Bonus: Your armor contribution from Cloth gear is increased by 30% while Mana-Forged Barrier is active.

Name: Arcane Instability
Description: Increases your spell damage done by 3%.     Increases your critical strike chance by 3%.

Name: Arcane Meditation
Description: Increases your haste by 3%.    Allows 25% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting.

Name: Arcane Mind
Description: Increases your total Intellect by 10% and your spell critical chance by 3%.     The duration of Alter Time is increased by 2 sec.  Capstone Bonus: Reduces the global cooldown of Alter Time by 100%.

Name: Arcane Potency
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your next damaging spell by 30% after gaining Presence of Mind or Clearcasting from Arcane Concentration. This effect will be consumed by any spell cast, even spells which cannot critically strike.

Name: Arcane Shielding
Description: Increases the resistances granted by Mage Armor by 50%.    Decreases the mana lost per point of damage taken when Mana Shield is active by 33%.

Name: Arcane Stability
Description: Increases your hit chance by 2%.    Reduces spell pushback suffered from damaging attacks by 70%.     Reduces the mana cost of your Arcane Mage spells by 6%.

Name: Arcane Subtlety
Description: Reduces the chance your helpful Mage spells and damage over time effects will be dispelled by 30%.    Reduces the threat caused by your Arcane spells by 40%.

Name: Armory of the Archmage
Description: Resistances granted by Magic Absorption are now increased by 100%.

Name: Empowered Mana Shield
Description: Increases the shielding amount of Mana Shield by 100%.    Reduces the chance you'll be critically hit by melee and spells by 6%.    Capstone Bonus: The shielding amount of Mana Shield is further increased by 40% of your Defense Rating.

Name: Improved Blink
Description: Reduces the mana cost of Blink by 50% and for 4 sec after casting your chance to be hit by all attacks and spells is reduced by 30%.

Name: Improved Counterspell
Description: Your Counterspell also silences the target for 4 sec.

Name: Incanter's Absorption
Description: When your Mana Shield, Frost Ward, Fire Ward, Arcane Ward, Ice Barrier, or Arcane Barrier absorbs damage your spell damage is increased by 15% of the amount absorbed for 10 sec.

Name: Magic Absorption
Description: Increases all resistances by 0.5 per level.    All spells that damage you have a 10% chance to restore 2% of your total mana. 6 second cooldown.

Name: Medivh's Reach
Description: Increases the range of your damaging spells with a channeling or cast time by 6 yards.     Does not stack with similar effects.

Name: Mind Mastery
Description: Increases spell damage by 9% of your Intellect.     Reduces the mana cost of all spells by 6%.     Increases the duration of Brilliance Aura by 6 seconds.

Name: Missile Barrage
Description: Using Arcane direct damage spells and abilities has a 40% chance, and Fire and Frost have a 20% chance to empower your next Arcane Missiles, reducing its channel and fire time by 2 seconds, and removing its mana cost.    Arcane Missiles cannot trigger this effect.

Name: Netherwind Presence
Description: Increases spell haste by 9%.

Name: Power Surge
Description: Your direct damaging spells with a cast or channel time have a 100% chance to grant you a Power Surge, reducing all damage taken by 2% for 6 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.

Name: Prismatic Cloak
Description: Reduces all damage taken by 6%.     Reduces the fade time of your Invisibility spell by 3 sec.

Name: Spell Impact
Description: Increases the damage of your Arcane Explosion, Arcane Blast, Arcane Barrage, Arcane Orb, Blast Wave, Fire Blast, Scorch, Pyroblast, Ice Lance and Cone of Cold spells by 6%.

Name: Spell Power
Description: Your spell critical strikes now deal 200% damage.      This does not stack with other similar effects.  Capstone Bonus: Dealing direct critical damage with a spell while your mana is below 50% taps into raw power, restoring 1% of your total mana each second and increasing your magic damage by 4% and Arcane damage by another 2%. This effect lasts for 15 seconds and can only occur once every 30 seconds.

Name: Spellblade
Description: Your melee attacks have a 12% chance to restore 20% of your base mana.

Name: Student of the Mind
Description: Increases your total Spirit by 9%.  Capstone Bonus: Your spell damage is increased by 10% of your Spirit.

Name: Torment the Weak
Description: Your Frostbolt, Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Pyroblast, Arcane Missiles, Arcane Blast, and Arcane Barrage abilities deal 12% more damage to targets affected by a movement or attack speed slow.

Name: Blast Wave
Description: A wave of flame radiates outward from the caster, damaging all enemies caught within the blast for 76 to 88 Fire damage, knocking them back and dazing them for 6 sec.

Name: Combustion
Description: When activated, this spell increases your critical strike damage bonus with Fire damage spells and abilities by 50%, and causes each of your damaging Fire hits to increase your critical strike chance with Fire damage by 10%.  This effect lasts until you have caused 3 non-periodic Fire critical strikes.

Name: Dragon's Breath
Description: Targets in a cone in front of the caster take 170 to 207 Fire damage and are Disoriented for 5 sec.  Any direct damaging attack will revive targets.  Turns off your attack when used.

Name: Fire Blast
Description: Blasts the enemy for 19 to 23 Fire damage.

Name: Fire Ward
Description: Absorbs 165 Fire damage.  Lasts 30 sec.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Fireball
Description: Hurls a fiery ball that causes 14 to 22 Fire damage and an additional 2 Fire damage over 4 sec.

Name: Flamestrike
Description: Calls down a pillar of fire, burning all enemies within the area for 52 to 68 Fire damage and an additional 48 Fire damage over 8 sec.

Name: Living Bomb
Description: The target becomes a Living Bomb, taking 256 Fire damage over 12 sec.  After 12 sec or when the spell is dispelled, the target explodes dealing 120 Fire damage to all enemies within 10 yards.

Name: Meteor
Description: Calls down a meteor which lands at the target location after 3 seconds, dealing 142 Fire damage within 8 yards, and burns the ground for 154 Fire damage over 6 sec to all enemies in the area.

Name: Molten Armor
Description: Causes 40 Fire damage when hit.    Increases your critical strike rating by 10% of your Spirit.    Reduces the chance you are critically hit by 5%.      Lasts until cancelled.    Only one type of Mage Armor spell can be active at any time.

Name: Pyroblast
Description: Hurls an immense fiery boulder that causes 133 to 176 Fire damage and an additional 52 Fire damage over 12 sec.

Name: Scorch
Description: Scorch the enemy for 53 to 65 Fire damage.

Name: Tame Dragonkin
Description: Teaches you the necessary abilities to tame a Dragonkin companion.  Teaches you Tame Dragonkin, Call Dragonkin, Dismiss Dragonkin, Revive Dragonkin and Dragonkin Lore.      Tame Dragonkin Begins taming a dragonkin to be your companion.    Your armor is reduced by 10% while you focus for 20 sec.    If you lose the dragonkin's attention, the taming process will fail.

Name: Blazing Speed
Description: Gives you a 10% chance when hit by a melee or ranged attack to increase your movement speed by 50% and dispel all movement impairing effects.  This effect lasts 8 sec.

Name: Burning Determination
Description: When Interrupted or Silenced you have a 100% chance to become immune to the next Interrupt or Silence mechanic.  Lasts 20 sec.

Name: Burning Soul
Description: Increases your critical strike chance by 2%.    Reduces spell pushback suffered from damaging attacks by 70%.

Name: Burnout
Description: Your spell critical strikes now deal 200% damage.     This does not stack with other similar effects.  Capstone Bonus: Dealing direct Fire damage on targets afflicted by your Ignite increases your spell damage by 3% for 8 seconds. Dealing direct magic non-Fire damage to targets affected by your Ignite causes an explosion, dealing damage to all nearby enemies. Both effects require the final rank of Ignite.

Name: Critical Mass
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire spells and abilities by 6%.

Name: Draconic Knowledge
Description: Grants you an effect based on the aspect of your Dragonkin as long as it is active.  Bronze: Increases your Haste by an amount equal to 12% of your Tamed Dragon's Intellect  Blue: Increases your restored Mana Per 5 Seconds by 24% of your Tamed Dragon's Intellect  Red: Increases your Critical Strike Rating by 15% of your Tamed Dragon's Intellect  Green: Increases your Healing Power by 15% of your Tamed Dragon's Intellect  Black: Increases your Attack Power by 20% of your Tamed Dragon's Intellect  Other Dragonkin: Increases Spell Damage by 15% of your Tamed Dragon's Intellect

Name: Empowered Fire
Description: Increases the spell damage scaling of your Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Pyroblast, and Living Bomb spells by 15%.    Each time your Ignite deals damage, you have a 100% chance to regain 2% of your base mana.

Name: Fiery Payback
Description: Melee and ranged attacks made against you have a 10% chance to disarm your attacker's main hand and ranged weapons for 6 sec.    When below 35% health all damage taken is reduced by 20% and your Pyroblast spell's cast time is reduced by 3.50 secs while the cooldown is increased by 5.0 secs.

Name: Fire Power
Description: Increases all damage done by 3%.    Increases your Fire damage done by 6%.

Name: Firestarter
Description: Casting direct damaging Fire spells or abilities that have a cooldown has a 100% chance to make your next Flamestrike instant, cost no mana, and deal 30% more direct damage.

Name: Flame Throwing
Description: Increases the range of your damaging spells by 6 yards. This does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Hot Streak
Description: Any time you score 2 non-periodic fire spell or ability criticals in a row you have a 100% chance the next Pyroblast spell cast within 10 sec will be instant cast.    Pyroblast cannot trigger this by itself.

Name: Ignite
Description: Your critical strikes from direct Fire damage spells and abilities cause the target to burn for an additional 40% of the triggering spell or abilityâ€™s damage over 4 seconds.

Name: Impact
Description: Your direct damaging spells have a 10% chance and your Meteor has a 100% chance to cause the next Fire Blast you cast to stun the target for 3 sec

Name: Improved Fire Blast
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Fire Blast spell by 2 sec.

Name: Improved Fireball
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of Fireball by 9%.

Name: Improved Molten Armor
Description: Increases the critical strike rating given by Molten armor by an additional 25% of your Spirit.

Name: Improved Scorch
Description: Increases your chance to critically hit with Scorch, Fireball and Frostfire Bolt by an additional 3%.    Your Scorch spell has a 100% chance to cause your target to be vulnerable to spell damage, increasing spell critical strike chance against that target by 5% and lasts 30 sec.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Incineration
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire Blast, Scorch, Arcane Blast and Cone of Cold spells by 6%.

Name: Master of Elements
Description: Your offensive spell criticals will refund 30% of their base mana cost.

Name: Molten Fury
Description: Increases damage done by all Spells and Abilities by 12% to targets under 35% health.

Name: Molten Shields
Description: Reduces the cooldown of Fire Ward, Frost Ward, Arcane Ward and Shadow Ward by 4 sec.    Your Fire Ward, Frost Ward, Arcane Ward and Shadow Ward spells to have a 100% chance to reflect spells from the school it wards against for 1 sec.

Name: Playing with Fire
Description: Increases all damage done by 2% and all magic damage taken by 2%.   Dealing direct magic damage now has a 100% chance to reduce the cooldown of your Combustion and Dragon's Breath by 1 second, doubled when dealing critical strikes.  Dragon's Breath cannot reduce its own cooldown. Up to 15 seconds reduction. Max 5 seconds reduction for Explosive Shot.

Name: Pyromaniac
Description: Increases your critical strike chance by 3%.    Allows 25% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting.   Capstone Bonus: All threat generated is reduced by 30%. This capstone effect does not stack with similar capstone effects.

Name: World in Flames
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Flamestrike, Pyroblast, Blast Wave, Dragon's Breath, Living Bomb, Meteor, Blizzard and Arcane Explosion spells by 6%.

Name: Blizzard
Description: Ice shards pelt the target area doing 288 Frost damage over 8 sec.

Name: Cold Snap
Description: When activated, this spell resets the cooldown on all Frost spells you recently cast.

Name: Cone of Cold
Description: Targets in a cone in front of the caster take 56 to 60 Frost damage and are slowed by 50% for 8 sec.

Name: Deep Freeze
Description: Stuns the target for 5 sec. Only usable on Frozen targets.  Deals 1004 to 1222 damage to monsters permanently immune to stuns.

Name: Frost Armor
Description: Increases Armor by 36.    If an enemy strikes the caster, they may have their movement slowed by 15% and the time between their attacks increased by 20% for 5 sec.   Lasts until cancelled.    Does not stack with other similar effects. Only one type of Mage armor spell can be active at any time.

Name: Frost Nova
Description: Blasts enemies near the caster for 19 to 21 Frost damage and freezes them in place for up to 8 sec.      Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

Name: Frost Ward
Description: Absorbs 165 Frost damage.  Lasts 30 sec.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Frostbolt
Description: Launches a bolt of frost at the enemy, causing 12 to 15 Frost damage and slowing movement speed by 40% for 5 sec.

Name: Frostfire Bolt
Description: Launches a bolt of frostfire at the enemy, causing 177 to 205 Frostfire damage, slowing movement speed by 40% and causing an additional 18 Frostfire damage over 9 sec. This spell will be checked against the lower of the target's Frost and Fire resists.

Name: Frozen Orb
Description: Launches a Frozen Orb forward from the caster's position, that deals 32 Frost damage to all nearby enemy targets every 1 sec for 8 sec.     Targets damaged by the Frost Orb are slowed by 40% for 2 sec.

Name: Ice Barrier
Description: Instantly shields you, absorbing 369 damage.  Lasts 1 min.  While the shield holds, spellcasting will not be delayed by damage.

Name: Ice Block
Description: You become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all attacks for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move or cast spells.      Causes Hypothermia, preventing you from recasting Ice Block for 30 sec.

Name: Ice Lance
Description: Deals 30 to 33 Frost damage to an enemy target.  Causes triple damage against Frozen targets.

Name: Icy Veins
Description: Hastens your spellcasting, increasing spell casting speed by 20% and reducing the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting by 100%. Lasts 20 sec.    Does not stack with other similar cast speed increasing effects.

Name: Ring of Frost
Description: Summons a Ring of Frost at the target location. Enemies entering the ring will become frozen for 6 sec. Lasts 8 sec and has an 8 yard radius.

Name: Summon Water Elemental
Description: Summon a Water Elemental to fight for the caster for 45 sec.

Name: Arctic Reach
Description: Increases the range of your damaging spells by 6 yards and the radius of your Frost Nova and Cone of Cold spells by 20%.    This does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Arctic Winds
Description: Increases all damage done by 3%    Increases Frost damage done by 3%.    Increases the duration of Deep Freeze by 1 sec.  Capstone Bonus: Your Deep Freeze casts apply up to 5 frozen enemies within 8 yards of your target. If used with Fingers of Frost, it will consume only one charge.

Name: Brain Freeze
Description: Dealing direct frost damage has a 15% chance to cause your next Fireball or Frostfire Bolt spell to be instant cast, cost no mana.    Damage dealt by your Arcane Missiles and Frostbolt is increased by 6% on targets affected by your Fireball effect.

Name: Chilled to the Bone
Description: Increases all damage done by 3%.    Reduces the movement speed of targets affected by Frostbolt, Cone of Cold and Frozen Orb by an additional 10%.  Capstone Bonus: Your Frostbolt and Ice Lance casts versus monsters reduce the cooldown of your Deep Freeze by 2 sec and Frozen Orb by 1 sec.

Name: Cold as Ice
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Cold Snap, Ice Barrier and Summon Water Elemental spells by 20%.

Name: Empowering Frostbolt
Description: Reduces the cast time of your Frostbolt by 0.3 sec.    After casting Frostbolt the critical strike damage bonus of your spells is increased by 20% and your total Frost damage is increased by 7% for 8 sec.

Name: Enduring Winter
Description: Increases the duration of your Summon Water Elemental spell by 15 sec.    Your Frostbolt spell has a 100% chance to grant Replenishment. This effect can only occur once every 6 sec.      Replenishment Replenishes 1% of maximum mana per 5 sec on up to 10 party members for 15 sec.

Name: Fingers of Frost
Description: When you deal direct Frost damage with a spell, you have a 15% chance to gain Fingers of Frost.    Fingers of Frost Your spells and abilities treat the target as if it were Frozen. Holds 2 charges. Lasts for 15 seconds.  Ice Lance cannot trigger this effect.

Name: Frost Channeling
Description: Reduces the mana cost of your Frost spells and abilities by 12% and reduces their threat caused by 15%.  Capstone Bonus: Killing an enemy that yields experience or honor with Frost damage will restore 12% of your mana.

Name: Frost Warding
Description: Increases the armor and resistances given by your Frost Armor and Ice Armor spells by 50%.     Frost Ward, Fire Ward, Shadow Ward and Arcane Ward have a 30% chance to negate the damage taken from the spell and restore mana equal to the damage reduced.

Name: Frostbite
Description: Dealing direct frost damage has 15% chance to freeze the target for 5 sec.

Name: Frozen Core
Description: Reduces all magic damage taken by 6%.

Name: Ice Floes
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Frost Nova, Cone of Cold, Ice Block and Icy Veins spells by 33%.

Name: Ice Shards
Description: Your spell critical strikes now deal 200% damage.      This does not stack with other similar effects.  Capstone Bonus: Increases damage against frozen targets by 6%.

Name: Improved Blizzard
Description: Adds a chill effect to your Blizzard.  This effect lowers the target's movement speed by 40%. Lasts 1.50 sec.     Reduces the mana cost of Blizzard by 30% and its periodic interval by 28%.

Name: Improved Cone of Cold
Description: Increases the damage dealt by your Cone of Cold spell by 45%.

Name: Improved Frostbolt
Description: Increases the damage of Frostbolt and Ice Lance by 9%.

Name: Improved Ice Armor
Description: Increases the armor given by your Frost Armor and Ice Armor spells by 60%.

Name: Permafrost
Description: Increases the duration of your Cone of Cold, Frostbolt, Ice Armor and Frost Shock slow effects by 3 sec, reduces the target's speed by an additional 10% and reduces the target's healing received by 20%.

Name: Piercing Ice
Description: Increases all Frost damage you deal by 6%.

Name: Precision
Description: Increases your hit chance by 3%.    Reduces the mana cost of spells by 3%.

Name: Shatter
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your direct spells and abilities against frozen targets by 50%.

Name: Shattered Barrier
Description: While Ice Barrier is active your damage is increased by 6%.  Capstone Bonus: Your Ice Barrier will shatter when destroyed, slowing all enemies within 10 yards by 70% for 4 sec and grants you 8% haste for 8 seconds.

Name: Winter's Chill
Description: Increases your critical strike chance by 3%.     Direct Frost damage has a 100% chance to apply the Winter's Chill effect: Increasing the chance spells will critically strike the target by 1% for 15 sec. Stacks up to 5 times.    Does not stack with other similar effects. Frozen Orb cannot trigger this effect

Name: Aura Mastery
Description: Causes your Concentration Aura to make all affected targets immune to Silence and Interrupt effects and improve the effect of all other auras by 100%.  Lasts 6 sec.

Name: Beacon of Light
Description: The target becomes a Beacon of Light to all members of your party or raid within a 60 yard radius. Any direct heals you cast on party or raid members will also heal the Beacon for 25% of the amount healed. Lasts 15 sec.     Only one target can be the Beacon of Light at a time.

Name: Blessing of Wisdom
Description: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, restoring 10 mana every 5 seconds for 30 min.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Cleanse
Description: Cleanses a friendly target, removing 1 poison effect, 1 disease effect and 1 magic effect.

Name: Concentration Aura
Description: All party or raid members within 40 yards lose 35% less casting or channeling time when damaged.    Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

Name: Consecration
Description: Consecrates the land beneath the Paladin, doing 34 Holy damage over 8 sec to enemies who enter the area.

Name: Divine Favor
Description: When activated, gives your next Holy spell a 100% critical effect chance and 50% increased healing.

Name: Divine Illumination
Description: Reduces resource cost of all magic spells and abilities by 60% and increases the critical effect chance of Holy healing spells by 20% for 15 sec.

Name: Divine Plea
Description: You gain 25% of your total mana over 15 sec, but reduces your healing by 50%.

Name: Exorcism
Description: Causes 99 to 113 Holy damage to an enemy target. Exorcism always critically strikes Undead and Demon targets. It also stuns them for 3 sec.

Name: Flash of Light
Description: Heals a friendly target for 84 to 97.

Name: Holy Light
Description: Heals a friendly target for 28 to 35.

Name: Holy Shock
Description: Blasts the target with Holy energy, causing 191 to 216 Holy damage to an enemy, or 301 to 327 healing to an ally.

Name: Holy Wrath
Description: Sends bolts of holy power in all directions, causing 78 to 90 Holy damage and stunning all Undead and Demon targets within 10 yards for 3 sec.

Name: Lay on Hands
Description: Heals a friendly target for an amount equal of 100% of your maximum health. The target cannot be targeted by Divine Shield, Hand of Protection, Divine Protection or Lay on Hands again for 2 min.    Cannot be used within 30 sec of using Avenging Wrath.

Name: Light of Dawn
Description: Unleashes a wave of Holy energy, healing up to 5 injured allies within a 30 yd frontal cone for 80 to 93.

Name: Light's Hammer
Description: Hurl a Light-infused hammer into the ground, where it will blast a 10 yard area with Arcing Light for 10 sec.  Deals Holy damage to enemies and reduces their movement speed by 50% for 3 sec. Also heals up to 5 allies every 2 sec.

Name: Purify
Description: Purifies the friendly target, removing 1 disease effect and 1 poison effect.

Name: Redemption
Description: Brings a dead player back to life with 65 health and 120 mana.  Cannot be cast when in combat.

Name: Sacred Shield
Description: Each time the target takes damage they gain a Sacred Shield, absorbing 110 damage and increasing the paladin's chance to critically hit with Flash of Light by 50% for up to 6 sec. They cannot gain this effect more than once every 6 sec. Lasts 30 sec.      This spell cannot be on more than one target at any one time.

Name: Seal of Light
Description: Fills you with divine light for until cancelled, giving each melee auto attack a chance to heal you for 0. This effect can only occur once every 2 seconds. Only one Seal can be active at any one time.    Unleashing this Seal's energy will deal 3 Holy damage to an enemy.

Name: Seal of Righteousness
Description: Fills you with holy spirit for until cancelled, granting each main hand auto attack and Paladin melee ability 1 additional Holy damage. Only one Seal can be active at any one time.  Unleashing this Seal's energy will cause 3 Holy damage to an enemy.

Name: Seal of Wisdom
Description: Fills you with divine wisdom for until cancelled, giving each melee auto attack a chance to restore 4% of your total mana. Only one Seal can be active at any one time.    Unleashing this Seal's energy will deal 3 Holy damage to an enemy.

Name: Turn Evil
Description: The targeted undead or demon enemy will be compelled to flee for up to 20 sec.      Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only one target can be turned at a time.

Name: A New Dawn
Description: Increases your critical strike chance by 3%.   Increases the amount healed by your Light of Dawn spell by 30%.  Capstone Bonus: Targets healed by your Light of Dawn receive 20% increased healing from your next Flash of Light, Holy Light, or Holy Shock.

Name: Blessed Hands
Description: Increases the effectiveness of Hand of Sacrifice by 15% and Hand of Salvation by 150%.  Capstone Bonus: Your Hand spells also increase your healing done to the target by 15% while active.

Name: Blessed Life
Description: All attacks against you have a 10% chance to cause half damage.

Name: Divine Intellect
Description: Increases your total Intellect by 10%.

Name: Enlightened Judgements
Description: Increases your hit chance by 4%.    Increases the range of your Judgement of Light and Judgement of Wisdom spells by 30 yards.

Name: Healing Light
Description: Increases the effectiveness by your Holy Light, Flash of Light, Light of Dawn, Holy Shock and Light's Hammer spells by 12%.

Name: Holy Guidance
Description: Increases your spell power by 12% of your Intellect.  Capstone Bonus: Your Holy Shocks now also makes your target susceptible to spell criticals, increasing enemies' chance to be critically struck by spells or allies' chance to be critically healed by 5% for 20 seconds. Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Holy Power
Description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Holy spells and abilities by 5%.

Name: Illumination
Description: Critical heals with Flash of Light, Holy Light or Holy Shock now have a 100% chance to gain mana equal to 30% of the base cost of the spell.

Name: Improved Blessing of Wisdom
Description: Increases the effect of your Blessing of Wisdom spell by 30%.

Name: Improved Concentration Aura
Description: Increases the effect of your Concentration Aura by an additional 15%.    While any Aura is active reduces the duration of any Silence or Interrupt effect used against an affected group member by 30%.      The duration reduction does not stack with any other effects.

Name: Improved Lay on Hands
Description: Grants the target of your Lay on Hands spell 20% reduced Physical damage taken for 15 sec.     Reduces the cooldown of Lay on Hands by 4 min.

Name: Infusion of Light
Description: Your Holy Shock critical effects reduce the cast time of your next Flash of Light by 1.5 sec, or increases the critical chance and critical heal effect of your next Holy Light by 20%.    In addition, causes your Flash of Light to heal targets with Sacred Shield for an additional 100% over 12 sec.

Name: Judgements of the Pure
Description: Increases the damage done by your Seals, Judgements and Execution Sentence by 25%.    Your Judgement spells increase your haste by 15% for 1 min.

Name: Light's Grace
Description: Gives your Holy Light spell a 100% chance to reduce the cast time of your next Holy Light spell by 0.5 sec. This effect lasts 15 sec.

Name: Pure of Heart
Description: Reduces the duration of Curse, Disease and Poison effects by 30%.

Name: Purifying Power
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Holy Wrath and Exorcism by 34%.    Reduces the mana cost of your Cleanse, Holy Wrath, and Consecration spells by 10%.

Name: Sacred Cleansing
Description: Your Cleanse spell has a 30% chance to increase the target's resistance to Disease, Magic and Poison by 30% for 10 sec.

Name: Sanctified Light
Description: Increases the critical effect chance of your Holy Light, Flash of Light, Holy Shock, and Light of Dawn spells by 6%.     Increases the amount healed by your Holy critical heals by 15%.    Capstone Bonus: After using Blinding Light your next Holy Light, Flash of Light, Holy Shock or Light of Dawn has a 100% increased critical effect chance.

Name: Seals of the Pure
Description: Increases the damage done by your Seal of Righteousness, Seal of Vengeance, Seal of Command and Execution Sentence by 30%.

Name: Shining Beacon
Description: Increases Beacon of Light's healing to 100% of initial heal and increases its duration to 60 sec.

Name: Spiritual Focus
Description: Increases your critical strike chance by 2%.    Reduces spell pushback suffered from damaging attacks by 70%.

Name: Unyielding Faith
Description: Reduces the duration of all Fear and Disorient effects by 30%.  This does not stack with other Fear reduction effects.

Name: Avenger's Shield
Description: Hurls a holy shield at the enemy, dealing 441 to 537 Holy damage, Dazing them and then jumping to additional nearby enemies.  Affects 3 total targets. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Blessing of Kings
Description: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing total stats by 10% for 30 min.    Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Blessing of Sanctuary
Description: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, reducing damage taken by 3% and increasing Strength and Stamina by 10% for 30 min.     In addition, when the target blocks, parries, or dodges a melee attack the target will gain 6% of base mana.    Does not stack with similar effects.

Name: Blinding Light
Description: Emits dazzling light in all directions, blinding enemies within 10 yards, causing them to wander disoriented for 6 sec.

Name: Devotion Aura
Description: Gives 40 additional armor to party and raid members within 40 yards.      Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

Name: Divine Intervention
Description: You sacrifice yourself to remove the targeted party member from harm's way. Enemies will stop attacking the protected party member, who will be immune to all harmful attacks but will not be able to take any action for 3 min.

Name: Divine Protection
Description: Reduces all damage taken by 50% for 12 sec.    Cannot be used within 30 sec of using Avenging Wrath.    Once protected, the target cannot be targeted by Divine Protection, Divine Shield, Hand of Protection or Lay on Hands for 2 min.   This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Divine Sacrifice
Description: 30% of all damage taken by party members within 30 yards is redirected to the caster (up to a maximum of 40% of the caster's health times the number of party members).  Damage which reduces the caster below 20% health will break the effect.  Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Divine Shield
Description: Protects you from all damage and spells for 12 sec, but reduces your damage by 50%.    Once protected, the target cannot be targeted by Divine Shield, Hand of Protection, Divine Protection or Lay on Hands again for 2 min.

Name: Fire Resistance Aura
Description: Gives 30 additional Fire resistance to all party and raid members within 40 yards.      Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

Name: Frost Resistance Aura
Description: Gives 30 additional Frost resistance to all party and raid members within 40 yards.      Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

Name: Hammer of Justice
Description: Stuns the target for 3 sec and interrupts non-player spellcasting for 3 sec.

Name: Hammer of the Righteous
Description: Hammer the current target and up to 2 additional nearby targets, causing 4 times your main hand damage per second as Holy damage.

Name: Hand of Freedom
Description: Places a Hand on the friendly target, granting immunity to movement impairing effects for 6 sec.

Name: Hand of Protection
Description: A targeted party or raid member is protected from all physical attacks, Interrupt and Silence mechanics for 6 sec, but during that time they cannot attack or use physical abilities. This also removes any Stun effects on use.  Once protected, the target cannot be targeted by Divine Shield, Hand of Protection, Divine Protection or Lay on Hands again for 2 min.    Cannot be used within 30 sec of using Avenging Wrath.

Name: Hand of Sacrifice
Description: Places a Hand on the party or raid member, transferring 30% damage taken to the caster.  Lasts 12 sec or until the caster has transferred 100% of their maximum health.

Name: Hand of Salvation
Description: Places a Hand on the party or raid member, reducing their total threat by 2% every 1 sec. for 10 sec.  Players may only have one Hand on them per Paladin at any one time.

Name: Holy Shield
Description: Increases chance to block by 30% for 10 sec. Each block expends a charge and deals 50 holy damage to the attacker. 8 charges.

Name: Righteous Defense
Description: Transfers the next melee or ranged attack made against an ally. In addition, while active 20% of the threat they generate is transferred to you instead.  Casting this spell with an enemy target will redirect it to whatever they are targeting.    This cannot be used in Battlegrounds or Arenas

Name: Righteous Fury
Description: Your threat generated is significantly increased.    Teaches you Hand of Reckoning.   Also increases your chance to block Fierce Blows.

Name: Seal of Justice
Description: Fills the Paladin with the spirit of justice for until cancelled, giving each melee attack a chance to stun for 2 sec. This effect has a 10 second cooldown. Only one Seal can be active at any one time.  Unleashing this Seal's energy will deal 3 Holy damage to an enemy.

Name: Shadow Resistance Aura
Description: Gives 30 additional Shadow resistance to all party and raid members within 40 yards.      Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

Name: Shield of Righteousness
Description: Slam the target with your shield, causing Holy damage based on your block value plus an additional 5. This ability will also heal you based on your spell damage.

Name: Anticipation
Description: Increases your Dodge chance by 5%.

Name: Ardent Defender
Description: When below 35% health all damage taken is reduced by 6%.    You have a 100% chance to fully absorb an attack which would otherwise kill you, up to a maximum of 15% of your total health and heal you by up to 20% of your maximum health (amount healed based on defense). You also take 20% increased healing for the next 3 sec.     This effect shares a 2 minute cooldown with Cheat Death and Spirit of Redemption.

Name: Blessed Weapons
Description: Increases all damage you deal when a one-handed melee weapon is equipped by 10%.    The all-damage increase does not stack with Enhanced Weapon Mastery, Unending Fury, Answered Prayers, Blood Gorged or Blood Presence. Only the highest increase applies.

Name: Combat Expertise
Description: Increases your Stamina by 6%.    Increases your critical strike chance by 6%.    Increases your Expertise by 6.

Name: Divine Guardian
Description: When Divine Sacrifice is activated, your party and raid members within 30 yards take 20% reduced damage for 6 sec.      Increases the duration of your Sacred Shield by 100% and the amount absorbed by 20%.

Name: Divine Strength
Description: Increases your total Strength by 15%.

Name: Divinity
Description: Requires  Path of Strength  Increases all healing effects on you by 12%.    Increases your healing power by 60% of your Stamina.    The healing effect does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Exceptional Devotion Aura
Description: Increases the armor bonus of your Devotion Aura by 45%.

Name: Guarded by the Light
Description: Reduces spell damage taken by 6%.    You have a 100% chance to refresh the duration of your Divine Plea when you hit an enemy with melee attack.     Your Divine Plea spell is 100% less likely to be dispelled.

Name: Guardian's Favor
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Hand of Protection by 120 sec.    Increases the duration of your Hand of Freedom by 4 sec.

Name: Improved Consecration
Description: Consecration now deals instant Holy damage to nearby enemies, causing extra threat and slowing their melee attack speed by 20% for 15 sec.  Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Improved Devotion Aura
Description: Increases the armor bonus of your Devotion Aura by 50%.    Increases the amount healed on any target affected by your any of your Auras by 6%.

Name: Improved Hammer of Justice
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Hammer of Justice by 20 sec.

Name: Improved Righteous Fury
Description: While Righteous Fury is active all damage you take is reduced by 6%.

Name: Inner Light
Description: Increases the damage of Shield of Righteousness by 15% and its healing done by 30%.

Name: Judgements of the Just
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Hammer of Justice by 10 sec.     Increases the duration of your Seal of Justice effect by 1 sec.    Your Judgement spells also reduce the melee attack speed of the target by 20%.

Name: Reckoning
Description: You have a 10% chance after being hit by or avoiding a melee attack to gain 4 stacks of Reckoning, causing your next melee attack within 8 sec to generate an additional attack.

Name: Redoubt
Description: Increases your chance to block attacks with a shield by 10%.     Blocking an attack has a 10% chance to increase your Strength by 10% and reduce your damage taken by 6%.  Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Righteous Verdict
Description: Increases the duration of Hammer of Justice by 2 sec.

Name: Sacred Duty
Description: Increases your total Stamina by 6%.    Reduces the chance you'll be critically hit by melee attacks by 6%.    Reduces the cooldown of your Divine Shield and Divine Protection spells by 60 sec.

Name: Shield of the Templar
Description: Reduces all damage taken by 3%.    Your Avenger's Shield has a 100% chance to silence your targets for 3 sec.    Capstone Bonus: Being healed by others reduces the cooldown of your Divine Protection by 1 second and Holy Shield by 1 second. This effect can only occur once every second.

Name: Spiritual Attunement
Description: Being healed by allies also restores mana equal to 10% of the effective amount healed.

Name: Stoicism
Description: Reduces the duration of all Stun effects by 30%.    Reduces the chance your Paladin helpful spells and damage over time effects will be dispelled by an additional 30%.   This does not stack with other Stun reduction effects.

Name: Tenacity
Description: Increases your armor value from items by 6%.    Increases threat generated from all skills by 15%.  Capstone Bonus: Your Armor is increased by an amount equal to your Strength.

Name: Touched by the Light
Description: When you receive effective healing from another player, you have an 33% chance to gain Touched by the Light, increasing your next direct heal on yourself by 30%.  While Touched by the Light is active, directly healing yourself grants Shroud of Light, causing the next direct damage taken to heal you for 30% of the damage taken plus 0.  This can only occur once every 8 seconds.  Does not work with Tactical Mastery.

Name: Avenging Wrath
Description: Increases all damage and healing caused by 20% for 20 sec.   Cannot be used within 30 sec of being the target of Divine Shield, Divine Protection, or Hand of Protection, or of using Lay on Hands on oneself.    Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Blessing of Might
Description: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing their Strength and Agility by 2 for 30 min.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Crusader Aura
Description: Increases the mounted speed by 20% for all party and raid members within 40 yards.  Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.     This does not stack with other movement speed increasing effects.

Name: Crusader Strike
Description: An instant strike that causes 75% weapon damage.

Name: Divine Storm
Description: An instant weapon attack that causes 110% of weapon damage to up to 4 enemies within 8 yards. The Divine Storm heals up to 3 party or raid members for 25% of the damage caused.

Name: Execution Sentence
Description: A hammer slowly falls from the sky, causing Holy damage if the target is an enemy and healing if the target is an ally, over 10 sec.     This culminates in a final burst of damage or healing. Dispelling the effect triggers the final burst.

Name: Hammer of Wrath
Description: Hurls a hammer that strikes an enemy for 354 to 390 Holy damage. Only usable on enemies that have 20% or less health.

Name: Judgement of Justice
Description: Unleashes the energy of a Seal spell to judge an enemy for 20 sec, preventing them from fleeing and limiting their movement speed.      Refer to individual Seals for additional Judgement effect.    Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

Name: Judgement of Light
Description: Unleashes the energy of a Seal spell to judge an enemy for 20 sec, granting auto attacks and auto shots made against the judged enemy a chance of healing the attacker for 2% of their base health.      Refer to individual Seals for additional Judgement effect.    Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

Name: Judgement of Wisdom
Description: Unleashes the energy of a Seal spell to judge an enemy for 20 sec, giving each attack a chance to restore 2% of the attacker's base mana.     Refer to individual Seals for additional Judgement effect.    Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

Name: Repentance
Description: Puts the enemy target in a state of meditation, incapacitating them for up to 1 min (6 seconds on players), and removing the effect of Righteous Vengeance.  Any damage caused will awaken the target. Usable against Demons, Dragonkin, Giants, Humanoids and Undead.

Name: Retribution Aura
Description: Causes 11 Holy damage to any enemy that strikes a party or raid member within 40 yards.      Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

Name: Seal of Command
Description: All main hand auto attacks and Paladin melee abilities deal 0 to 1 additional Holy damage to the target and up to 2 additional targets. Lasts until cancelled.  Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy, instantly causing 1 to 2 Holy damage.

Name: Seal of Vengeance
Description: Fills you with holy power, causing main hand auto and Paladin melee abilities to apply Holy Vengeance, which deals 1 additional Holy damage over 15 sec.    Holy Vengeance can stack up to 5 times. Once stacked to 5 times, each of your main hand auto attacks and Paladin melee abilities deals damage as additional Holy damage. Only one Seal can be active on the caster at any one time. Lasts until cancelled.  Unleashing this Seal's energy will deal 3 Holy damage to an enemy, increased by 10% for each application of Holy Vengeance on the target.

Name: Benediction
Description: Restores 30% base mana when you kill a target that gives experience or honor. This effect cannot occur more than once every 5 seconds.  Capstone Bonus: Benediction now also restores mana to party members below 50% of their total mana.

Name: Conviction
